      left.monomials.card * right.monomials.card

name: Algebraic.FiniteSupport.mem_add
statement:
theorem mem_add
    [DecidableEq M]
    (monomial : M)
    (left right : FiniteSupport M) :
    monomial ∈ (left + right).monomials ↔
      monomial ∈ left.monomials ∨ monomial ∈ right.monomials

name: Algebraic.FiniteSupport.mem_mul
statement:
theorem mem_mul
    [DecidableEq M]
    [Mul M]
    (monomial : M)
    (left right : FiniteSupport M) :
    monomial ∈ (left * right).monomials ↔
      ∃ leftMonomial ∈ left.monomials,
        ∃ rightMonomial ∈ right.monomials,
          leftMonomial * rightMonomial = monomial

name: Algebraic.FiniteSupport.monomials_add

name: Algebraic.FiniteSupport.monomials_empty

name: Algebraic.FiniteSupport.monomials_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem monomials_mul

      left.monomials.image₂ (· * ·) right.monomials

name: Algebraic.BooleanCube.ModThree.Internal.residue_affineCube
statement:
theorem residue_affineCube (a : ι → ZMod 2) (v : J → ι → ZMod 2)
    (disjoint : DisjointDirections v) (z : J → ZMod 2) :
    residue (affineCube a v z) =
      residue a + ∑ j, bit (z j) * (residue (a + v j) - residue a)

name: Algebraic.BooleanCube.ModThree.exists_affineCube_of_disjoint_blocks
statement:
theorem exists_affineCube_of_disjoint_blocks
    (R : (ι → ZMod 2) →ₗ[ZMod 2] (κ → ZMod 2)) (a : ι → ZMod 2)
    (B : J → Finset ι) (disjoint : Pairwise fun j k => Disjoint (B j) (B k))
    (large : ∀ j, 2 * Fintype.card κ < (B j).card) :
    ∃ v : J → ι → ZMod 2,
      DisjointDirections v ∧ Function.Injective (affineCube a v) ∧
      (∀ z, R (affineCube a v z) = R a) ∧
      (∀ j, residue (a + v j) - residue a ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ z, residue (affineCube a v z) =
        residue a + ∑ j, bit (z j) * (residue (a + v j) - residue a)

name: Algebraic.BooleanCube.ModThree.exists_signed_cube
statement:
theorem exists_signed_cube {n q : ℕ}
    (R : (Fin n → ZMod 2) →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin q → ZMod 2)) (a : Fin n → ZMod 2) :
    ∃ (L : (Fin (n / (2 * q + 1)) → ZMod 2) →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin n → ZMod 2))
      (δ : Fin (n / (2 * q + 1)) → ZMod 3),
      Function.Injective L ∧ (∀ z, R (L z) = 0) ∧
      (∀ j, δ j = 1 ∨ δ j = -1) ∧
      ∀ z, residue (a + L z) = residue a + ∑ j, bit (z j) * δ j

name: Algebraic.BooleanCube.ModThree.residue_affineCube

theorem residue_affineCube (a : ι → ZMod 2) (v : J → ι → ZMod 2)

      residue a + ∑ j, bit (z j) * (residue (a + v j) - residue a)

theorem exists_stage {k L R : ℕ} {D E : ℝ} {LB : Finset (Fin (2 * k + 1)) → ℕ}
    (hLB : PairedClusterBound k L R D E LB) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hRL : R ≤ L) (hLk : L ≤ k)
    (hD : 3 / 2 ≤ D) {l : List (Fin (2 * k + 1))} (hl : l.Nodup) (hlu : l.toFinset = univ) :
    ∃ q ≤ 2 * k + 1, (1 + 2 * D / 3) * (2 * k + 1 : ℝ) - D * E -

statement:
theorem le_sub_card_add_of_lost [DecidableEq α] {k L R : ℕ} {D E V : ℝ} {f : α → ℤ}
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hfk : ∀ a, -(k : ℤ) ≤ f a ∧ f a ≤ k) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hRL : R ≤ L) (hD : 3 / 2 ≤ D) {S S' : Finset α} (hSS' : (S \ S').card ≤ 1)
    (hlost : ∀ j, (S' ∩ sideBlock (fun a => -f a) L j).card < R) {i₁ j₀ : ℕ}
    (hi₁ : R ≤ (S ∩ sideBlock f L i₁).card)
    (hH : ∀ i, R ≤ (S ∩ sideBlock f L i).card → ∃ a ∈ sideBlock f L i,
      ∃ b ∈ sideBlock (fun a => -f a) L j₀,
        D * ((phi (2 * k + 1) (f a) (-f b) : ℝ) - E) ≤ V) :
    (1 + 2 * D / 3) * (2 * k + 1 : ℝ) - D * E - (8 * L + R * (2 * k + 1) / L + 2) ≤
      (2 * k + 1 : ℝ) - S.card + V

theorem PairedClusterBound.exists_stage {k L R : ℕ} {D E : ℝ}
    {LB : Finset (Fin (2 * k + 1)) → ℕ} (hLB : PairedClusterBound k L R D E LB) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hRL : R ≤ L) (hLk : L ≤ k) (hD : 3 / 2 ≤ D) {l : List (Fin (2 * k + 1))} (hl : l.Nodup)
    (hlu : l.toFinset = univ) :
    ∃ q ≤ 2 * k + 1, (1 + 2 * D / 3) * (2 * k + 1 : ℝ) - D * E -
      (8 * L + R * (2 * k + 1) / L + 2) ≤ q + LB (univ \ (l.take q).toFinset)

statement:
theorem le_sub_card_add_of_lost {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {k L R : ℕ}
    {D E V : ℝ} {f : α → ℤ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (hfk : ∀ a, -(k : ℤ) ≤ f a ∧ f a ≤ k)
    (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hRL : R ≤ L) (hD : 3 / 2 ≤ D) {S S' : Finset α} (hSS' : (S \ S').card ≤ 1)
    (hlost : ∀ j, (S' ∩ sideBlock (fun a => -f a) L j).card < R) {i₁ j₀ : ℕ}
    (hi₁ : R ≤ (S ∩ sideBlock f L i₁).card)
    (hH : ∀ i, R ≤ (S ∩ sideBlock f L i).card → ∃ a ∈ sideBlock f L i,
      ∃ b ∈ sideBlock (fun a => -f a) L j₀,
        D * ((phi (2 * k + 1) (f a) (-f b) : ℝ) - E) ≤ V) :
    (1 + 2 * D / 3) * (2 * k + 1 : ℝ) - D * E - (8 * L + R * (2 * k + 1) / L + 2) ≤
      (2 * k + 1 : ℝ) - S.card + V

statement:
theorem choose_mul_card_le_rank_of_shifts (o : Fin (2 * p + 1) → ℤ)
    (g : Fin (2 * p + 1) → Fin m → ℂ) (e : Fin (2 * p + 1) → Fin m → ℕ)
    (ho : Set.InjOn (fun I : Finset (Fin (2 * p + 1)) => ∑ t ∈ I, o t) {I | I.card = p})
    (hg : ∀ t j, g t j = 2 ^ 2 ^ e t j) (D : ℕ)
    (hD : ∀ I I' : Finset (Fin (2 * p + 1)), I.card = p → I'.card = p →
      ∑ t ∈ I, o t - ∑ t ∈ I', o t ≤ D)
    (he : ∀ t t' (j j' : Fin m), |(j : ℤ) - j'| ≤ D → e t j = e t' j' → t = t' ∧ j = j')
    {Q : Type*} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] (w : Q → ℤ) (hw : Function.Injective w)
    (hrange : ∀ q (K : Finset (Fin (2 * p + 1))), K.card = p ∨ K.card = p + 1 →
      0 ≤ w q + ∑ t ∈ K, o t ∧ w q + ∑ t ∈ K, o t < m) :

name: Algebraic.Tensor3.Internal.Diagonal.choose_mul_le_rank
statement:
theorem choose_mul_le_rank (o : Fin (2 * p + 1) → ℤ) (g : Fin (2 * p + 1) → Fin m → ℂ)

    (hlo : ∀ K : Finset (Fin (2 * p + 1)), K.card = p ∨ K.card = p + 1 →
      lo ≤ ∑ t ∈ K, o t ∧ ∑ t ∈ K, o t ≤ lo + D)

name: Algebraic.Tensor3.Internal.Diagonal.det_submatrix_shift_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_submatrix_shift_ne_zero (o : Fin (2 * p + 1) → ℤ)
    (g : Fin (2 * p + 1) → Fin m → ℂ) (e : Fin (2 * p + 1) → Fin m → ℕ)
    (ho : Set.InjOn (fun I : Finset (Fin (2 * p + 1)) => ∑ t ∈ I, o t) {I | I.card = p})
    (hg : ∀ t j, g t j = 2 ^ 2 ^ e t j) (D : ℕ)
    (hD : ∀ I I' : Finset (Fin (2 * p + 1)), I.card = p → I'.card = p →
      ∑ t ∈ I, o t - ∑ t ∈ I', o t ≤ D)
    (he : ∀ t t' (j j' : Fin m), |(j : ℤ) - j'| ≤ D → e t j = e t' j' → t = t' ∧ j = j')
    (σ : {I : Finset (Fin (2 * p + 1)) // I.card = p} ≃
      {J : Finset (Fin (2 * p + 1)) // J.card = p + 1})
    (hσ : ∀ I, I.1 ⊆ (σ I).1) (w : ℤ) (ℓ j : {I : Finset (Fin (2 * p + 1)) // I.card = p} → Fin m)
    (hℓ : ∀ I, (ℓ I : ℤ) = w + ∑ t ∈ (σ I).1, o t) (hj : ∀ I, (j I : ℤ) = w + ∑ t ∈ I.1, o t) :
    ((koszulFlattening p (weightedShifts o g)).submatrix (fun I => (σ I, ℓ I))
      (fun I => (I, j I))).det ≠ 0

name: Algebraic.Tensor3.Internal.Diagonal.koszulFlattening_weightedShifts_apply
statement:
theorem koszulFlattening_weightedShifts_apply [LinearOrder α] [Fintype α] {m p : ℕ} (o : α → ℤ)
    (g : α → Fin m → ℂ) (J : {J : Finset α // J.card = p + 1}) (ℓ : Fin m)
    (I : {I : Finset α // I.card = p}) (j : Fin m) :
    koszulFlattening p (weightedShifts o g) (J, ℓ) (I, j) =
      ∑ t, wedgeCoeff J.1 I.1 t * if (ℓ : ℤ) = j + o t then g t j else 0

name: Algebraic.Tensor3.Internal.Diagonal.koszulFlattening_weightedShifts_eq_zero
statement:
theorem koszulFlattening_weightedShifts_eq_zero [LinearOrder α] [Fintype α] {m p : ℕ}

    (I : {I : Finset α // I.card = p}) (j : Fin m)
    (h : ∀ t, t ∉ I.1 → insert t I.1 = J.1 → (ℓ : ℤ) ≠ j + o t) :
    koszulFlattening p (weightedShifts o g) (J, ℓ) (I, j) = 0

    (ha₄ : a₄ ≤ r - 2 * μ) (hrs : r + s ≤ m) (q : Tiles a₁ a₂ a₃ a₄) :
    (F : ℤ) ≤ tileCenter r s μ q ∧ tileCenter r s μ q + F < m ∧

    (ha₂ : a₂ ≤ min s (m - r - (r + s)) - 2 * μ) (ha₃ : a₃ ≤ min r (m - s - (r + s)) - 2 * μ)

statement:
theorem choose_mul_card_le_rank_koszulFlattening_sum_weightedShifts {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (o : κ → Fin (2 * p + 1) → ℤ) (g : κ → Fin (2 * p + 1) → Fin m → ℂ)
    (e : κ → Fin (2 * p + 1) → Fin m → ℕ)
    (ho : ∀ b, Set.InjOn (fun I : Finset (Fin (2 * p + 1)) => ∑ t ∈ I, o b t) {I | I.card = p})
    (hg : ∀ b t j, g b t j = 2 ^ 2 ^ e b t j)
    (he : ∀ b t t' (j j' : Fin m), |(j : ℤ) - j'| ≤ subsetSumSpread p (o b) →
      e b t j = e b t' j' → t = t' ∧ j = j')
    (hinj : ∀ t, Function.Injective fun b => o b t)
    {Q : Type*} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] (c : Q → κ) (w : Q → ℤ) (v : Q → ℕ)
    (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hrange : ∀ q (K : Finset (Fin (2 * p + 1))), K.card = p ∨ K.card = p + 1 →
      0 ≤ w q + ∑ t ∈ K, o (c q) t ∧ w q + ∑ t ∈ K, o (c q) t < m)
    (hvanish : ∀ q q', v q' < v q → ∀ b (I : Finset (Fin (2 * p + 1))) t, I.card = p →
      t ∉ I → w q + ∑ x ∈ insert t I, o (c q) x ≠ w q' + ∑ x ∈ I, o (c q') x + o b t) :
    (2 * p + 1).choose p * Fintype.card Q ≤
      (koszulFlattening p (∑ b, weightedShifts (o b) (g b))).rank

theorem map_add_selectSlices_map_diagonal (cP cN : α' → α) (d : α → ℂ)
    (hdP : ∀ t, d (cP t) = 1) (hdN : ∀ t, d (cN t) = 1) (T : Tensor3 α β γ) :
    map (selectSlices cP + selectSlices cN) 1 1
        (map (Matrix.diagonal d) (1 : Matrix β β ℂ) (1 : Matrix γ γ ℂ) T) =
      map (selectSlices cP + selectSlices cN) (1 : Matrix β β ℂ) (1 : Matrix γ γ ℂ) T

name: Algebraic.Tensor3.map_add_selectSlices_weightedLMTensor
statement:
theorem map_add_selectSlices_weightedLMTensor (cP cN : Fin (2 * p + 1) → Fin (2 * k + 1)) :
    map (selectSlices cP + selectSlices cN) 𝟙 𝟙 (weightedLMTensor k) =
      weightedShifts (clusterOffsets k cP) (fun t j => lmWeight k (cP t) j) +
        weightedShifts (clusterOffsets k cN) (fun t j => lmWeight k (cN t) j)

name: Algebraic.Tensor3.Internal.Explicit.exists_cluster_negBlock

    (hS : 3 ^ (2 * p) + 1 ≤ (S ∩ DeletionGame.negBlock k L i).card) :
    ∃ c : Fin (2 * p + 1) → Fin (2 * k + 1), StrictMono c ∧
      (∀ t, c t ∈ S ∩ DeletionGame.negBlock k L i) ∧
      (Function.Injective fun I : Finset (Fin (2 * p + 1)) => ∑ t ∈ I, clusterOffsets k c t) ∧
      clusterOffsets k c (Fin.last (2 * p)) - clusterOffsets k c 0 ≤ (L : ℤ) - 1 ∧
      ∀ t, -(k : ℤ) ≤ clusterOffsets k c t ∧ clusterOffsets k c t ≤ -1

name: Algebraic.AC0.Switching.card_combinedAdvice_succ

theorem card_combinedAdvice_succ (width pathLength : Nat) :
    Nat.card (CombinedAdvice width (pathLength + 1)) =
      ∑ index : Fin (Nat.min width (pathLength + 1)),
        if index.val = pathLength then
          width.choose (index.val + 1) * 2 ^ (index.val + 1)
        else
          (width.choose (index.val + 1) *
              (2 ^ (index.val + 1) - 1)) *
            Nat.card
              (CombinedAdvice width (pathLength - index.val))

theorem eventually_lt_size_of_sliceBound {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    (Good : Nat → Nat → Prop) (D K : Nat → Nat)
    (hD : (fun n => (D n : ℝ)) =o[atTop] (fun n => (n : ℝ)))
    (hK : (fun n => Real.logb 2 (K n)) =o[atTop] (fun n => (n : ℝ)))
    (hKtwo : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 1 < K n)
    (hslices : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ g, Good n g → SliceBound A η C n g (D n) (K n))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ g, Good n g → (1 + 1 / A - ε) * n < g

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.log_bound_of_count
statement:
theorem log_bound_of_count {A η C N : ℝ} (hAη : 0 ≤ A + η) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hN : 1 ≤ N) {m g D K : Nat} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hcount : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((m : ℝ) - 2) ≤
      (N * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((A + η) * max ((g : ℝ) - m) 0 +
        3 * Real.logb 2 N + C + 3) + 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((D : ℝ) + 1) * K ^ 2) :
    (m : ℝ) ≤ (A + η) * max ((g : ℝ) - m) 0 +
      4 * Real.logb 2 N + C + D + 2 * Real.logb 2 K + 7

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.lt_size_of_sliceBound
statement:
theorem lt_size_of_sliceBound {A η θ C : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hηθ : η ≤ A ^ 2 * θ / 2) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθA : θ ≤ 1 / A) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    {n g D K : Nat} (hK : 1 < K) (hslice : SliceBound A η C n g D K)
    (hlog : (A + η + 2) * D + (A + η + 3) * Real.logb 2 K +
      4 * Real.logb 2 n + (4 * Real.logb 2 (4 + 3 / A) + C + 4 * (A + η) + 11) <
        A * θ / 2 * n) : (1 + 1 / A - θ) * n < g

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.eventually_lt_of_oneWayBound
statement:
theorem eventually_lt_of_oneWayBound (K : Nat → Nat)
    (small : (fun n => Real.logb 2 (K n)) =o[atTop] (fun n => (n : ℝ)))
    (positive : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 1 ≤ K n) (C : Nat) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ B : Nat,
      n ≤ B + 2 * Nat.clog 2 (K n) + C → (1 - ε) * n < B

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.eventually_lt_of_real_oneWayBound
statement:
theorem eventually_lt_of_real_oneWayBound (K : Nat → Nat)
    (small : (fun n => Real.logb 2 (K n)) =o[atTop] (fun n => (n : ℝ)))
    (positive : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 1 ≤ K n) (C : Nat) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n : Nat in atTop, ∀ B : ℝ,
      (n : ℝ) ≤ B + 2 * (Nat.clog 2 (K n) : ℝ) + C → (1 - ε) * n < B

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.bitWeight_pos

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.sum_log_bitWeight_ge

theorem sum_log_bitWeight_ge {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (bit : X → Bool)

      4 * (Finset.univ.filter fun x => bit x = rare).card ≤ Fintype.card X) :

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.sum_log_le_of_sum_le
statement:
theorem sum_log_le_of_sum_le {X : Type*} [Fintype X] (f : X → ℝ)
    (positive : ∀ x, 0 < f x) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.sum_messageWeight
statement:
@[simp] theorem sum_messageWeight {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.sum_weight_key_le
statement:
theorem sum_weight_key_le {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T]
    (key : X → T) (weight : T → ℝ) (nonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ weight t)
    (mass : ∑ t, weight t = 1) {K : Nat}
    (fibres : ∀ t, (Finset.univ.filter fun x => key x = t).card ≤ K) :
    ∑ x, weight (key x) ≤ K

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.exists_subset_many_pairs
statement:
theorem exists_subset_many_pairs {n a : Nat} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (han : a ≤ n)
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (left right : J → Fin n) (distinct : ∀ j, left j ≠ right j) :
    ∃ U : Finset (Fin n), U.card = a ∧
      (n.choose a) * (Finset.univ.filter fun j => left j ∈ U ∧ right j ∈ U).card ≥
        ((n - 2).choose (a - 2)) * Fintype.card J

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.exists_subset_pair_ratio
statement:
theorem exists_subset_pair_ratio {n a : Nat} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (han : a ≤ n)
    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (left right : J → Fin n) (distinct : ∀ j, left j ≠ right j) :
    ∃ U : Finset (Fin n), U.card = a ∧
      ((a : ℝ) * (a - 1) / ((n : ℝ) * (n - 1))) * Fintype.card J ≤
        (Finset.univ.filter fun j => left j ∈ U ∧ right j ∈ U).card

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.collisionCount_eq_sum_differences
statement:
theorem collisionCount_eq_sum_differences {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [AddGroup X]
    (key : X → T) :
    collisionCount key =
      ∑ d, (Finset.univ.filter fun x => key (x + d) = key x).card

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.collisionCount_le_of_differences
statement:
theorem collisionCount_le_of_differences {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [AddGroup X]
    (key : X → T) {δ : ℕ}
    (differences : ∀ d : X, d ≠ 0 →
      (Finset.univ.filter fun x => key (x + d) = key x).card ≤ δ) :
    collisionCount key ≤ Fintype.card X + δ * (Fintype.card X - 1)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.collisionCount_le_of_refines
statement:
theorem collisionCount_le_of_refines {X T U : Type*} [Fintype X]
    (key : X → T) (coarse : X → U)
    (refines : ∀ x y, key x = key y → coarse x = coarse y) :
    collisionCount key ≤ collisionCount coarse

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.sum_weight_div_fibre_le
statement:
theorem sum_weight_div_fibre_le {X T : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype T]
    (key : X → T) (weight : T → ℝ) (nonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ weight t)
    (mass : ∑ t, weight t = 1) :
    (∑ x, weight (key x) / (Finset.univ.filter fun y => key y = key x).card) ≤ 1

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.WeightBound.log_card_le
statement:
theorem WeightBound.log_card_le {X Y : Type*} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] [Fintype Y]
    {key : X → Y} {cost : ℝ} (bound : WeightBound key cost) {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (fibres : ∀ y, (Finset.univ.filter fun x => key x = y).card ≤ K) :

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.coordinateSplit_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateSplit_fst {I V : Type*} (e : I ↪ V) (x : V → Bool) :

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.pow_card_mul_card_le_of_forces_coordinates

theorem pow_card_mul_card_le_of_forces_coordinates {I V : Type*}

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.Graph.card_support_insert_of_mem_mem
statement:
theorem card_support_insert_of_mem_mem [DecidableEq E]

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.Graph.card_support_insert_of_notMem_mem

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Entropy.Graph.exists_weightBound_tuple_of_local
statement:
theorem exists_weightBound_tuple_of_local
    (seed : ∀ e : SignedEdge V, WeightBound e.eval (Real.binEntropy (1 / 4)))
    (one : ∀ e f : SignedEdge V,
      e.left = f.left ∨ e.left = f.right ∨ e.right = f.left ∨ e.right = f.right →
      ConditionalWeightBound e.eval f.eval (3 / 4 * Real.log 2))
    (two : ∀ e f g : SignedEdge V,
      (e.left = f.left ∨ e.left = f.right) →
      (e.right = g.left ∨ e.right = g.right) →
      ConditionalWeightBound e.eval (fun x => (f.eval x, g.eval x)) edgeCost)
    (edge : E → SignedEdge V) (selected : Finset E) :
    Nonempty (WeightBound (tuple edge selected)
      (selected.card * edgeCost +
        (support (fun e => (edge e).left) (fun e => (edge e).right) selected).card *
          vertexCost))

statement:

    (edge : E → SignedEdge V) (disjoint : Function.Injective (endpoint edge))
    (key : (V → Bool) → (R → Bool)) {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Fiber.Conditional.Internal.card_pi_constraints
Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Fiber.Conditional.Internal.constrained_card
statement:
theorem constrained_card {E V : Type*} [Fintype E] [Fintype V]
    (edge : E → SignedEdge V) (disjoint : Function.Injective (endpoint edge))
    (mask bits : V → Bool) :
    Fintype.card {x : V → Bool // (∀ e, (edge e).eval x = false) ∧
      ∀ v, mask v = true → x v = bits v} =
      (∏ e, Fintype.card {x // PairAllowed (edge e).leftSign (edge e).rightSign
        (fun b => mask (endpoint edge (e, b))) (fun b => bits (endpoint edge (e, b))) x}) *
      (∏ v : {v : V // v ∉ Set.range (endpoint edge)},
        Fintype.card {x : Bool // mask v.val = true → x = bits v.val})

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Fiber.Conditional.Internal.free_count
statement:
theorem free_count (mask bit : Bool) :
    3 ^ (if mask then 1 else 0) *
        Fintype.card {x : Bool // mask = true → x = bit} ≤
      2 ^ (if mask then 1 else 0) * 2

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Fiber.Conditional.Internal.pair_count
statement:
theorem pair_count (a b : Bool) (mask bits : Bool → Bool) :
    3 ^ pairSelected mask * Fintype.card {x // PairAllowed a b mask bits x} ≤
      2 ^ pairSelected mask * 3

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Fiber.Conditional.Internal.selected_count
statement:
theorem selected_count {E V : Type*} [Fintype E] [Fintype V]
    (edge : E → SignedEdge V) (disjoint : Function.Injective (endpoint edge))
    (mask : V → Bool) :
    (∑ e, pairSelected (fun b => mask (endpoint edge (e, b)))) +
      (∑ v : {v : V // v ∉ Set.range (endpoint edge)}, if mask v.val then 1 else 0) =
      ∑ v, if mask v then 1 else 0

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Fiber.card_fiber_le_of_refines_on
statement:
theorem card_fiber_le_of_refines_on {X Y Z : Type*} [Fintype X]
    (event : Finset X) (key : X → Y) (residual : X → Z)
    (refines : ∀ x ∈ event, ∀ y ∈ event, residual x = residual y → key x = key y)
    {K : ℕ} (fibers : ∀ y, (Finset.univ.filter fun x => key x = y).card ≤ K)
    (z : Z) : (event.filter fun x => residual x = z).card ≤ K

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Fiber.card_residual_fiber_le
statement:
theorem card_residual_fiber_le {I V : Type*} [Fintype V]

name: Algebraic.Aggregate.Geometry.Gold.eq_of_radical

name: Algebraic.Aggregate.Geometry.Gold.map_product_eq_zero_of_cube_affine

    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (witness : J → Finset (Fin n))
    (card : ∀ j, (witness j).card = 3) (weight : J → ℝ) :
    ∃ U : Finset (Fin n), U.card = a ∧
      tripleRetention n a * (∑ j, weight j) ≤
        ∑ j, if witness j ⊆ U then weight j else 0

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Aggregate.Geometry.Joint.exists_subset_weighted_witnesses
statement:

    {J : Type*} [Fintype J] (witness : J → Finset (Fin n))
    (card : ∀ j, (witness j).card = d) (weight : J → ℝ) :
    ∃ U : Finset (Fin n), U.card = a ∧
      ((n - d).choose (a - d) : ℝ) * (∑ j, weight j) ≤
        (n.choose a : ℝ) * (∑ j, if witness j ⊆ U then weight j else 0)

theorem exists_cross_of_isChain {L : Set V} :
    ∀ (u : V) (l : List V), (u :: l).IsChain G.DirAdj → u ∈ L →
      (u :: l).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil u l) ∉ L →
        ∃ x ∈ u :: l, ∃ y, x ∈ L ∧ y ∉ L ∧ G.DirAdj x y
  | u, [], _, hu, hv => absurd hu (by simpa using hv)
  | u, w :: l, hc, hu, hv => by
    rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hc
    by_cases hw : w ∈ L
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hxL, hyL, hxy⟩

Algebraic.Cutwidth.Superconcentrator.Internal.exists_lift_isDirWalk
statement:
theorem exists_lift_isDirWalk {r : V} {p : List V} {u v : V} (h : G.IsDirWalk p u v)

      (split G (compEdges G r)).IsDirWalk q ⟨u, ⟨0, hu⟩⟩
          ⟨v, ⟨slots G (compEdges G r) v - 1, Nat.sub_lt hv one_pos⟩⟩ ∧

statement:
theorem exists_lift_walks {ι κ : Type*} {r : V} {input : ι → V} {output : κ → V}
    (hr : ∀ i, ReflTransGen G.Adj (input i) r)
    (hin : ∀ i, 0 < slots G (compEdges G r) (input i))
    (hout : ∀ j, 0 < slots G (compEdges G r) (output j)) {X : Finset ι} {target : ι → κ}
    {walk : ι → List V}
    (hwalk : ∀ i ∈ X, G.IsDirWalk (walk i) (input i) (output (target i)))
    (hdisj : ∀ i ∈ X, ∀ j ∈ X, i ≠ j → (walk i).Disjoint (walk j)) :
    ∃ walk' : ι → List (SplitVertex G (compEdges G r)),
      (∀ i ∈ X, (split G (compEdges G r)).IsDirWalk (walk' i) ⟨input i, ⟨0, hin i⟩⟩
          ⟨output (target i), ⟨slots G (compEdges G r) (output (target i)) - 1,
            Nat.sub_lt (hout (target i)) one_pos⟩⟩) ∧
        ∀ i ∈ X, ∀ j ∈ X, i ≠ j → (walk' i).Disjoint (walk' j)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Superconcentrator.Internal.reflTransGen_lift
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_lift {r : V} (P : Set V) :
    ∀ (u : V) (l : List V), (u :: l).IsChain G.DirAdj → ReflTransGen G.Adj u r →
      (∀ z ∈ u :: l, z ∈ P) → ∀ x y : SplitVertex G (compEdges G r), x.1 = u →
        (x.2 : ℕ) ≤ (inEdges G (compEdges G r) u).card →
          y.1 = (u :: l).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil u l) →
            (y.2 : ℕ) + 1 = slots G (compEdges G r) y.1 → ReflTransGen (stepIn P) x y
  | u, [], _, _, hP, x, y, hx, _, hy, hlast => by
    have hxy : x.1 = y.1 := hx.trans (by simpa using hy.symm)
    have hs : slots G (compEdges G r) x.1 = slots G (compEdges G r) y.1 := by rw [hxy]
    have := x.2.isLt
    exact reflTransGen_forward P hxy (hx ▸ hP u List.mem_cons_self) (by omega)
  | u, w :: l, hc, hu, hP, x, y, hx, hxk, hy, hlast => by
    rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hc
    obtain ⟨⟨e, he₁, he₂⟩, hc⟩

    (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (C : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ Q : ℝ, 0 ≤ Q →
      (N : ℝ) ≤ (A + A ^ 2 * ε / 2) * max (Q - D * N) 0 + 3 * Real.logb 2 (B * Q) + C →

    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ h base Q : ℝ, 0 ≤ h → h ≤ n → base ≤ D * n → base - 1 ≤ Q →
      0 ≤ Q → h ≤ (A + A ^ 2 * ε / 2) * max (Q - base) 0 + 3 * Real.logb 2 (B * Q) + C →
        base + h / A - ε * n ≤ Q

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Concentrator.Internal.exists_dirAdj_of_mem_tail
statement:
theorem exists_dirAdj_of_mem_tail :
    ∀ {u : V} {l : List V}, (u :: l).IsChain G.DirAdj → ∀ z ∈ l, ∃ y, G.DirAdj y z
  | _, [], _, z, hz => by simp at hz
  | u, w :: l, hc, z, hz => by
    rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hc
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hz with rfl | hz
    · exact ⟨u, hc.1⟩
    · exact exists_dirAdj_of_mem_tail hc.2 z hz

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Concentrator.Internal.exists_eliminate
statement:
theorem exists_eliminate {m : ℕ} {output : Fin m → V} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) {E : Type} [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E) {n : ℕ} (input : Fin (n + 1) → V),
      Fintype.card E ≤ k → G.Concentrator input output → G.Acyclic →
        (∀ i, G.inDegree (input i) = 0) → m ≤ n →
          ∃ (E' : Type) (_ : Fintype E') (G' : Multigraph V E') (input' : Fin n → V),
            G'.Concentrator input' output ∧ G'.Acyclic ∧ (∀ i, G'.inDegree (input' i) = 0) ∧
              Fintype.card E' + 2 ≤ Fintype.card E

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Concentrator.Internal.exists_eliminate_iter
statement:
theorem exists_eliminate_iter {m : ℕ} {output : Fin m → V} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ) {E : Type} [Fintype E] (G : Multigraph V E) {n : ℕ} (input : Fin n → V),
      m + j ≤ n → G.Concentrator input output → G.Acyclic →
        (∀ i, G.inDegree (input i) = 0) →
          ∃ (n' : ℕ) (E' : Type) (_ : Fintype E') (G' : Multigraph V E') (input' : Fin n' → V),
            n' + j = n ∧ G'.Concentrator input' output ∧ G'.Acyclic ∧
              (∀ i, G'.inDegree (input' i) = 0) ∧ Fintype.card E' + 2 * j ≤ Fintype.card E

theorem exists_primitive_polynomialFamily {F X : Type*} [Field F] {A K : Nat}
    (E : Polynomial F) (monic : E.Monic) (positive : 0 < E.natDegree)
    (T : Finset X) (seed : X → F) (weight : X → Fin K → F)
    (nonvanishing : ∀ x ∈ T, E.eval (seed x) ≠ 0)
    (p : Fin K → Polynomial F) (nonzero : p ≠ 0)
    (degree : ∀ j, (p j).degree < A)
    (vanish : ∀ x ∈ T, ∑ j, (p j).eval (seed x) * weight x j = 0) :
    ∃ q : Fin K → Polynomial F, q ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ j, (q j).degree < A) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ T, ∑ j, (q j).eval (seed x) * weight x j = 0) ∧
      ∃ j, ¬ E ∣ q j

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.card_test_sub_le_disagreement
statement:
theorem card_test_sub_le_disagreement {α β : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (f g : α → β) (T : Finset β) :
    |(((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun x => f x ∈ T).card : ℝ) -
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun x => g x ∈ T).card : ℝ)| ≤
        ((Finset.univ.filter fun x => f x ≠ g x).card : ℝ)

    ∃ g : α ↪ β, ∀ b ∈ Set.range f, ∃ x, f x = b ∧ g x = b

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.exists_seedwise_injection

theorem exists_seedwise_injection {α Seed Ω : Type*} [Fintype Seed] [Fintype Ω]
    (C : α → Seed → Ω) (P : Finset α) (capacity : P.card ≤ Fintype.card Ω) :
    ∃ g : Seed → (P ↪ Ω),
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (P × Seed)).filter
        fun xy => C xy.1.val xy.2 = g xy.2 xy.1).card = (seededNeighborSet C P).card

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.abs_mixture_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_mixture_sub_le {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w p q : ι → ℝ)
    (nonnegative : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (mass : ∑ i, w i = 1) {ε : ℝ}
    (close : ∀ i, |p i - q i| ≤ ε) :
    |(∑ i, w i * p i) - ∑ i, w i * q i| ≤ ε

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.exists_flat_mixture_of_exact_size
statement:
theorem exists_flat_mixture_of_exact_size {α Seed Ω : Type*} [Fintype Seed]
    (C : α → Seed → Ω) (P : Finset α) {K : Nat}
    (positive : 0 < K) (size : K ≤ P.card) {ε : ℝ}
    (lossless : ∀ S : Finset α, S ⊆ P → S.card = K →
      ∃ g : Seed → (S ↪ Ω), ∀ T : Finset (Seed × Ω),
        |seededTestProb (fun x : S => C x.val) T -
          seededTestProb (fun x y => g y x) T| ≤ ε) :
    ∃ g : ∀ S : P.powersetCard K, Seed → (S.val ↪ Ω),
      ∀ T : Finset (Seed × Ω),
        |seededTestProb (fun x : P => C x.val) T -
          seededMixtureTestProb (fun _ : P.powersetCard K =>
            ((P.powersetCard K).card : ℝ)⁻¹)
            (fun S x y => g S y x) T| ≤ ε

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.powersetCard_average
statement:
theorem powersetCard_average {α : Type*} (P : Finset α) {K : Nat}
    (positive : 0 < K) (size : K ≤ P.card) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (∑ S ∈ P.powersetCard K, (∑ x ∈ S, f x) / (K : ℝ)) /
      (P.powersetCard K).card = (∑ x ∈ P, f x) / (P.card : ℝ)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.seededMixtureTestProb_sub_le
statement:
theorem seededMixtureTestProb_sub_le {ι Seed Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype Seed]
    {Source Target : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (Source i)] [∀ i, Fintype (Target i)]
    (w : ι → ℝ) (C : ∀ i, Source i → Seed → Ω) (G : ∀ i, Target i → Seed → Ω)
    (nonnegative : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (mass : ∑ i, w i = 1) {ε : ℝ}
    (close : ∀ i, ∀ T : Finset (Seed × Ω),
      |seededTestProb (C i) T - seededTestProb (G i) T| ≤ ε) :
    ∀ T : Finset (Seed × Ω),
      |seededMixtureTestProb w C T - seededMixtureTestProb w G T| ≤ ε

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.seededTestProb_eq_sum
statement:
theorem seededTestProb_eq_sum {α Seed Ω : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype Seed]
    (C : α → Seed → Ω) (T : Finset (Seed × Ω)) :
    seededTestProb C T =
      (∑ x, ((Finset.univ.filter fun y => (y, C x y) ∈ T).card : ℝ)) /
        ((Fintype.card α : ℝ) * Fintype.card Seed)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.seededTestProb_eq_uniformMixture
statement:
theorem seededTestProb_eq_uniformMixture {α Seed Ω : Type*} [Fintype Seed]
    (C : α → Seed → Ω) (P : Finset α) {K : Nat}
    (positive : 0 < K) (size : K ≤ P.card) (T : Finset (Seed × Ω)) :
    seededTestProb (fun x : P => C x.val) T =
      seededMixtureTestProb (fun _ : P.powersetCard K =>
        ((P.powersetCard K).card : ℝ)⁻¹)
        (fun (S : P.powersetCard K) (x : S.val) => C x.val) T

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.seededTestProb_powersetCard
statement:
theorem seededTestProb_powersetCard {α Seed Ω : Type*} [Fintype Seed]
    (C : α → Seed → Ω) (P : Finset α) {K : Nat}
    (positive : 0 < K) (size : K ≤ P.card) (T : Finset (Seed × Ω)) :
    seededTestProb (fun x : P => C x.val) T =
      (∑ S : P.powersetCard K, seededTestProb (fun x : S.val => C x.val) T) /
        (P.powersetCard K).card

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.seededTestProb_support_eq_sum
statement:
theorem seededTestProb_support_eq_sum {α Seed Ω : Type*} [Fintype Seed]
    (C : α → Seed → Ω) (P : Finset α) (T : Finset (Seed × Ω)) :
    seededTestProb (fun x : P => C x.val) T =
      (∑ x ∈ P, ((Finset.univ.filter fun y => (y, C x y) ∈ T).card : ℝ)) /

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.sum_powersetCard_sum
statement:
theorem sum_powersetCard_sum {α M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (P : Finset α) {K : Nat} (positive : 0 < K) (f : α → M) :
    ∑ S ∈ P.powersetCard K, ∑ x ∈ S, f x =
      (P.card - 1).choose (K - 1) • ∑ x ∈ P, f x

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.exists_flat_mixture_of_exact_size
statement:
theorem exists_flat_mixture_of_exact_size {α Seed Ω : Type*} [Fintype Seed]
    (C : α → Seed → Ω) (P : Finset α) {K : Nat}
    (positive : 0 < K) (size : K ≤ P.card) {ε : ℝ}
    (lossless : ∀ S : Finset α, S ⊆ P → S.card = K →
      ∃ g : Seed → (S ↪ Ω), ∀ T : Finset (Seed × Ω),
        |seededTestProb (fun x : S => C x.val) T -
          seededTestProb (fun x y => g y x) T| ≤ ε) :
    ∃ g : ∀ S : P.powersetCard K, Seed → (S.val ↪ Ω),
      ∀ T : Finset (Seed × Ω),
        |seededTestProb (fun x : P => C x.val) T -
          seededMixtureTestProb (fun _ : P.powersetCard K =>
            ((P.powersetCard K).card : ℝ)⁻¹)
            (fun S x y => g S y x) T| ≤ ε

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.powersetCard_average
statement:
theorem powersetCard_average {α : Type*} (P : Finset α) {K : Nat}
    (positive : 0 < K) (size : K ≤ P.card) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (∑ S ∈ P.powersetCard K, (∑ x ∈ S, f x) / (K : ℝ)) /
      (P.powersetCard K).card = (∑ x ∈ P, f x) / (P.card : ℝ)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.seededMixtureTestProb_sub_le
statement:
theorem seededMixtureTestProb_sub_le {ι Seed Ω : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype Seed]
    {Source Target : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (Source i)] [∀ i, Fintype (Target i)]
    (w : ι → ℝ) (C : ∀ i, Source i → Seed → Ω) (G : ∀ i, Target i → Seed → Ω)
    (nonnegative : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (mass : ∑ i, w i = 1) {ε : ℝ}
    (close : ∀ i, ∀ T : Finset (Seed × Ω),
      |seededTestProb (C i) T - seededTestProb (G i) T| ≤ ε) :
    ∀ T : Finset (Seed × Ω),
      |seededMixtureTestProb w C T - seededMixtureTestProb w G T| ≤ ε

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.seededTestProb_powersetCard
statement:
theorem seededTestProb_powersetCard {α Seed Ω : Type*} [Fintype Seed]
    (C : α → Seed → Ω) (P : Finset α) {K : Nat}
    (positive : 0 < K) (size : K ≤ P.card) (T : Finset (Seed × Ω)) :
    seededTestProb (fun x : P => C x.val) T =
      (∑ S : P.powersetCard K, seededTestProb (fun x : S.val => C x.val) T) /
        (P.powersetCard K).card

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.hashFiberCount_sq_sum
statement:
theorem hashFiberCount_sq_sum {α Seed Ω : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype Seed]
    [Fintype Ω] (E : α → Seed → Ω) :
    ∑ z, hashFiberCount E z ^ 2 =
      ∑ x, ∑ x', ((Finset.univ.filter fun y => E x y = E x' y).card : ℝ)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.hashFiberCount_sq_sum_output
statement:
theorem hashFiberCount_sq_sum_output {α Seed Ω : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype Ω]
    (E : α → Seed → Ω) (y : Seed) :
    ∑ o, hashFiberCount E (y, o) ^ 2 =

    ∑ z ∈ T, hashFiberCount E z =

theorem signSum_negative_tail_of_parityBias {α : Type*} {m : Nat} {s : Finset α}
    {w : α → ℝ} {σ : α → Fin m → ℝ} {δ : ℝ}
    (hw : ∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ w a) (hmass : ∑ a ∈ s, w a = 1) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hσ : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ i, σ a i = 1 ∨ σ a i = -1)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hbudget : 100 * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ ≤ 1)

name: Nat.fromBits_toBits_mod
statement:
theorem Nat.fromBits_toBits_mod : ∀ (w val : ℕ),
    Nat.fromBits (Nat.toBits w val) = val % 2 ^ w
  | 0, val => by simp [Nat.toBits, Nat.fromBits, Nat.mod_one]
  | w + 1, val => by
    have ih

name: Nat.length_toBits
statement:
theorem Nat.length_toBits : ∀ (w val : ℕ), (Nat.toBits w val).length = w
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | w + 1, val => by simp [Nat.toBits, Nat.length_toBits w]

name: Nat.length_toBitsLE
statement:

name: Nat.size_eq_log_two_add_one

name: Nat.size_le_log_two_add_one

theorem Nat.size_le_log_two_add_one (value : ℕ) :

name: Nat.toBitsLE_fromBitsLE
statement:
theorem Nat.toBitsLE_fromBitsLE (bits : List Bool) :
    Nat.toBitsLE bits.length (Nat.fromBitsLE bits) = bits

name: Nat.toBitsLE_size
statement:
theorem Nat.toBitsLE_size (value : ℕ) :

name: Nat.toBits_add_pow_mul
statement:
theorem Nat.toBits_add_pow_mul : ∀ (w val c : ℕ),
    Nat.toBits w (val + c * 2 ^ w) = Nat.toBits w val
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | w + 1, val, c => by
    have hrw : val + c * 2 ^ (w + 1) = val + c * 2 * 2 ^ w

name: Nat.toBits_fromBits
statement:
theorem Nat.toBits_fromBits : ∀ bits : List Bool,
    Nat.toBits bits.length (Nat.fromBits bits) = bits
  | [] => rfl
  | bit :: rest => by
    have hlt

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.parityBiasBound_of_seed_escape
statement:
theorem parityBiasBound_of_seed_escape {α Choice Seed : Type*} [Fintype Choice]
    {m N : Nat} {s : Finset α} {w : α → ℝ} {σ : α → Fin N → ℝ} {β : ℝ}
    (S : Fin N → Choice → Seed) (bad : Finset (Fin N) → Choice → Finset Seed)
    (good : Fin m ↪ Fin N)
    (escape : ∀ i, ∃ z, S (good i) z ∉ parityBadSeeds bad 4)
    (estimate : ∀ U ∈ parityTests (Fin N) 4, ∃ j ∈ U, ∀ z,
      S j z ∉ bad U z → |weightedMean s w (fun x => ∏ i ∈ U, σ x i)| ≤ β) :
    ParityBiasBound s w (fun x i => σ x (good i)) β

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.somewhereSampler_exists_good_fibers
statement:
theorem somewhereSampler_exists_good_fibers {α Outer Candidate Ω : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [Fintype Outer] [Fintype Ω]
    {S : α → Outer → Candidate → Ω} {L ε δ : ℝ}
    (sampler : SomewhereSampler S L ε δ) (Q : Finset α)
    (positive : 0 < Q.card) (source : L ≤ Q.card)
    (T : Finset Ω) (small : (T.card : ℝ) ≤ ε * Fintype.card Ω) :
    ∃ G ⊆ Q, (1 - δ) * Q.card ≤ G.card ∧
      ∀ y ∈ G, ((allHitSeeds S T y).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ε * Fintype.card Outer

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.somewhereSampler_parity_fibers
statement:
theorem somewhereSampler_parity_fibers {α Source Choice Seed : Type*}
    [Fintype Source] [Fintype Choice] [Fintype Seed] {N : Nat}
    {s : Finset α} {w : α → ℝ} (σ : α → Source → Fin N → ℝ)
    {S : Source → Fin N → Choice → Seed} {L ε δ β η : ℝ}
    (sampler : SomewhereSampler S L ε δ) (Q : Finset Source)
    (positive : 0 < Q.card) (source : L ≤ Q.card)
    (bad : Finset (Fin N) → Choice → Finset Seed) (nonneg : 0 ≤ η)
    (seedBound : ∀ U ∈ parityTests (Fin N) 4, ∀ z,
      ((bad U z).card : ℝ) ≤ η * Fintype.card Seed)
    (budget : (N : ℝ) ^ 4 * Fintype.card Choice * η ≤ ε)
    (estimate : ∀ U ∈ parityTests (Fin N) 4, ∃ j ∈ U, ∀ z, ∀ y ∈ Q,
      S y j z ∉ bad U z →
        |weightedMean s w (fun x => ∏ i ∈ U, σ x y i)| ≤ β) :
    ∃ G ⊆ Q, (1 - δ) * Q.card ≤ G.card ∧
      ∀ y ∈ G, ∃ (m : Nat) (good : Fin m ↪ Fin N),
        ((N - m : Nat) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ε * N ∧
        ParityBiasBound s w (fun x i => σ x y (good i)) β

    (h : Ω) (z : Fin t → Ω) :
    mapWeight (fun az : (Ω × α) × (Fin t → Ω) =>
      (Fin.cons az.1.1 az.2 : Fin (t + 1) → Ω))
      (fun az => c az.1 * tail az.1.2 az.2) (Fin.cons h z) =

    mapWeight (fun az : (Ω × α) × (Fin t → Ω) =>
      (Fin.cons az.1.1 az.2 : Fin (t + 1) → Ω))
      (fun az => mapWeight (fun a => (f a, a)) w az.1 * tail az.1.2 az.2) =
      mapWeight (fun az : α × (Fin t → Ω) =>
        (Fin.cons (f az.1) az.2 : Fin (t + 1) → Ω))
        (fun az => w az.1 * tail az.1 az.2)

theorem factoredWeight_observe_left {Z A B U : Type*}
    [Fintype Z] [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (w : Z → ℝ) (l : Z → A → ℝ) (r : Z → B → ℝ) (f : Z → A → U)
    (nonnegative : ∀ z a, 0 ≤ l z a) :
    mapWeight (fun p : (Z × B) × A => (((p.1.1, f p.1.1 p.2), p.1.2), p.2))
      (factoredWeight w l r) =
      factoredWeight (observedTranscriptWeight w l f) (observedTranscriptKernel l f)
        (fun zu => r zu.1)

statement:

    (f : Z → A → U) (g : Z × U → B → V)
    (left_nonnegative : ∀ z a, 0 ≤ l z a) (right_nonnegative : ∀ z b, 0 ≤ r z b) :
    mapWeight (fun p : (Z × B) × A =>
      ((((p.1.1, f p.1.1 p.2), g (p.1.1, f p.1.1 p.2) p.1.2), p.1.2), p.2))
      (factoredWeight w l r) =
      factoredWeight
        (observedTranscriptWeight (observedTranscriptWeight w l f) (fun zu => r zu.1) g)
        (fun zuv => observedTranscriptKernel l f zuv.1)
        (observedTranscriptKernel (fun zu => r zu.1) g)

      (factoredWeight w l r) =

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.observedTranscriptKernel_eq_uniform

    (zero : mapWeight (f zu.1) (p zu.1) zu.2 = 0) :

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Extractor.Internal.observedTranscriptKernel_factor
statement:
theorem observedTranscriptKernel_factor {Z A U : Type*} [Fintype A]
    (p : Z → A → ℝ) (f : Z → A → U)
    (nonnegative : ∀ z a, 0 ≤ p z a) (zu : Z × U) (a : A) :
    mapWeight (f zu.1) (p zu.1) zu.2 * observedTranscriptKernel p f zu a =
      if f zu.1 a = zu.2 then p zu.1 a else 0

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.crossing_const_eq
statement:
theorem crossing_const_eq {r s : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hs : 0 < s) :
    (√(2 * Real.pi * s))⁻¹ * (2 * √(2 * r / Real.pi)) = 2 / Real.pi * (√r / √s)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.form_eq_inner
statement:
theorem form_eq_inner (a ω : ι → ℝ) :
    form a ω = innerSL ℝ (toLp 2 a : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (toLp 2 ω)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.gaussPi_between_le
statement:
theorem gaussPi_between_le (α β : ι → ℝ)
    (hnorm : ∑ i, α i ^ 2 = ∑ i, β i ^ 2) (hsum : 0 < ∑ i, (α i + β i) ^ 2) (t : ℝ) :
    (gaussPi ι).real {ω | Between t (form α ω) (form β ω)} ≤
      2 / Real.pi * (Real.sqrt (∑ i, (β i - α i) ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (∑ i, (α i + β i) ^ 2))

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.gaussPi_map_form
statement:
theorem gaussPi_map_form (a : ι → ℝ) :
    (gaussPi ι).map (form a) = gaussianReal 0 (∑ i, a i ^ 2).toNNReal

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.gaussPi_map_form_pair
statement:
theorem gaussPi_map_form_pair (a b : ι → ℝ) (hab : ∑ i, a i * b i = 0) :
    (gaussPi ι).map (fun ω => (form a ω, form b ω)) =
      (gaussianReal 0 (∑ i, a i ^ 2).toNNReal).prod
        (gaussianReal 0 (∑ i, b i ^ 2).toNNReal)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.gaussPi_tail_le
statement:
theorem gaussPi_tail_le (α : ι → ℝ) (hα : ∑ i, α i ^ 2 = 1)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (gaussPi ι).real {ω | T ≤ |form α ω|} ≤ 1 / T ^ 2

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.gaussPi_window_le
statement:
theorem gaussPi_window_le (α : ι → ℝ) (hα : ∑ i, α i ^ 2 = 1)
    (s : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (gaussPi ι).real {ω | s ≤ form α ω ∧ form α ω < s + δ} ≤ δ / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.card_ball_le

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.card_filter_neighborFinset_le
Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.card_sphere_le
statement:
theorem card_sphere_le (degree : ∀ v, H.degree v ≤ 3) (v : W) :
    ∀ d : ℕ, (sphere H v d).card ≤ 3 * 2 ^ d
  | 0 => by rw [sphere_zero]; simp
  | d + 1 => (card_sphere_succ_le H degree v d).trans (by rw [pow_succ]; omega)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.card_sphere_one_le
statement:
theorem card_sphere_one_le (degree : ∀ v, H.degree v ≤ 3) (v : W) :
    (sphere H v 1).card ≤ 3

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.card_sphere_succ_le
statement:
theorem card_sphere_succ_le (degree : ∀ v, H.degree v ≤ 3) (v : W) :
    ∀ d : ℕ, (sphere H v (d + 1)).card ≤ 3 * 2 ^ d
  | 0 => by simpa using card_sphere_one_le H degree v
  | d + 1 => by
    have h

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.card_sphere_succ_succ_le
statement:
theorem card_sphere_succ_succ_le (degree : ∀ v, H.degree v ≤ 3) (v : W) (d : ℕ) :
    (sphere H v (d + 1 + 1)).card ≤ 2 * (sphere H v (d + 1)).card

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.edist_eq_dist_of_le

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.edist_le_edist_add_one
statement:

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.exists_adj_edist_eq

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.kappa_le_one
statement: theorem kappa_le_one (q : ℝ) : 2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) ≤ 1

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.kappa_mul_sq_add_sq
statement:
theorem kappa_mul_sq_add_sq (q x : ℝ) :
    2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) * (x ^ 2 + (x * q) ^ 2) / 2 = x * (x * q)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.kernel_comm
statement: theorem kernel_comm (q : ℝ) (R : ℕ) (v z : W) : kernel H q R v z = kernel H q R z v

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.kernel_defect_le
statement:
theorem kernel_defect_le {q : ℝ} (R : ℕ) {u v : W} (huv : H.Adj u v) (z : W) :
    2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) * (kernel H q R u z ^ 2 + kernel H q R v z ^ 2) / 2 -
        kernel H q R u z * kernel H q R v z ≤
      (q ^ 2) ^ R / 2 *
        ((if H.edist u z = R then 1 else 0) + (if H.edist v z = R then 1 else 0))

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.sum_kernel_mul_ge
statement:
theorem sum_kernel_mul_ge (degree : ∀ v, H.degree v ≤ 3) (q : ℝ) (R : ℕ) {u v : W}
    (huv : H.Adj u v) :
    2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) * ((∑ z, kernel H q R u z ^ 2) + ∑ z, kernel H q R v z ^ 2) / 2 -

theorem exists_indicator_eq_comp {S : Finset ι} {A : Set (Π i, Ω i)} (hA : MeasurableSet A)
    (hdep : ∀ ω ω' : Π i, Ω i, (∀ i ∈ S, ω i = ω' i) → (ω ∈ A ↔ ω' ∈ A))
    (ω₀ : Π i, Ω i) :
    ∃ g : (Π i : S, Ω i) → ℝ, Measurable g ∧
      A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) = g ∘ fun ω (i : S) => ω i

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Gaussian.Internal.indepFun_indicator_of_disjoint

    (hdepA : ∀ ω ω' : Π i, Ω i, (∀ i ∈ S, ω i = ω' i) → (ω ∈ A ↔ ω' ∈ A))
    (hdepB : ∀ ω ω' : Π i, Ω i, (∀ i ∈ T, ω i = ω' i) → (ω ∈ B ↔ ω' ∈ B))
    (hST : Disjoint S T) :
    IndepFun (A.indicator fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (B.indicator fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (Measure.pi μ)

      ∃ e ∈ H.edgeFinset, v ∈ e ∧ t ≤ score e).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * ((H.edgeFinset.filter fun e => b ≤ score e).card : ℝ)

      ∃ e ∈ H.edgeFinset, v ∈ e ∧ t ≤ score e).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * ((H.edgeFinset.filter fun e => score e < a).card : ℝ)

    (hge : t ≤ p ∨ t ≤ q ∨ t ≤ r) :
    (4 : ℝ) ≤ ((if Between t p q then 1 else 0) + (if Between t p r then 1 else 0)) +
      (((if Between t q p then 1 else 0) + (if Between t q r then 1 else 0)) +
        ((if Between t r p then 1 else 0) + (if Between t r q then 1 else 0)))

    (hα : ∑ i, α i ^ 2 = 1) (hβ : ∑ i, β i ^ 2 = 1) (hx : -1 < ∑ i, α i * β i) (t : ℝ) :
    (gaussPi ι).real {ω | Between t (form α ω) (form β ω)} ≤
      arccos (∑ i, α i * β i) / π

    (gaussPi ι).real {ω | Between t (form α ω) (form β ω)} ≤
      2 / π * arctan (√(∑ i, (β i - α i) ^ 2) / √(∑ i, (α i + β i) ^ 2))

statement:
theorem card_cutFinset_eq_sum_indicator (q : ℝ) (R : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ω : W → ℝ)
    [Fintype H.edgeSet] :
    ((H.cutFinset (Finset.univ.filter fun v => score H q R ω v < t)).card : ℝ) =
      ∑ e ∈ H.edgeFinset, (crossEvent H q R t e).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ω

      ∑ v, (scoreEvent H q R p v).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ω

    {a δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (M : ℕ) {B : ℝ}
    (low : 3 * ((Finset.univ.filter fun v => X v < a).card : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (high : 3 * ((Finset.univ.filter fun v => a + M * δ ≤ X v).card : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (mid : ∀ i < M,
      ((H.cutFinset (Finset.univ.filter fun v => X v < a + i * δ)).card : ℝ) +
        3 * ((Finset.univ.filter fun v => a + i * δ ≤ X v ∧ X v < a + (i + 1) * δ).card : ℝ)
        ≤ B)

theorem exists_band_parameters {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    ∃ (q : ℝ) (R : ℕ) (ρ₀ T ε η : ℝ) (M : ℕ), 0 ≤ q ∧ 17 / 32 ≤ ρ₀ ∧
      ρ₀ ≤ 2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) - 3 * (2 * q ^ 2) ^ R ∧ c < T ∧ 0 < ε ∧ 0 < η ∧ 0 < M ∧
      bandLayoutBound ρ₀ c T ε η M + ε ≤ Real.exp (-(c ^ 2) / 2) * frontierCoefficient + ξ

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.apply_comp

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.apply_of_ne

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.crossing_sub_crossing_le
statement:
theorem crossing_sub_crossing_le (x x' : Fin n → Bool) (L : Finset (WireVertex n s))

    crossing N x L e - crossing N x' L e ≤
      if N.wireGraph.fst e ∈ L ↔ N.wireGraph.snd e ∈ L then 0 else 1

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.eventually_le_size_of_orderingBound
statement:
theorem eventually_le_size_of_orderingBound {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A)
    (hord : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ C : ℝ, OrderingBound A η C) {ε δ : ℝ} (hε₀ : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hε : ε < 1 / 2) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (s : ℕ) (N : ComparatorNetwork n s), N.IsHalver ε →
      (1 + (1 - 2 * ε) / (2 * A) - δ) * n ≤ s

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.exists_le_card_cut
statement:
theorem exists_le_card_cut {ε : ℝ} (hN : N.IsHalver ε) [LinearOrder (WireVertex n s)] :
    ∃ L : Finset (WireVertex n s), IsLowerSet (L : Set (WireVertex n s)) ∧
      (1 - 2 * ε) * ((n / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (N.wireGraph.cut L).card

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.exists_touch_of_segTime_lt
statement:
theorem exists_touch_of_segTime_lt {e : WireEdge n s} (he : IsSegment e) (ht : segTime e < s) :
    ∃ c : Fin s, (c : ℕ) = segTime e ∧
      (N.minWire c = segWire N e ∨ N.maxWire c = segWire N e)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.lastStop_eq
statement:
theorem lastStop_eq (w : Fin n) (t : ℕ) :
    N.lastStop w t = if h : (touchSet N w t).Nonempty then
      .gate ((touchSet N w t).max' h) (decide (N.maxWire ((touchSet N w t).max' h) = w))
    else .input w

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.lastStop_succ_of_not_touch
statement:
theorem lastStop_succ_of_not_touch {w : Fin n} (c : Fin s) (h₁ : N.minWire c ≠ w)
    (h₂ : N.maxWire c ≠ w) : N.lastStop w (c + 1) = N.lastStop w c

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.lastStop_succ_of_touch
statement:
theorem lastStop_succ_of_touch {w : Fin n} (c : Fin s) (hw : N.minWire c = w ∨ N.maxWire c = w) :
    N.lastStop w (c + 1) = .gate c (decide (N.maxWire c = w))

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.lastStop_zero
statement: theorem lastStop_zero (w : Fin n) : N.lastStop w 0 = .input w

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.le_add_one
statement: theorem le_add_one {ε : ℝ} (hN : N.IsHalver ε) (hε : ε < 1 / 2) : n ≤ s + 1

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.le_of_orderingBound
statement:
theorem le_of_orderingBound {A η C ε : ℝ} (hord : OrderingBound A η C) (hN : N.IsHalver ε)
    (hε : ε < 1 / 2) :
    (1 - 2 * ε) * ((n / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (A + η) * max ((s : ℝ) - n) 0 + 3 * Real.logb 2 (2 * n + 2 * s) + C

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.le_rank_lastStop
statement:
theorem le_rank_lastStop {w : Fin n} {t : ℕ} {c : Fin s} (hc : (c : ℕ) < t)
    (hw : N.minWire c = w ∨ N.maxWire c = w) : (c : ℕ) + 1 ≤ rank (N.lastStop w t)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.mem_touchSet
statement:
theorem mem_touchSet {w : Fin n} {t : ℕ} {c : Fin s} :
    c ∈ touchSet N w t ↔ (c : ℕ) < t ∧ (N.minWire c = w ∨ N.maxWire c = w)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.potential_sub_potential_succ
statement:
theorem potential_sub_potential_succ (x : Fin n → Bool) (L : Finset (WireVertex n s))
    (c : Fin s) :
    potential N x L c - potential N x L (c + 1) =
      crossing N x L (.into c false) + crossing N x L (.into c true) +
        crossing N x L (.link c)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.rank_lastStop_le
statement: theorem rank_lastStop_le (w : Fin n) (t : ℕ) : rank (N.lastStop w t) ≤ t

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.state_succ
statement:

    N.state x (c + 1) = N.apply c (N.state x c)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.sub_le_card_cut
statement:
theorem sub_le_card_cut (x x' : Fin n → Bool) (L : Finset (WireVertex n s)) :
    (((Finset.univ.filter fun w => .input w ∈ L ∧ x w = true).card : ℤ) -
        (Finset.univ.filter fun w => .output w ∈ L ∧ N.eval x w = true).card) -
      (((Finset.univ.filter fun w => .input w ∈ L ∧ x' w = true).card : ℤ) -
        (Finset.univ.filter fun w => .output w ∈ L ∧ N.eval x' w = true).card) ≤
      (N.wireGraph.cut L).card

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.sum_crossing
statement:
theorem sum_crossing (x : Fin n → Bool) (L : Finset (WireVertex n s)) :
    ∑ e, crossing N x L e =
      ∑ w, ind L (.input w) * (x w).toNat - ∑ w, ind L (.output w) * (N.eval x w).toNat

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Halver.Internal.sum_ind_mul_toNat
statement:
theorem sum_ind_mul_toNat (L : Finset (WireVertex n s)) (P : Fin n → WireVertex n s)
    (y : Fin n → Bool) :
    ∑ w, ind L (P w) * (y w).toNat =
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun w => P w ∈ L ∧ y w = true).card : ℤ)

statement:
theorem split_hyperconcentrator (h : G.Hyperconcentrator input output) {r : V}
    (hr : ∀ i, ReflTransGen G.Adj (input i) r)
    (hin : ∀ i, 0 < slots G (compEdges G r) (input i))
    (hout : ∀ j, 0 < slots G (compEdges G r) (output j)) :
    (split G (compEdges G r)).Hyperconcentrator (fun i => ⟨input i, ⟨0, hin i⟩⟩)

        Nat.sub_lt (hout j) one_pos⟩⟩) where
  input_injective _ _ hij

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.PathDecomposition.Internal.exists_boundaryTransition
statement:
theorem exists_boundaryTransition
    (left : ∀ u ∈ S, ∃ v ∉ S, H.Adj u v)
    (right : ∀ v ∉ S, ∃ u ∈ S, H.Adj u v) :
    ∃ (D : PathDecomposition H) (first last : Fin D.length),
      (∀ i, first ≤ i ∧ i ≤ last) ∧ D.bag first = S ∧ D.bag last = Sᶜ ∧
        ∀ i, (D.bag i).card ≤ (H.cutFinset S).card + 1

    (right : ∀ v ∉ S, ∃ u ∈ S, H.Adj u v) :
    ∃ (D : PathDecomposition H) (first last : Fin D.length),
      (∀ i, first ≤ i ∧ i ≤ last) ∧ D.bag first = S ∧ D.bag last = Sᶜ ∧
        ∀ i, (D.bag i).card ≤ (H.cutFinset S).card + 1

theorem exists_helpful_set_of_margin {W : Type} [Fintype W] (H : SimpleGraph W)
    (S : Finset W) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (M k : Nat)
    (margin : a * S.card + k < (H.cutFinset S).card)
    (find : ∀ T ⊆ S, a * T.card < (H.cutFinset T).card →
      ∃ X ⊆ T, X.card ≤ M ∧ 1 ≤ helpfulness H T X) :
    ∃ X ⊆ S, X.card ≤ k * M ∧ (k : ℤ) ≤ helpfulness H S X

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Bisection.Internal.card_boundary_interior_neighbors

    {c : W} (hc : c ∈ cutBoundary H S) :
    (H.neighborFinset c ∩ (S \ cutBoundary H S)).card = 2

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Bisection.Internal.card_cutBoundary_eq_cut
Algebraic.Cutwidth.Bisection.Internal.card_cut_sdiff_cut_eq_sum
statement:

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Bisection.Internal.card_interior_edges

    (independent : ∀ c ∈ cutBoundary H S, ∀ d ∈ cutBoundary H S, ¬ H.Adj c d) :
    2 * (H.induce {v | v ∈ S \ cutBoundary H S}).edgeFinset.card +
      2 * (cutBoundary H S).card = 3 * (S \ cutBoundary H S).card

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Bisection.Internal.card_interior_neighbors
statement:

statement:

    (regular : H.IsRegularOfDegree 3)
    (outside : ∀ c ∈ cutBoundary H S, (H.neighborFinset c \ S).card = 1)
    (independent : ∀ c ∈ cutBoundary H S, ∀ d ∈ cutBoundary H S, ¬ H.Adj c d)
    (hX : X ⊆ S \ cutBoundary H S)
    (positive : (H.cutFinset X \ H.cutFinset (cutBoundary H S)).card <
      (sharedBoundary H S X).card) :
    ∃ Y ⊆ S, Y.card ≤ 4 * X.card ∧ 1 ≤ helpfulness H S Y

statement:

    {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 < ξ)
    (dense : (1 / 3 + ξ) * S.card < (H.cutFinset S).card) (M : Nat)
    (budget : 1 ≤ ((M : ℝ) + 1) * (3 * ξ / 2)) :
    ∃ C : (H.induce {v | v ∈ S \ cutBoundary H S}).ConnectedComponent,
      C.toSimpleGraph.IsTree ∧ Fintype.card C ≤ M

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Bisection.Internal.helpfulness_boundaryLift
statement:
theorem helpfulness_boundaryLift {S X : Finset W} (regular : H.IsRegularOfDegree 3)
    (outside : ∀ c ∈ cutBoundary H S, (H.neighborFinset c \ S).card = 1)
    (independent : ∀ c ∈ cutBoundary H S, ∀ d ∈ cutBoundary H S, ¬ H.Adj c d)
    (hX : X ⊆ S \ cutBoundary H S) :
    helpfulness H S (boundaryLift H S X) = (sharedBoundary H S X).card -
      ((H.cutFinset X \ H.cutFinset (cutBoundary H S)).card : ℤ)

statement:

      2 * ((H.neighborFinset v \ S).card : ℤ) - H.degree v +
      2 * ((H.neighborFinset v ∩ X).card : ℤ)

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Bisection.Internal.exists_boundary_switch
statement:

statement:
theorem exists_independent_boundary_or_small_helpful (H : SimpleGraph W) (S : Finset W)
    (regular : H.IsRegularOfDegree 3) :
    (∃ X ⊆ S, X.card ≤ 33 ∧ 1 ≤ helpfulness H S X) ∨
      ∃ G : SimpleGraph W, G.IsRegularOfDegree 3 ∧ G.cutFinset S = H.cutFinset S ∧
        cutBoundary G S = cutBoundary H S ∧
        (∀ c ∈ cutBoundary G S, (G.neighborFinset c \ S).card = 1) ∧
        (∀ a ∈ cutBoundary G S, ∀ b ∈ cutBoundary G S, ¬ G.Adj a b) ∧
        ∀ X ⊆ S, ∃ Y ⊆ S, X ⊆ Y ∧ Y.card ≤ 3 * X.card ∧
          helpfulness G S X ≤ helpfulness H S Y

        ∀ X ⊆ S, ∃ Y ⊆ S, X ⊆ Y ∧ Y.card ≤ 3 * X.card ∧

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Bisection.NeighborNormalization.Internal.boundaryNeighbors_switch
statement:
theorem boundaryNeighbors_switch (G : SimpleGraph W) {C : Finset W} {a b c d : W}

    (hc : c ∉ C) (hd : d ∉ C) (v : W) :
    (switchEdges G a b c d).neighborFinset v ∩ C =

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Bisection.RedBlack.Internal.exists_positive_of_attachments
statement:
theorem exists_positive_of_attachments (P : Finset V) (edges : Finset E)
    (A : E → Finset V) (M : Nat)
    (cut : (B.cutFinset P).card < edges.card)
    (closed : ∀ e ∈ edges, B.cutFinset (A e) = ∅)
    (small : ∀ e ∈ edges, (A e).card ≤ M)
    (attached : ∀ e ∈ edges,
      (R.fst e ∈ P ∧ R.snd e ∈ A e) ∨ (R.snd e ∈ P ∧ R.fst e ∈ A e)) :
    ∃ X : Finset V, X.card ≤ P.card + edges.card * M ∧ Positive B R X

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Bisection.RedBlack.Internal.exists_positive_of_thin_walk
statement:
theorem exists_positive_of_thin_walk {u v : V} (p : B.Walk u v) {n : Nat}
    (edge : Fin (n + 3) ↪ E) (pos : Fin (n + 3) → Nat) (A : E → Finset V) (M : Nat)
    (ordered : Monotone pos) (within : ∀ i, pos i ≤ p.length)
    (degree : ∀ w ∈ p.support, B.degree w ≤ 2)
    (thin : p.length ≤ M * (n + 3))
    (closed : ∀ i, B.cutFinset (A (edge i)) = ∅)
    (small : ∀ i, (A (edge i)).card ≤ M)
    (attached : ∀ i,
      (R.fst (edge i) = p.getVert (pos i) ∧ R.snd (edge i) ∈ A (edge i)) ∨
        (R.snd (edge i) = p.getVert (pos i) ∧ R.fst (edge i) ∈ A (edge i))) :
    ∃ X : Finset V, X.card ≤ 8 * M + 1 ∧ Positive B R X

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Bisection.RedBlack.Internal.exists_positive_of_three_attachments
statement:
theorem exists_positive_of_three_attachments (P : Finset V) (edges : Finset E)
    (A : E → Finset V) (M : Nat)
    (connected : (B.induce {v | v ∈ P}).Connected)
    (degree : ∀ v ∈ P, B.degree v ≤ 2) (three : edges.card = 3)
    (closed : ∀ e ∈ edges, B.cutFinset (A e) = ∅)
    (small : ∀ e ∈ edges, (A e).card ≤ M)
    (attached : ∀ e ∈ edges,

statement:
theorem edge_ncard_eq_degree_two (forest : B.IsAcyclic)
    (independent : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ v ∈ S, ¬ B.Adj u v)
    (coreIndependent : ∀ u ∉ S, ∀ v ∉ S, ¬ B.Adj u v)
    (degree : ∀ v ∈ S, B.degree v ≤ 2) :
    (graph B S).edgeSet.ncard = (S.filter (fun v => B.degree v = 2)).card

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Bisection.RedBlack.PathSuppression.exists_connection_equiv
statement:
theorem exists_connection_equiv (forest : B.IsAcyclic)
    (independent : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ v ∈ S, ¬ B.Adj u v)

    (degree : ∀ v ∈ S, B.degree v ≤ 2) :
    ∃ f : (S.filter (fun v => B.degree v = 2)) ≃ (graph B S).edgeSet,
      ∀ x, ∃ u v : {v // v ∉ S}, (f x).val = s(u, v) ∧

name: Algebraic.Cutwidth.Bisection.Internal.BoundarySuppression.exists_helpful_set_of_positive

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.depth_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem depth_neg : ∀ F : Formula n, F.neg.depth = F.depth
  | lit _ _ => rfl
  | const _ => rfl
  | and l r => by simp [neg, depth, depth_neg l, depth_neg r]
  | or l r => by simp [neg, depth, depth_neg l, depth_neg r]

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.eval_and

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.eval_const
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_const (b : Bool) (x : Fin n → Bool) : (const b : Formula n).eval x = b

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.eval_lit
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_lit (i : Fin n) (b : Bool) (x : Fin n → Bool) :

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.eval_neg
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_neg : ∀ (F : Formula n) (x : Fin n → Bool), F.neg.eval x = !F.eval x
  | lit i b, x => by
    simp only [neg, eval]
    cases x i <;> cases b <;> rfl
  | const b, _ => rfl
  | and l r, x => by simp [neg, eval_neg l, eval_neg r]
  | or l r, x => by simp [neg, eval_neg l, eval_neg r]

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.eval_or
statement:

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.leaves_neg

  | lit _ _ => rfl

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.one_le_leaves
statement:
theorem one_le_leaves : ∀ F : Formula n, 1 ≤ F.leaves
  | lit _ _ => le_rfl
  | const _ => le_rfl
  | and l r => by simp only [leaves]; have

name: Algebraic.KW.Protocol.depth_toFormula
statement:
@[simp] theorem depth_toFormula :
    ∀ (P : Protocol n) (A B : (Fin n → Bool) → Prop), (P.toFormula A B).depth = P.depth
  | answer _, _, _ => by
    simp only [toFormula]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  | alice _ l r, A, B => by
    simp [toFormula, Formula.depth, depth, depth_toFormula l, depth_toFormula r]
  | bob _ l r, A, B => by
    simp [toFormula, Formula.depth, depth, depth_toFormula l, depth_toFormula r]

name: Algebraic.KW.Protocol.leaves_toFormula
statement:
@[simp] theorem leaves_toFormula :
    ∀ (P : Protocol n) (A B : (Fin n → Bool) → Prop), (P.toFormula A B).leaves = P.leaves
  | answer _, _, _ => by
    simp only [toFormula]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  | alice _ l r, A, B => by
    simp [toFormula, Formula.leaves, leaves, leaves_toFormula l, leaves_toFormula r]
  | bob _ l r, A, B => by
    simp [toFormula, Formula.leaves, leaves, leaves_toFormula l, leaves_toFormula r]

name: Algebraic.KW.Protocol.toFormula_spec
statement:
theorem toFormula_spec :
    ∀ (P : Protocol n) (A B : (Fin n → Bool) → Prop), P.Solves A B →
      (∀ x, A x → (P.toFormula A B).eval x = true) ∧ (∀ y, B y → (P.toFormula A B).eval y = false)
  | answer i, A, B, h => by
    simp only [toFormula]
    by_cases hB : ∃ y, B y
    · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.card_vars_le_leaves
statement:
theorem card_vars_le_leaves : ∀ F : Formula n, F.vars.card ≤ F.leaves
  | lit _ _ => by simp [vars, leaves]
  | const _ => by simp [vars, leaves]
  | and l r => by
    simp only [vars, leaves]
    exact (Finset.card_union_le _ _).trans
      (Nat.add_le_add (card_vars_le_leaves l) (card_vars_le_leaves r))
  | or l r => by
    simp only [vars, leaves]
    exact (Finset.card_union_le _ _).trans
      (Nat.add_le_add (card_vars_le_leaves l) (card_vars_le_leaves r))

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.depth_compose_le
statement:
theorem depth_compose_le (F : Formula m) (G : Formula n) :
    (F.compose G).depth ≤ F.depth + G.depth

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.depth_mapIndex
statement:
@[simp] theorem depth_mapIndex (φ : Fin n → Fin N) :
    ∀ F : Formula n, (F.mapIndex φ).depth = F.depth
  | lit _ _ => rfl
  | const _ => rfl
  | and l r => by simp [mapIndex, depth, depth_mapIndex φ l, depth_mapIndex φ r]
  | or l r => by simp [mapIndex, depth, depth_mapIndex φ l, depth_mapIndex φ r]

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.depth_subst_le
statement:
theorem depth_subst_le (σ : Fin N → Formula n) {d : Nat} (hσ : ∀ i, (σ i).depth ≤ d) :
    ∀ F : Formula N, (F.subst σ).depth ≤ F.depth + d
  | lit i b => by
    cases b <;> simp [subst, depth, hσ i]
  | const _ => by simp [subst, depth]
  | and l r => by
    simp only [subst, depth]
    have

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.eval_compose
statement:
theorem eval_compose (F : Formula m) (G : Formula n) (z : Fin (m * n) → Bool) :
    (F.compose G).eval z = F.eval fun j => G.eval fun i => z (blockIndex j i)

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.eval_mapIndex
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_mapIndex (φ : Fin n → Fin N) :
    ∀ (F : Formula n) (x : Fin N → Bool), (F.mapIndex φ).eval x = F.eval (x ∘ φ)
  | lit _ _, _ => rfl
  | const _, _ => rfl
  | and l r, x => by simp [mapIndex, eval_mapIndex φ l, eval_mapIndex φ r]
  | or l r, x => by simp [mapIndex, eval_mapIndex φ l, eval_mapIndex φ r]

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.eval_subst
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_subst (σ : Fin N → Formula n) :
    ∀ (F : Formula N) (x : Fin n → Bool), (F.subst σ).eval x = F.eval fun i => (σ i).eval x
  | lit i b, x => by
    cases b
    · simp only [subst, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, eval_neg, eval_lit]
      cases (σ i).eval x <;> rfl
    · simp only [subst, ↓reduceIte, eval_lit]
      cases (σ i).eval x <;> rfl
  | const _, _ => rfl
  | and l r, x => by simp [subst, eval_subst σ l, eval_subst σ r]
  | or l r, x => by simp [subst, eval_subst σ l, eval_subst σ r]

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.eval_update_of_notMem_vars
statement:
theorem eval_update_of_notMem_vars {i : Fin n} (b : Bool) (x : Fin n → Bool) :
    ∀ F : Formula n, i ∉ F.vars → F.eval (Function.update x i b) = F.eval x
  | lit j _, h => by
    have hji : j ≠ i

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.leaves_compose_le
statement:
theorem leaves_compose_le (F : Formula m) (G : Formula n) :

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.leaves_le_two_pow_depth
statement:
theorem leaves_le_two_pow_depth : ∀ F : Formula n, F.leaves ≤ 2 ^ F.depth
  | lit _ _ => by simp [leaves, depth]
  | const _ => by simp [leaves, depth]
  | and l r => by
    simp only [leaves, depth, pow_succ]
    have hl

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.leaves_mapIndex
statement:
@[simp] theorem leaves_mapIndex (φ : Fin n → Fin N) :
    ∀ F : Formula n, (F.mapIndex φ).leaves = F.leaves
  | lit _ _ => rfl
  | const _ => rfl
  | and l r => by simp [mapIndex, leaves, leaves_mapIndex φ l, leaves_mapIndex φ r]
  | or l r => by simp [mapIndex, leaves, leaves_mapIndex φ l, leaves_mapIndex φ r]

name: Algebraic.KW.Formula.leaves_subst_le
statement:
theorem leaves_subst_le (σ : Fin N → Formula n) {L : Nat} (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hσ : ∀ i, (σ i).leaves ≤ L) :
    ∀ F : Formula N, (F.subst σ).leaves ≤ F.leaves * L
  | lit i b => by
    cases b <;> simp [subst, leaves, hσ i]
  | const _ => by simpa [subst, leaves] using hL
  | and l r => by
    simp only [subst, leaves, Nat.add_mul]
    have

name: Algebraic.KW.exists_iInf_natCast_eq

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.affineLine_identity
statement:
theorem affineLine_identity
    {K Coordinate : Type*}
    [Fintype K] [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    (polynomial : MvPolynomial Coordinate K)
    (degree : polynomial.totalDegree < Fintype.card K - 1)
    (center direction : Coordinate -> K) :
    MvPolynomial.eval center polynomial =
      -∑ parameter ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (0 : K)),
        MvPolynomial.eval
          (fun index => center index + direction index * parameter)
          polynomial

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.card_evaluationCodeDomain

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.evaluationCode_line_recovery_charTwo
statement:
theorem evaluationCode_line_recovery_charTwo
    {K Index Coordinate : Type*}
    [Fintype K] [Field K] [DecidableEq K] [CharP K 2]
    [Fintype Index] [DecidableEq Index]
    [Fintype Coordinate] [DecidableEq Coordinate]
    (nodes : Index -> K)
    (message : (Coordinate -> Index) -> K)
    (degree : Fintype.card Coordinate * (Fintype.card Index - 1) <
      Fintype.card K - 1)
    (target direction : Coordinate -> K) :
    evaluationCode nodes message target =
      ∑ parameter ∈ (Finset.univ.erase (0 : K)),
        evaluationCode nodes message
          (fun index => target index + direction index * parameter)

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.evaluationCode_on_grid
statement:

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.gridInterpolate_add
statement:

theorem paperEvaluationCode_line_recovery

      (Fin dimension ->
        Fin (resourceGridWidth (Fintype.card K) dimension)) -> K)

statement:
theorem commonZeroBlockSumResidueGap

    (degrees : Coordinate → Nat) (start blockWidth : Nat)
    (zeroBlock : CommonZeroBlock degrees start blockWidth)
    (dimensionFits : Fintype.card Coordinate ≤ 2 ^ blockWidth) :

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.HighRate.commonZeroBlock_iff
statement:
theorem commonZeroBlock_iff

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.HighRate.exponentLtCardPredOfZeroBlock
statement:
theorem exponentLtCardPredOfZeroBlock
    (width start blockWidth exponent : Nat)
    (blockPositive : 0 < blockWidth) (blockFits : start + blockWidth ≤ width)
    (reduced : exponent < 2 ^ width)
    (zeroBlock : exponent % 2 ^ (start + blockWidth) < 2 ^ start) :

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.HighRate.notDvdOfResidueGap
statement:
theorem notDvdOfResidueGap

    (modulusDivides : modulus ∣ q)

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.HighRate.cardRetainedDigits

statement:

    [Finite K] (target : V) (direction : ℙ K V) (point : V) :

      ∃ scalar : K, scalar ≠ 0 ∧ target + scalar • direction.rep = point

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.puncturedLine_disjoint_of_avoids_differences
statement:
theorem puncturedLine_disjoint_of_avoids_differences
    [Finite K]
    (target : V)
    (direction : ℙ K V)
    (used : Finset V)
    (avoids : ∀ (point : V), point ∈ used ->
      ∀ pointDifferent : point ≠ target,
      direction ≠ Projectivization.mk K (point - target)
        (sub_ne_zero.mpr pointDifferent)) :

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.puncturedLine_mk_eq_image
statement:
theorem puncturedLine_mk_eq_image
    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [DecidableEq V]
    (target vector : V)
    (vectorNonzero : vector ≠ 0) :
    puncturedLine target
        (Projectivization.mk K vector vectorNonzero) =
      (Finset.univ.erase (0 : K)).image

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.sum_puncturedLine

    (target : V)
    (direction : ℙ K V)

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.HighRate.existsSystematicEncoder

      Nat.card information = Fintype.card Index ∧

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.HighRate.retainedDimension_rate
statement:
theorem retainedDimension_rate
    (alphabet blocks precision : Nat)
    (alphabetPositive : 0 < alphabet) (blocksPositive : 0 < blocks)
    (blocksLarge : precision * (alphabet - 1) ≤ blocks) :
    precision * alphabet ^ blocks ≤ (precision + 1) * retainedDimension alphabet blocks

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.HighRate.existsPackingPlacement
statement:
theorem existsPackingPlacement
    {Information : Type*} [Fintype Information]
    (sourceBits symbolBits : Nat)
    (informationPositive : 0 < Fintype.card Information) (symbolPositive : 0 < symbolBits) :
    Nonempty (Fin sourceBits ↪
      (Fin (packingCopies sourceBits (Fintype.card Information) symbolBits) ×
        Information × Fin symbolBits))

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.HighRate.packingCopies_capacity
statement:
theorem packingCopies_capacity
    (sourceBits messageSymbols symbolBits : Nat)
    (messagePositive : 0 < messageSymbols) (symbolPositive : 0 < symbolBits) :
    sourceBits ≤ packingCopies sourceBits messageSymbols symbolBits * messageSymbols * symbolBits

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.HighRate.packingCopies_storage
statement:

    (sourceBits messageSymbols codeSymbols symbolBits precision : Nat)
    (rate : precision * codeSymbols ≤ (precision + 1) * messageSymbols) :
    precision * (packingCopies sourceBits messageSymbols symbolBits * codeSymbols * symbolBits) ≤
      (precision + 1) * sourceBits + precision * (codeSymbols * symbolBits)

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.Nonuniform.existsCollisionCut
statement:
theorem existsCollisionCut
    {Vertex : Type*}
    (graph : SimpleGraph Vertex) (bad : Finset Vertex)
    (nonisolated : ∀ vertex ∈ bad, ∃ neighbor, graph.Adj vertex neighbor) :
    ∃ selected : Finset Vertex, selected ⊆ bad ∧
      bad.card ≤ 2 * selected.card ∧
      ∀ vertex ∈ selected, ∃ neighbor,
        neighbor ∉ selected ∧ graph.Adj vertex neighbor

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.Nonuniform.cardOutsidePoints_le
statement:

    (sets : Index → Choice → Finset Point) (occupied : Finset Point)
    (selected : Finset Index) (outside : {index // index ∉ selected} → Choice)
    (setSize : Nat) (setsSmall : ∀ index choice, (sets index choice).card ≤ setSize) :
    (outsidePoints sets occupied selected outside).card ≤
      occupied.card + Fintype.card Index * setSize

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.Nonuniform.EnumeratedClean.mem_pointSet_iff

theorem mem_pointSet_iff (valid : Fin slots → Bool) (points : Fin slots → Point) (point : Point) :
    point ∈ pointSet valid points ↔ ∃ slot, valid slot = true ∧ points slot = point

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.Nonuniform.EnumeratedClean.noConflict_iff_clean
statement:
theorem noConflict_iff_clean
    (valid : Fin requests → Fin slots → Bool)
    (points : Fin requests → Fin slots → Point) (occupied : Finset Point)
    (withinRequest : ∀ request left right, valid request left = true → valid request right = true →
      points request left = points request right → left = right)
    (request : Fin requests) :
    (∀ slot, ¬ Conflict valid points occupied request slot) ↔
      Clean (fun request (_ : Unit) => pointSet (valid request) (points request))

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.Nonuniform.mem_phaseOccupied_iff
statement:

    {K V : Type*} [Field K] [Finite K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (state : PhaseState V (ℙ K V) capacity active) (point : V) :
    point ∈ phaseOccupied state ↔
      ∃ slot line, state.1 slot = some line ∧ point ∈ puncturedLine line.1 line.2

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.Nonuniform.HalfClean.existsHalfSelection
statement:
theorem HalfClean.existsHalfSelection
    {K V : Type*} [Field K] [Finite K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (state : PhaseState V (ℙ K V) capacity active)
    (candidate : Fin active → ℙ K V) (successful : HalfClean state candidate) :
    ∃ accepted : Finset (Fin active),
      accepted.card = (active + 1) / 2 ∧
      acceptedᶜ.card = active / 2 ∧
      (∀ index ∈ accepted,
        Disjoint (puncturedLine (state.2 index) (candidate index)) (phaseOccupied state)) ∧
      (accepted : Set (Fin active)).Pairwise (fun left right =>
        Disjoint (puncturedLine (state.2 left) (candidate left))
          (puncturedLine (state.2 right) (candidate right)))

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.evaluationCode_sum_puncturedLine

    [Fintype Index] [DecidableEq Index]
    [Fintype Coordinate] [DecidableEq Coordinate]
    (nodes : Index -> K)
    (message : (Coordinate -> Index) -> K)
    (degree : Fintype.card Coordinate * (Fintype.card Index - 1) <
      Fintype.card K - 1)
    (target : Coordinate -> K)
    (direction : ℙ K (Coordinate -> K)) :
    evaluationCode nodes message target =
      ∑ point ∈ puncturedLine target direction,
        evaluationCode nodes message point

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.exists_disjoint_paperEvaluationCode_recovery
statement:
theorem exists_disjoint_paperEvaluationCode_recovery
    (K : Type*)
    [Fintype K] [Field K] [DecidableEq K] [CharP K 2]
    (dimension : Nat)
    (dimensionPositive : 0 < dimension)
    (message :
      (Fin dimension ->
        Fin (resourceGridWidth (Fintype.card K) dimension)) -> K)
    (targets : List (Fin dimension -> K))
    (cardBound : targets.length * (Nat.card K - 1) <
      Nat.card (ℙ K (Fin dimension -> K))) :
    ∃ directions : List (ℙ K (Fin dimension -> K)),
      ValidSchedule targets directions ∧
        (recoverySets targets directions).map
            (fun set => ∑ point ∈ set,
              paperEvaluationCode K dimension message point) =
          targets.map (paperEvaluationCode K dimension message)

name: Algebraic.MassProduction.paperEvaluationCode_sum_puncturedLine
statement:
theorem paperEvaluationCode_sum_puncturedLine

statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_bias_antitone_internal {n : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : Antitone f)
    {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hq : q ≤ 1) :
    bernoulliAverage q f ≤ bernoulliAverage p f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_cons_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_cons_internal {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ)
    (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ) :
    bernoulliAverage p f =
      (1 - p) * bernoulliAverage p (fun x => f (Fin.cons false x)) +
        p * bernoulliAverage p (fun x => f (Fin.cons true x))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_const_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_const_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p c : ℝ) :
    bernoulliAverage p (fun _ : ι → Bool => c) = c

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_expect_comm_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_expect_comm_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {α : Type*} (A : Finset α)
    (p : ℝ) (f : (ι → Bool) → α → ℝ) :
    bernoulliAverage p (fun s => 𝔼 x ∈ A, f s x) =
      𝔼 x ∈ A, bernoulliAverage p (fun s => f s x)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_indicator_bounds_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_indicator_bounds_internal {n : ℕ} (A : Set (Fin n → Bool))
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ bernoulliAverage p (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∧
      bernoulliAverage p (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_linear_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_linear_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (p a b : ℝ) (f g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    bernoulliAverage p (fun x => a * f x + b * g x) =
      a * bernoulliAverage p f + b * bernoulliAverage p g

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_lowerSet_pow_le_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_lowerSet_pow_le_internal {n : ℕ} {A : Set (Fin n → Bool)}
    (hA : IsLowerSet A)
    {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≤ 1) (hq : q ≤ 1)
    (h : ℕ) (hh : (h : ℝ) * p ≤ q) :
    bernoulliAverage q (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      bernoulliAverage p (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ^ h

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_lowerSet_transfer_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_lowerSet_transfer_internal {n : ℕ} {A : Set (Fin n → Bool)}
    (hA : IsLowerSet A) (hA' : A.Nonempty) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hr' : r ≤ 1 / 20) :
    (bernoulliAverage (1 / 4) (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) ^ (5 * r) ≤
      bernoulliAverage r (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_lowerSet_union_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_lowerSet_union_internal {n : ℕ} {A : Set (Fin n → Bool)}
    (hA : IsLowerSet A)
    {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≤ 1) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq' : q ≤ 1) :
    bernoulliAverage (p + q - p * q) (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      bernoulliAverage p (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
        bernoulliAverage q (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_mono_internal

    bernoulliAverage p (fun x => a * f x) = a * bernoulliAverage p f

    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (e : ι ≃ κ) (p : ℝ) (f : (κ → Bool) → ℝ) :

    (p : ℝ) (s : ι → Bool) (f : ({i // s i = true} → Bool) → ℝ) :
    bernoulliAverage p (fun x : ι → Bool => f (fun i => x i)) = bernoulliAverage p f

statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_sub_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

    bernoulliAverage p (fun s => f s - g s) = bernoulliAverage p f - bernoulliAverage p g

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_union_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_union_internal {n : ℕ} (p q : ℝ) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ) :
    bernoulliAverage p (fun r => bernoulliAverage q (fun s =>
      f (fun i => r i || s i))) = bernoulliAverage (p + q - p * q) f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_zero_internal

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliWeight_cons_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliWeight_cons_internal {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ) (b : Bool)
    (selected : Fin n → Bool) :
    bernoulliWeight p (Fin.cons b selected) =
      (if b then p else 1 - p) * bernoulliWeight p selected
