    noiseStability ρ f = ⟪f, noiseOp ρ f⟫

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.noiseStability_eq_sum_weight
statement:
theorem noiseStability_eq_sum_weight (ρ : ℝ) (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    noiseStability ρ f = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ρ ^ k * 𝐖 f k

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.noiseStability_le_self_inner
statement:
theorem noiseStability_le_self_inner {ρ : ℝ} (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1)
    (f : BooleanFunction n) : noiseStability ρ f ≤ ⟪f, f⟫

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.noiseStability_mono
statement:
theorem noiseStability_mono {ρ₁ ρ₂ : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ ρ₁) (h12 : ρ₁ ≤ ρ₂)
    (f : BooleanFunction n) : noiseStability ρ₁ f ≤ noiseStability ρ₂ f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.noiseStability_nonneg
statement:
theorem noiseStability_nonneg {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    0 ≤ noiseStability ρ f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.noiseStability_one
statement: theorem noiseStability_one (f : BooleanFunction n) : noiseStability 1 f = ⟪f, f⟫

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.noiseStability_one_sub_le
statement:
theorem noiseStability_one_sub_le {ρ : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (h1 : ρ ≤ 1) (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    ⟪f, f⟫ - noiseStability ρ f ≤ (1 - ρ) * totalInfluence f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.noiseStability_zero
statement:
theorem noiseStability_zero (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    noiseStability 0 f = (𝓕 f ∅) ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.noiseStability_zero_eq_expect_sq
statement:
theorem noiseStability_zero_eq_expect_sq (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    noiseStability 0 f = 𝔼[f] ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.norm_sq_degreePart
statement:
theorem norm_sq_degreePart (f : BooleanFunction n) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖degreePart f k‖₂ ^ 2 = 𝐖 f k

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.norm_sq_eq_inner
statement: theorem norm_sq_eq_inner (f : BooleanFunction n) : ‖f‖₂ ^ 2 = ⟪f, f⟫

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.norm_sq_eq_sum_fourierCoeff_sq
statement:
theorem norm_sq_eq_sum_fourierCoeff_sq (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    ‖f‖₂ ^ 2 = ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), (𝓕 f S) ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.parityFun_add
statement:
theorem parityFun_add (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x y : Cube n) :
    (χ S) (x + y) = (χ S) x * (χ S) y

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.parityFun_flipCoord
statement:
theorem parityFun_flipCoord (i : Fin n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : Cube n) :
    (χ S) (flipCoord i x) = (if i ∈ S then -1 else 1) * (χ S) x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.parityFun_injective
statement:
theorem parityFun_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun S : Finset (Fin n) => (χ S : BooleanFunction n))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.parityFun_mul
statement:
theorem parityFun_mul (S T : Finset (Fin n)) (x : Cube n) :
    (χ S) x * (χ T) x = (χ (symmDiff S T)) x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.parityFun_orthonormal
statement:
theorem parityFun_orthonormal (S T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ⟪χ S, χ T⟫ = if S = T then 1 else 0

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.parityFun_span
statement:
theorem parityFun_span (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    ∃ c : Finset (Fin n) → ℝ, ∀ x, f x = ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), c S * (χ S) x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.parseval
statement:
theorem parseval (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    ⟪f, f⟫ = ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), (𝓕 f S) ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.parseval_boolean
statement:
theorem parseval_boolean (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), (𝓕 f S) ^ 2 = 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.plancherel
statement:
theorem plancherel (f g : BooleanFunction n) :
    ⟪f, g⟫ = ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), (𝓕 f S) * (𝓕 g S)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sensitivityOp_eq_parityFun_mul_derivative
statement:
theorem sensitivityOp_eq_parityFun_mul_derivative (i : Fin n) (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    sensitivityOp i f = fun x => (χ ({i} : Finset (Fin n))) x * (derivative i f) x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.setDensity_isDensity
statement:
theorem setDensity_isDensity (A : Finset (Cube n)) (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    IsDensity (setDensity A)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.setDensity_singleton_zero
statement:
theorem setDensity_singleton_zero :
    ∀ y : Cube n, setDensity ({0} : Finset (Cube n)) y =
      ∑ S : Finset (Fin n), (χ S) y

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sq_expect_le_noiseStability
statement:
theorem sq_expect_le_noiseStability {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    𝔼[f] ^ 2 ≤ noiseStability ρ f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sum_degreePart
statement:
theorem sum_degreePart (f : BooleanFunction n) (x : Cube n) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), degreePart f k x = f x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sum_fourierCoeff_singleton_sq_eq_fourierWeightAtDegree_one
statement:
theorem sum_fourierCoeff_singleton_sq_eq_fourierWeightAtDegree_one (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, (𝓕 f {i}) ^ 2 = 𝐖 f 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sum_fourierCoeff_singleton_sq_le_totalInfluence
statement:
theorem sum_fourierCoeff_singleton_sq_le_totalInfluence (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, (𝓕 f {i}) ^ 2 ≤ totalInfluence f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sum_fourierWeightAtDegree
statement:
theorem sum_fourierWeightAtDegree (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 𝐖 f k = ⟪f, f⟫

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.sum_fourierWeightAtDegree_boolean
statement:
theorem sum_fourierWeightAtDegree_boolean (f : BooleanFunction n)
    (hf : IsBooleanValued f) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 𝐖 f k = 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_boolean_eq_expect_sensitive
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_boolean_eq_expect_sensitive (f : BooleanFunction n)
    (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    totalInfluence f
      = 𝔼[fun x => ∑ i : Fin n, if f x ≠ f (flipCoord i x) then (1 : ℝ) else 0]

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_boolean_le
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_boolean_le (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    totalInfluence f ≤ (n : ℝ)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_boolean_le_of_degree
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_boolean_le_of_degree (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : ∀ S : Finset (Fin n), d < S.card → 𝓕 f S = 0) :
    totalInfluence f ≤ (d : ℝ)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_eq_sum_influence
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_eq_sum_influence (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    totalInfluence f = ∑ i : Fin n, influence i f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_eq_sum_weight
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_eq_sum_weight (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    totalInfluence f = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (k : ℝ) * 𝐖 f k

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_le
statement: theorem totalInfluence_le (f : BooleanFunction n) : totalInfluence f ≤ (n : ℝ) * ⟪f, f⟫

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_le_of_degree
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_le_of_degree (f : BooleanFunction n) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ S : Finset (Fin n), d < S.card → 𝓕 f S = 0) :
    totalInfluence f ≤ (d : ℝ) * ⟪f, f⟫

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_nonneg
statement: theorem totalInfluence_nonneg (f : BooleanFunction n) : 0 ≤ totalInfluence f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.totalInfluence_parityFun
statement:
theorem totalInfluence_parityFun (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    totalInfluence (χ S) = (S.card : ℝ)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.two_point_hypercontractive
statement:
theorem two_point_hypercontractive (a b : ℝ) :
    ((a + b / Real.sqrt 3) ^ 4 + (a - b / Real.sqrt 3) ^ 4) / 2 ≤ (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_boolean
statement:
theorem variance_boolean (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    Var[f] = 1 - (𝔼[f]) ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_boolean_le_one
statement:
theorem variance_boolean_le_one (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    Var[f] ≤ 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_boolean_nonneg
statement:
theorem variance_boolean_nonneg (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    0 ≤ Var[f]

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_boolean_prob
statement:
theorem variance_boolean_prob (f : BooleanFunction n) (hf : IsBooleanValued f) :
    Var[f] = 4 * Pr[fun x => f x = 1] * Pr[fun x => f x = -1]

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_dist_bounds
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_eq_self_inner_sub_fourierWeightAtDegree_zero
statement:
theorem variance_eq_self_inner_sub_fourierWeightAtDegree_zero (f : BooleanFunction n) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_eq_sum_fourierCoeff_sq
statement:
theorem variance_eq_sum_fourierCoeff_sq (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    Var[f] = ∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset (Fin n) => S ≠ ∅),
      (𝓕 f S) ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_eq_sum_fourierWeightAtDegree_pos
statement:
theorem variance_eq_sum_fourierWeightAtDegree_pos (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    Var[f] = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, 𝐖 f (k + 1)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_le_totalInfluence
statement: theorem variance_le_totalInfluence (f : BooleanFunction n) : Var[f] ≤ totalInfluence f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.variance_nonneg
statement: theorem variance_nonneg (f : BooleanFunction n) : 0 ≤ Var[f]

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_bool_internal
statement:
theorem expect_bool_internal (f : Bool → ℝ) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_pair_internal
statement:
theorem expect_pair_internal {β : Type*} [Fintype β] (f : α × β → ℝ) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_average_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_average_internal {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    {f : β → α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ y x, 0 ≤ f y x) :
    (𝔼 y, harmonicMean (f y)) ≤ harmonicMean (fun x => 𝔼 y, f y x)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_concave_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_concave_internal {f g : α → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht' : t ≤ 1) :
    t * harmonicMean f + (1 - t) * harmonicMean g ≤
      harmonicMean (fun x => t * f x + (1 - t) * g x)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_const_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_const_internal (c : ℝ) :
    harmonicMean (fun _ : α => c) = c

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_equiv_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_equiv_internal {β : Type*} [Fintype β]
    (e : α ≃ β) (f : β → ℝ) : harmonicMean (fun x => f (e x)) = harmonicMean f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_exists_weight_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_exists_weight_internal {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    ∃ w : α → ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) ∧ (𝔼 x, w x) = 1 ∧
      (𝔼 x, f x * w x ^ 2) = harmonicMean f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_le_energy_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_le_energy_internal {f w : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hw : (𝔼 x, w x) = 1) : harmonicMean f ≤ 𝔼 x, f x * w x ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_le_expect_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_le_expect_internal {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    harmonicMean f ≤ 𝔼 x, f x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_light_fraction_le_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_light_fraction_le_internal {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha' : a ≤ harmonicMean f) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    (𝔼 x, if f x ≤ b then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ b / a

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_mono_internal
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_nonneg_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_nonneg_internal {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    0 ≤ harmonicMean f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_pair_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_pair_internal {f : Bool → α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ b x, 0 ≤ f b x) :
    harmonicMean (fun x : Bool × α => f x.1 x.2) =
      2 * harmonicMean (f false) * harmonicMean (f true) /
        (harmonicMean (f false) + harmonicMean (f true))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_variational_internal
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_cons_internal
statement:
theorem expect_cons_internal {n : ℕ} (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ) :
    (𝔼 x, f x) = ((𝔼 x, f (Fin.cons false x)) + (𝔼 x, f (Fin.cons true x))) / 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_cons_false_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_cons_false_internal {n : ℕ}
    (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ) (selected : Fin n → Bool) :
    harmonicTransform f (Fin.cons false selected) =
      harmonicTransform
        (fun x => (f (Fin.cons false x) + f (Fin.cons true x)) / 2) selected

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_cons_true_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_cons_true_internal {n : ℕ}
    {f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (selected : Fin n → Bool) :
    harmonicTransform f (Fin.cons true selected) =
      2 * harmonicTransform (fun x => f (Fin.cons false x)) selected *
        harmonicTransform (fun x => f (Fin.cons true x)) selected /
      (harmonicTransform (fun x => f (Fin.cons false x)) selected +
        harmonicTransform (fun x => f (Fin.cons true x)) selected)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_const_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_const_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (c : ℝ) (selected : ι → Bool) : harmonicTransform (fun _ => c) selected = c

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_midpoint_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_midpoint_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {f g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x)
    (selected : ι → Bool) :
    (harmonicTransform f selected + harmonicTransform g selected) / 2 ≤
      harmonicTransform (fun x => (f x + g x) / 2) selected

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_nonneg_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_nonneg_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (selected : ι → Bool) :
    0 ≤ harmonicTransform f selected

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_cons_false_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_cons_false_internal {n : ℕ}
    (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ) (selected x : Fin n → Bool) (b : Bool) :
    projectionAverage f (Fin.cons false selected) (Fin.cons b x) =
      projectionAverage (fun x => (f (Fin.cons false x) + f (Fin.cons true x)) / 2)
        selected x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_cons_true_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_cons_true_internal {n : ℕ}
    (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ) (selected x : Fin n → Bool) (b : Bool) :
    projectionAverage f (Fin.cons true selected) (Fin.cons b x) =
      projectionAverage (fun x => f (Fin.cons b x)) selected x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_midpoint_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_midpoint_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (selected x : ι → Bool) :
    projectionAverage (fun x => (f x + g x) / 2) selected x =
      (projectionAverage f selected x + projectionAverage g selected x) / 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_nonneg_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_nonneg_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (selected x : ι → Bool) :
    0 ≤ projectionAverage f selected x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_sqrt_le_bernoulliAverage_sqrt_harmonicTransform_internal
statement:
theorem expect_sqrt_le_bernoulliAverage_sqrt_harmonicTransform_internal {n : ℕ}
    {f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    (𝔼 x, Real.sqrt (f x)) ≤
      bernoulliAverage (1 / 4) (fun selected => Real.sqrt (harmonicTransform f selected))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_sqrt_pair_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_sqrt_pair_internal {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    (Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b) / 2 ≤
      3 / 4 * Real.sqrt ((a + b) / 2) + 1 / 4 * Real.sqrt (2 * a * b / (a + b))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicPair_le_midpoint_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicPair_le_midpoint_internal {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    2 * a * b / (a + b) ≤ (a + b) / 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicPair_mono_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicPair_mono_internal {a b c d : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hac : a ≤ c) (hbd : b ≤ d) : 2 * a * b / (a + b) ≤ 2 * c * d / (c + d)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_antitone_internal
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_concave_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_concave_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {f g : (ι → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht' : t ≤ 1) (selected : ι → Bool) :
    t * harmonicTransform f selected + (1 - t) * harmonicTransform g selected ≤

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_empty_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_empty_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : harmonicTransform f (fun _ => false) = 𝔼 x, f x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_full_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_full_internal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) : harmonicTransform f (fun _ => true) = harmonicMean f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_le_expect_internal
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_good_probability_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_good_probability_internal {n : ℕ}
    {f : (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (hmean : (𝔼 x, f x) = 1)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hbound : ∀ x, f x ≤ B) :
    1 / (2 * Real.sqrt B) ≤ bernoulliAverage (1 / 4)
      (fun selected => if 1 / (4 * B) ≤ harmonicTransform f selected then 1 else 0)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_coordinateMarginal_internal
statement:
theorem expect_coordinateMarginal_internal (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (selected : ι → Bool) :
    (𝔼 z, coordinateMarginal f selected z) = 𝔼 x, f x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicTransform_eq_harmonicMean_coordinateMarginal_internal
statement:
theorem harmonicTransform_eq_harmonicMean_coordinateMarginal_internal
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (selected : ι → Bool) :
    harmonicTransform f selected = harmonicMean (coordinateMarginal f selected)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.projectionAverage_eq_coordinateMarginal_internal
statement:
theorem projectionAverage_eq_coordinateMarginal_internal
    (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (selected x : ι → Bool) :
    projectionAverage f selected x = coordinateMarginal f selected (fun i => x i)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.coordinateMarginal_light_fraction_le
statement:
theorem coordinateMarginal_light_fraction_le {f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) (selected : ι → Bool) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (ha' : a ≤ harmonicTransform f selected) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    (𝔼 z, if coordinateMarginal f selected z ≤ b then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ b / a

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_coordinateMarginal
statement:
theorem expect_coordinateMarginal (f : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) (selected : ι → Bool) :

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.expect_sqrt_le_bernoulliAverage_sqrt_harmonicTransform
statement:
theorem expect_sqrt_le_bernoulliAverage_sqrt_harmonicTransform {n : ℕ}

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_light_fraction_le
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_light_fraction_le {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_mono
statement:
theorem harmonicMean_mono {f g : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    (hfg : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) : harmonicMean f ≤ harmonicMean g

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.harmonicMean_nonneg
statement:

statement:
theorem bad_modifications_probability_aux_internal (X : Finset (ι → Bool)) (hX : X.Nonempty)

    (hjoint : (p + q - p * q) * r = p * (1 - q)) :

      𝔼 x ∈ X, if (𝔼 y, if coordinateDensity X Q (resample P x y) <

        (𝔼 z, if coordinateMarginal (uniformDensity (coordinateFiber X s x)) R z ≤

    (hl : (𝔼 z, if coordinateMarginal (uniformDensity (coordinateFiber X s x)) R z ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (-128 * k - 2) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-64 * k)) :
    (𝔼 u, if coordinateDensity X (fun i => if h : s i = true then !R ⟨i, h⟩ else false)
      (completePattern s x u) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-194 * k) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤

    (hl : (𝔼 z, if coordinateMarginal

      (fun i => P i && !Q i) z ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-128 * k - 2) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤

    31 / 32 ≤ bernoulliAverage p (fun P => bernoulliAverage q (fun Q =>
      𝔼 x ∈ X, if (𝔼 y, if coordinateDensity X Q (resample P x y) <
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (-194 * k) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-k - 6) then 1 else 0))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.lowSpan_compl
statement:
theorem lowSpan_compl {q : Finset ι → ZMod 2} (hq : q ∈ lowSpan m) :
    (fun x => q xᶜ) ∈ lowSpan m

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.low_interpolation
statement:
theorem low_interpolation (f : Low ι m → ZMod 2) :
    ∃ q ∈ lowSpan (ι := ι) m, ∀ x : Low ι m, q x.val = f x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.majority_decomposition
statement:
theorem majority_decomposition (f : Finset (Fin (2 * m + 1)) → ZMod 2) :
    ∃ q ∈ lowSpan m, ∃ r ∈ lowSpan m,
      f = q + fun x => majority x * r x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.monomial_compl
statement:
theorem monomial_compl (a x : Finset ι) :
    monomial a xᶜ = ∑ b ∈ a.powerset, monomial b x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.monomial_empty
statement: theorem monomial_empty (x : Finset ι) : monomial ∅ x = 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.monomial_eq_prod
statement:
theorem monomial_eq_prod (a x : Finset ι) :
    monomial a x = ∏ i ∈ a, monomial {i} x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.monomial_union
statement:
theorem monomial_union (a b x : Finset ι) :
    monomial (a ∪ b) x = monomial a x * monomial b x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.restricted_monomials_span
statement:
theorem restricted_monomials_span (f : Low ι m → ZMod 2) :
    f ∈ Submodule.span (ZMod 2)
      (Set.range fun a : Low ι m => fun x : Low ι m => monomial a.val x.val)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.atomWeight_le
statement: theorem atomWeight_le (a : Atom m) : atomWeight a ≤ m + 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.atom_spans
statement:
theorem atom_spans (f : Finset (Fin (2 * m + 1)) → ZMod 2) :
    f ∈ Submodule.span (ZMod 2) (Set.range (atomEval (m := m)))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.lowSpan_map_mem
statement:
theorem lowSpan_map_mem {V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module (ZMod 2) V]
    (L : (Finset (Fin (2 * m + 1)) → ZMod 2) →ₗ[ZMod 2] V)
    (W : Submodule (ZMod 2) V)
    (h : ∀ a : Low (Fin (2 * m + 1)) m, L (monomial a.val) ∈ W)
    {q : Finset (Fin (2 * m + 1)) → ZMod 2} (hq : q ∈ lowSpan m) : L q ∈ W

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.majority_sq
statement:
theorem majority_sq (x : Finset (Fin (2 * m + 1))) :
    majority x * majority x = majority x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.product_mem_span
statement:
theorem product_mem_span (f : Fin k → Finset (Fin (2 * m + 1)) → ZMod 2) :
    (fun x : BlockCube k m => ∏ i, f i (x i)) ∈
      Submodule.span (ZMod 2) (Set.range (termEval (k := k) (m := m)))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.terms_span
statement:
theorem terms_span (f : BlockCube k m → ZMod 2) :
    f ∈ Submodule.span (ZMod 2) (Set.range (termEval (k := k) (m := m)))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.atom_variable_mem
statement:
theorem atom_variable_mem (a : Atom m) (j : Fin (2 * m + 1)) :
    (fun x => monomial {j} x * atomEval a x) ∈
      Submodule.span (ZMod 2)
        (Set.range fun b : {b : Atom m // atomWeight b ≤ atomWeight a + 1} =>
          atomEval b.val)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.filtration_mono
statement: theorem filtration_mono {s : ℕ} (h : r ≤ s) : filtration k m r ≤ filtration k m s

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.majority_mul_mem
statement:
theorem majority_mul_mem (W : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Finset (Fin (2 * m + 1)) → ZMod 2))
    (h : ∀ a : Low (Fin (2 * m + 1)) m, atomEval (a, true) ∈ W)
    (f : Finset (Fin (2 * m + 1)) → ZMod 2) :
    (fun x => majority x * f x) ∈ W

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.replaceFactor_atom
statement:
theorem replaceFactor_atom (a : Term k m) (i : Fin k) (b : Atom m) :
    replaceFactor a i (atomEval b) = termEval (Function.update a i b)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.span_map_mem
statement:
theorem span_map_mem {I V W : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module (ZMod 2) V]
    [AddCommMonoid W] [Module (ZMod 2) W] (v : I → V) (L : V →ₗ[ZMod 2] W)
    (U : Submodule (ZMod 2) W) (h : ∀ i, L (v i) ∈ U)
    {f : V} (hf : f ∈ Submodule.span (ZMod 2) (Set.range v)) : L f ∈ U

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.term_mem
statement:
theorem term_mem (a : Term k m) {r : ℕ} (h : weight a ≤ r) :
    termEval a ∈ filtration k m r

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.term_variable_mem
statement:
theorem term_variable_mem (a : Term k m) (i : Fin k) (j : Fin (2 * m + 1)) :
    (fun x => monomial {j} (x i) * termEval a x) ∈ filtration k m (weight a + 1)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.variable_mul_mem
statement:
theorem variable_mul_mem {f : BlockCube k m → ZMod 2} (hf : f ∈ filtration k m r)
    (i : Fin k) (j : Fin (2 * m + 1)) :
    (fun x => monomial {j} (x i) * f x) ∈ filtration k m (r + 1)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.weight_eq
statement:
theorem weight_eq (a : Term k m) (i : Fin k) :
    weight a = atomWeight (a i) + ∑ j ∈ univ.erase i, atomWeight (a j)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.weight_update
statement:
theorem weight_update (a : Term k m) (i : Fin k) (b : Atom m) :
    weight (Function.update a i b) =
      atomWeight b + ∑ j ∈ univ.erase i, atomWeight (a j)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.polynomial_mul_mem
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.variable_pow_mul_mem
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.variable_prod_mul_mem
statement:
theorem variable_prod_mul_mem {f : BlockCube k m → ZMod 2}
    (hf : f ∈ filtration k m r) (s : Finset (Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1)))
    (e : Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1) → ℕ) :
    (fun x => (∏ ij ∈ s, monomial {ij.2} (x ij.1) ^ e ij) * f x) ∈
      filtration k m (r + ∑ ij ∈ s, e ij)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.agreement_card_le
statement:
theorem agreement_card_le
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1)) (ZMod 2)) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ d)
    (E : Set (BlockCube k m)) (hE : ∀ x ∈ E, polynomialEval p x = xorMajority x) :
    Nat.card E ≤ Nat.card {a : Term k m // Allowed d a}

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.agreement_span
statement:
theorem agreement_span
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1)) (ZMod 2)) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ d)
    (E : Set (BlockCube k m)) (hE : ∀ x ∈ E, polynomialEval p x = xorMajority x) :
    Submodule.span (ZMod 2) (Set.range fun a : {a : Term k m // Allowed d a} =>
      restrictTo E (termEval a.val)) = ⊤

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.allowed_setFlag_false
statement:
theorem allowed_setFlag_false {a : Term k m} {i : Fin k} (h : pivot d a = some i) :
    Allowed d (setFlag a i false)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.allowed_setFlag_other
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.pivot_congr
statement:
theorem pivot_congr {a b : Term k m} (h : ∀ i, (a i).1 = (b i).1) :
    pivot d a = pivot d b

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.pivot_good
statement:
theorem pivot_good {a : Term k m} {i : Fin k} (h : pivot d a = some i) :
    (a i).1.val.card + d ≤ m

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.pivot_setFlag
statement:
theorem pivot_setFlag (a : Term k m) (i : Fin k) (b : Bool) :
    pivot d (setFlag a i b) = pivot d a

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.setFlag_first
statement:
theorem setFlag_first (a : Term k m) (i j : Fin k) (b : Bool) :
    (setFlag a i b j).1 = (a j).1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.setFlag_true_eq
statement:
theorem setFlag_true_eq {a : Term k m} {i : Fin k} (h : (a i).2 = true) :
    setFlag a i true = a

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.setFlag_twice
statement:
theorem setFlag_twice (a : Term k m) (i : Fin k) (b c : Bool) :
    setFlag (setFlag a i b) i c = setFlag a i c

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.term_setFlag
statement:
theorem term_setFlag (a : Term k m) (i : Fin k) (x : BlockCube k m) :
    termEval (setFlag a i true) x = termEval a x * majority (x i)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.weight_setFlag_drop
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.allowed_iff_of_pivot
statement:
theorem allowed_iff_of_pivot {a : Term k m} {i : Fin k} (h : pivot d a = some i) :
    Allowed d a ↔ (a i).2 = false

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.allowed_of_pivot_none
statement: theorem allowed_of_pivot_none {a : Term k m} (h : pivot d a = none) : Allowed d a

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.card_allowed
statement:
theorem card_allowed :
    2 * Nat.card {a : Term k m // Allowed d a} =
      Nat.card (Term k m) + Nat.card (ExceptionalAtom m d) ^ k

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.card_atom
statement: theorem card_atom : Nat.card (Atom m) = 2 ^ (2 * m + 1)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.card_term
statement: theorem card_term : Nat.card (Term k m) = Nat.card (BlockCube k m)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.compl_low
statement: theorem compl_low {x : Finset (Fin (2 * m + 1))} (hx : m < x.card) : xᶜ.card ≤ m

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.low_compl_high
statement: theorem low_compl_high (a : Low (Fin (2 * m + 1)) m) : m < a.valᶜ.card

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.pivot_none_iff
statement:
theorem pivot_none_iff (a : Term k m) :
    pivot d a = none ↔ ∀ i, m < (a i).1.val.card + d

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.pivot_toggle
statement: theorem pivot_toggle (a : Term k m) : pivot d (toggle d a) = pivot d a

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.toggle_involutive
statement: theorem toggle_involutive : Function.Involutive (toggle (k := k) (m := m) d)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.twice_agreement_card_le
statement:
theorem twice_agreement_card_le
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1)) (ZMod 2)) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ d)
    (E : Set (BlockCube k m)) (hE : ∀ x ∈ E, polynomialEval p x = xorMajority x) :
    2 * Nat.card E ≤ Nat.card (BlockCube k m) + Nat.card (ExceptionalAtom m d) ^ k

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.centralBinom_sq_bound
statement:
theorem centralBinom_sq_bound (m : ℕ) :
    (3 * (m : ℝ) + 1) * (Nat.centralBinom m : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (16 : ℝ) ^ m

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.exceptional_card_le
statement:
theorem exceptional_card_le (m d : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (ExceptionalAtom m d) ≤ 2 * d * (2 * m + 1).choose m

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.exceptional_fraction_le
statement:
theorem exceptional_fraction_le (m d : ℕ) :
    (Nat.card (ExceptionalAtom m d) : ℝ) / 2 ^ (2 * m + 1) ≤
      2 * d / Real.sqrt (2 * m + 1)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.middle_choose_le
statement:
theorem middle_choose_le (m : ℕ) :
    ((2 * m + 1).choose m : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * m + 1) / Real.sqrt (2 * m + 1)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.middle_choose_sq_bound
statement:
theorem middle_choose_sq_bound (m : ℕ) :
    (2 * (m : ℝ) + 1) * ((2 * m + 1).choose m : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * m + 1)) ^ 2

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.add_one_eq_iff
statement: theorem add_one_eq_iff (a b : ZMod 2) : a + 1 = b ↔ a ≠ b

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.correlation_eq_card
statement:
theorem correlation_eq_card {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (f g : α → ZMod 2) :
    correlation f g =
      |(2 * (Nat.card {x // f x = g x} : ℝ) - Nat.card α) / Nat.card α|

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.correlation_finite_bound
statement:
theorem correlation_finite_bound
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1)) (ZMod 2)) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    correlation (polynomialEval p) xorMajority ≤
      ((Nat.card (ExceptionalAtom m d) : ℝ) / 2 ^ (2 * m + 1)) ^ k

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.bitsToBlocks_blockBits
statement: theorem bitsToBlocks_blockBits (x : BlockCube k m) : bitsToBlocks (blockBits x) = x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.blockBits_bitsToBlocks
statement:
theorem blockBits_bitsToBlocks (x : Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1) → ZMod 2) :
    blockBits (bitsToBlocks x) = x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.correlation_bits_bound
statement:
theorem correlation_bits_bound
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1)) (ZMod 2)) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    correlation xorMajorityBits (fun x => MvPolynomial.eval x p) ≤
      (2 * d / Real.sqrt (2 * m + 1)) ^ k

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.correlation_comm
statement:
theorem correlation_comm {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (f g : α → ZMod 2) :
    correlation f g = correlation g f

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.correlation_equiv
statement:
theorem correlation_equiv {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (e : α ≃ β) (f g : β → ZMod 2) :
    correlation (fun x => f (e x)) (fun x => g (e x)) = correlation f g

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.correlation_middleBand_bound
statement:
theorem correlation_middleBand_bound
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1)) (ZMod 2)) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    correlation xorMajority (polynomialEval p) ≤
      (2 * (middleBandCount m d : ℝ) / 2 ^ (2 * m + 1)) ^ k

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.correlation_sqrt_bound
statement:
theorem correlation_sqrt_bound
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1)) (ZMod 2)) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    correlation xorMajority (polynomialEval p) ≤ (2 * d / Real.sqrt (2 * m + 1)) ^ k

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.Internal.exceptional_card_eq
statement:
theorem exceptional_card_eq (m d : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (ExceptionalAtom m d) = 2 * middleBandCount m d

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.low_interpolation
statement:
theorem low_interpolation {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : Low ι m → ZMod 2) :
    ∃ q ∈ lowSpan (ι := ι) m, ∀ x : Low ι m, q x.val = f x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.majority_decomposition
statement:
theorem majority_decomposition (f : Finset (Fin (2 * m + 1)) → ZMod 2) :
    ∃ q ∈ lowSpan m, ∃ r ∈ lowSpan m, f = q + fun x => majority x * r x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.polynomial_mul_mem
statement:
theorem polynomial_mul_mem {f : BlockCube k m → ZMod 2} (hf : f ∈ filtration k m r)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1)) (ZMod 2)) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    (fun x => polynomialEval p x * f x) ∈ filtration k m (r + d)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.xorMajorityBits_correlation_le
statement:
theorem xorMajorityBits_correlation_le
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1)) (ZMod 2)) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    correlation xorMajorityBits (fun x => MvPolynomial.eval x p) ≤
      (2 * d / Real.sqrt (2 * m + 1)) ^ k

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.xorMajority_correlation_le
statement:
theorem xorMajority_correlation_le
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1)) (ZMod 2)) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    correlation xorMajority (polynomialEval p) ≤ (2 * d / Real.sqrt (2 * m + 1)) ^ k

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.PolynomialCorrelation.xorMajority_correlation_le_middleBand
statement:
theorem xorMajority_correlation_le_middleBand
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin k × Fin (2 * m + 1)) (ZMod 2)) (hp : p.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    correlation xorMajority (polynomialEval p) ≤
      (2 * (middleBandCount m d : ℝ) / 2 ^ (2 * m + 1)) ^ k

name: Complexity.BP.eval_append
statement:
theorem eval_append {w : ℕ} (α : ℕ → Bool) (p q : BP w) :
    eval α (p ++ q) = eval α p * eval α q

name: Complexity.BP.eval_cons
statement:
theorem eval_cons {w : ℕ} (α : ℕ → Bool) (ins : BPInstr w) (p : BP w) :
    eval α (ins :: p) = BPInstr.eval α ins * eval α p

name: Complexity.BP.eval_eq_of_agree
statement:
theorem BP.eval_eq_of_agree {w : ℕ} (p : BP w) (α β : ℕ → Bool)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ BP.vars p, α i = β i) : BP.eval α p = BP.eval β p

name: Complexity.BP.eval_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem eval_nil {w : ℕ} (α : ℕ → Bool) : eval α ([] : BP w) = 1

name: Complexity.BP.eval_rename
statement:
theorem BP.eval_rename {w : ℕ} (α : ℕ → Bool) (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (p : BP w) :
    BP.eval α (BP.rename σ p) = BP.eval (α ∘ σ) p

name: Complexity.BP.eval_singleton
statement:
theorem eval_singleton {w : ℕ} (α : ℕ → Bool) (ins : BPInstr w) :
    eval α [ins] = BPInstr.eval α ins

name: Complexity.BPInstr.eval_eq_of_agree
statement:
theorem BPInstr.eval_eq_of_agree {w : ℕ} (ins : BPInstr w) (α β : ℕ → Bool)
    (h : α ins.var = β ins.var) : BPInstr.eval α ins = BPInstr.eval β ins

name: Complexity.BPInstr.eval_rename
statement:
theorem BPInstr.eval_rename {w : ℕ} (α : ℕ → Bool) (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (ins : BPInstr w) :
    BPInstr.eval α (BPInstr.rename σ ins) = BPInstr.eval (α ∘ σ) ins

name: Complexity.BP.Computes_and
Complexity.BP.Computes_conj

name: Complexity.BP.Computes_false
statement:
theorem BP.Computes_false {w : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin w)) :

name: Complexity.BP.Computes_not
Complexity.BP.Computes_not_compact
Complexity.BP.Computes_or

name: Complexity.BP.Computes_var
statement:
theorem BP.Computes_var {w : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin w)) (i : ℕ) :

name: Complexity.BP.eval_conjugate
statement:
theorem BP.eval_conjugate {w : ℕ} (α : ℕ → Bool)
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin w)) (p : BP w) :
    BP.eval α (BP.conjugate τ p) = τ * BP.eval α p * τ⁻¹

name: Complexity.BP.eval_inverse
statement:
theorem BP.eval_inverse {w : ℕ} (α : ℕ → Bool) (p : BP w) :
    BP.eval α (BP.inverse p) = (BP.eval α p)⁻¹

theorem BP.eval_postMul {w : ℕ} (α : ℕ → Bool) (p : BP w)

    (c : Equiv.Perm (Fin w)) :

name: Complexity.BPInstr.eval_conjugate
statement:
@[simp] theorem BPInstr.eval_conjugate {w : ℕ} (α : ℕ → Bool)

    BPInstr.eval α (BPInstr.const c) = c

name: Complexity.BPInstr.eval_inverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem BPInstr.eval_inverse {w : ℕ} (α : ℕ → Bool) (ins : BPInstr w) :
    BPInstr.eval α (BPInstr.inverse ins) = (BPInstr.eval α ins)⁻¹

name: Complexity.BPInstr.eval_postMul
statement:
@[simp] theorem BPInstr.eval_postMul {w : ℕ} (α : ℕ → Bool)
    (ins : BPInstr w) (c : Equiv.Perm (Fin w)) :
    BPInstr.eval α (BPInstr.postMul ins c) = BPInstr.eval α ins * c

name: Complexity.conj_isCycle_orderOf_five
statement:
theorem conj_isCycle_orderOf_five {a : Perm (Fin 5)} (h : a.IsCycle ∧ orderOf a = 5)
    (g : Perm (Fin 5)) : (g * a * g⁻¹).IsCycle ∧ orderOf (g * a * g⁻¹) = 5

name: Complexity.every_fiveCycle_is_commutator
statement:
theorem every_fiveCycle_is_commutator (c : Perm (Fin 5)) (hc : c.IsCycle)
    (hco : orderOf c = 5) :
    ∃ a b : Perm (Fin 5),
      a.IsCycle ∧ orderOf a = 5 ∧ b.IsCycle ∧ orderOf b = 5 ∧ ⁅a, b⁆ = c

name: Complexity.exists_fiveCycle_commutator

theorem abs_sumOn_le_of_budget [Finite ι] [Finite U] (hP : P.Coherent) (hL : 0 < P.length)
    {KL KR : ℕ} (hKL : 1 < KL) (hKR : 1 < KR)
    {w cost : (ι → U) → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hw : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ a)
    (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ cost x) (hrect : RectangleBudget w cost KL KR) :
    |sumOn w S| ≤ sumOn cost S + a * ((KL - 1) * (KR - 1) * P.transitionCount : ℕ)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.transitionCount_erase_le
statement:
theorem transitionCount_erase_le [Finite ι] [Finite U]

name: Complexity.Frontier.abs_sumOn_le
statement:
theorem abs_sumOn_le [Finite α] {w : α → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (hw : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ a) (S : Set α) :

name: Complexity.Frontier.sumOn_empty

name: Complexity.Frontier.sumOn_nonneg

name: Complexity.Frontier.sumOn_sdiff
statement:
theorem sumOn_sdiff [Finite α] (w : α → ℝ) {S T : Set α} (h : T ⊆ S) :

name: Complexity.Frontier.RectangleBias.abs_sumOn_le_of_dependsOn
statement:
theorem RectangleBias.abs_sumOn_le_of_dependsOn [Finite ι] [Finite U]
    {f : (ι → U) → Bool} {K : ℕ} {β : ℝ} (hf : RectangleBias f K β)
    (hK : 1 < K) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) {S : Set (ι → U)} {R : Set ι}
    (hR : DependsOn (· ∈ S) R) (hle : K ≤ Nat.card U ^ Rᶜ.ncard) :
    |sumOn (fun x => boolSign (f x)) S| ≤ β * S.ncard + (Nat.card U * K ^ 2 : ℕ)

name: Complexity.Frontier.abs_boolSign

name: Complexity.Frontier.agreement_le_of_output_bias
statement:
theorem agreement_le_of_output_bias [Finite α] [Nonempty α] (f g : α → Bool) {β R : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ b : Bool, |sumOn (fun x => boolSign (f x)) {x | g x = b}| ≤
      β * ({x | g x = b}.ncard : ℝ) + R) :
    agreement f g ≤ (1 + β) / 2 + R / Nat.card α

name: Complexity.Frontier.agreement_not
statement:
theorem agreement_not [Finite α] [Nonempty α] (f g : α → Bool) :
    agreement (fun x => !(f x)) g = 1 - agreement f g

name: Complexity.Frontier.boolSign_not

name: Complexity.Frontier.sign_sum_eq
statement:
theorem sign_sum_eq [Finite α] (f g : α → Bool) :
    sumOn (fun x => boolSign (f x) * boolSign (g x)) univ =
      2 * ({x | f x = g x}.ncard : ℝ) - Nat.card α

name: Complexity.Frontier.sign_sum_split
statement:
theorem sign_sum_split [Finite α] (f g : α → Bool) :
    sumOn (fun x => boolSign (f x) * boolSign (g x)) univ =
      sumOn (fun x => boolSign (f x)) {x | g x = true} -
        sumOn (fun x => boolSign (f x)) {x | g x = false}

name: Complexity.Frontier.sumOn_congr
statement:

name: Complexity.Frontier.sumOn_const

    (hM₂ : ∀ i ∈ S₂, ∀ j ∈ T, j ∉ T₂ → M i j = 0) :

name: Complexity.Correlation.sq_sum_bilinear_mul_two_pow_rank_le
statement:
theorem sq_sum_bilinear_mul_two_pow_rank_le [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α]
    [DecidableEq β] (B : Matrix α β (ZMod 2)) (P : Finset (α → ZMod 2))
    (Q : Finset (β → ZMod 2)) (g : (α → ZMod 2) → ℝ) (h : (β → ZMod 2) → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ p, |g p| ≤ 1) (hh : ∀ q, |h q| ≤ 1) :
    (∑ p ∈ P, ∑ q ∈ Q, g p * h q * zsign (p ⬝ᵥ B.mulVec q)) ^ 2 * 2 ^ B.rank ≤
      P.card * Q.card * 2 ^ Fintype.card α * 2 ^ Fintype.card β

name: Complexity.Correlation.quad_merge
statement:
theorem quad_merge [Fintype ι] [Fintype X] [Fintype ↥Xᶜ] (Q : Matrix ι ι (ZMod 2))
    (u : X → ZMod 2) (v : ↥Xᶜ → ZMod 2) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, Q i j * merge X u v i * merge X u v j =
      (∑ i : X, ∑ j : X, Q i j * u i * u j) + (∑ i : ↥Xᶜ, ∑ j : ↥Xᶜ, Q i j * v i * v j) +
        u ⬝ᵥ (cutMatrix Q X).mulVec v

    {M : Type*} [Fintype M] [DecidableEq M] (msg : (ι → Bool) → M) (X : Set ι)
    (hg : ∀ x y, msg x = msg y → g x = g y)
    (hrect : ∀ x₀, ∃ (A : Set (X → Bool)) (B : Set (↥Xᶜ → Bool)),
      {x | msg x = msg x₀} = rectangle X A B) :
    (2 * agreement (quadForm Q) g - 1) ^ 2 * 2 ^ cutRank Q X ≤ Fintype.card M

name: Complexity.TM.exists_reachesIn_of_rewindStep_frame
statement:
theorem exists_reachesIn_of_rewindStep_frame (tm : TM n)
    {rewindState targetState : tm.Q}
    (h_step_left : ∀ c : Cfg n tm.Q,
      c.state = rewindState →
      c.output.read ≠ Γ.start →
      c.output.cells 0 = Γ.start → (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.output.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      c.input.head ≥ 1 → (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.input.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      (∀ i, (c.work i).head ≥ 1) → (∀ i j, j ≥ 1 → (c.work i).cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      ∃ c', tm.step c = some c' ∧
        c'.state = rewindState ∧
        c'.output.head = c.output.head - 1 ∧
        c'.output.cells = c.output.cells ∧
        c'.input = c.input ∧ c'.work = c.work)
    (h_step_base : ∀ c : Cfg n tm.Q,
      c.state = rewindState →
      c.output.read = Γ.start →
      c.output.cells 0 = Γ.start → (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.output.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      c.input.head ≥ 1 → (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.input.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      (∀ i, (c.work i).head ≥ 1) → (∀ i j, j ≥ 1 → (c.work i).cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      ∃ c', tm.step c = some c' ∧
        c'.state = targetState ∧
        c'.output.head = 1 ∧
        c'.output.cells = c.output.cells ∧
        c'.input = c.input ∧ c'.work = c.work) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (c : Cfg n tm.Q),
    c.state = rewindState →
    c.output.cells 0 = Γ.start →
    (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.output.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
    c.output.head = p →
    c.input.head ≥ 1 → (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.input.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
    (∀ i, (c.work i).head ≥ 1) → (∀ i j, j ≥ 1 → (c.work i).cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
    ∃ c_target,
      tm.reachesIn (p + 1) c c_target ∧
      c_target.state = targetState ∧
      c_target.output.head = 1 ∧
      c_target.output.cells = c.output.cells ∧
      c_target.input = c.input ∧
      c_target.work = c.work

name: Complexity.TM.exists_reachesIn_of_rewindStep_output
statement:
theorem exists_reachesIn_of_rewindStep_output (tm : TM n)
    {rewindState targetState : tm.Q}
    (h_step_left : ∀ c : Cfg n tm.Q,
      c.state = rewindState →
      c.output.read ≠ Γ.start →
      c.output.cells 0 = Γ.start →
      (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.output.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      ∃ c', tm.step c = some c' ∧
        c'.state = rewindState ∧
        c'.output.head = c.output.head - 1 ∧
        c'.output.cells = c.output.cells)
    (h_step_base : ∀ c : Cfg n tm.Q,
      c.state = rewindState →
      c.output.read = Γ.start →
      c.output.cells 0 = Γ.start →
      (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.output.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      ∃ c', tm.step c = some c' ∧
        c'.state = targetState ∧
        c'.output.head = 1 ∧
        c'.output.cells = c.output.cells) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (c : Cfg n tm.Q),
    c.state = rewindState →
    c.output.cells 0 = Γ.start →
    (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → c.output.cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
    c.output.head = p →
    ∃ c_target,
      tm.reachesIn (p + 1) c c_target ∧
      c_target.state = targetState ∧
      c_target.output.head = 1 ∧
      c_target.output.cells = c.output.cells

name: Complexity.TM.exists_reachesIn_of_rewindStep_tape
statement:
theorem exists_reachesIn_of_rewindStep_tape (tm : TM n) (tape : Cfg n tm.Q → Tape)
    {rewindState targetState : tm.Q}
    (h_step_left : ∀ c : Cfg n tm.Q,
      c.state = rewindState →
      (tape c).read ≠ Γ.start →
      (tape c).cells 0 = Γ.start →
      (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → (tape c).cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      ∃ c', tm.step c = some c' ∧
        c'.state = rewindState ∧
        (tape c').head = (tape c).head - 1 ∧
        (tape c').cells = (tape c).cells)
    (h_step_base : ∀ c : Cfg n tm.Q,
      c.state = rewindState →
      (tape c).read = Γ.start →
      (tape c).cells 0 = Γ.start →
      (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → (tape c).cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
      ∃ c', tm.step c = some c' ∧
        c'.state = targetState ∧
        (tape c').head = 1 ∧
        (tape c').cells = (tape c).cells) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (c : Cfg n tm.Q),
    c.state = rewindState →
    (tape c).cells 0 = Γ.start →
    (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → (tape c).cells j ≠ Γ.start) →
    (tape c).head = p →
    ∃ c_target,
      tm.reachesIn (p + 1) c c_target ∧
      c_target.state = targetState ∧
      (tape c_target).head = 1 ∧
      (tape c_target).cells = (tape c).cells

Complexity.NTM.HoareTime.exists_first_halt_time
statement:
theorem HoareTime.exists_first_halt_time {tm : NTM n}
    {pre post : TapePred n} {bound : ℕ}
    (h : tm.HoareTime pre post bound)
    {inp : Tape} {work : Fin n → Tape} {out : Tape}
    (hpre : pre inp work out) (choices : Fin bound → Bool) :
    ∃ t, ∃ ht : t ≤ bound,
      tm.halted (tm.trace t (fun i => choices (Fin.castLE ht i))
        { state := tm.qstart, input := inp, work := work, output := out }) ∧
      ∀ s, (hs : s < t) →
        ¬ tm.halted (tm.trace s
          (fun i => choices (Fin.castLE (le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt hs) ht) i))
          { state := tm.qstart, input := inp, work := work, output := out })

                           (work = fun _ => Tape.init []) ∧

name: Complexity.TM.AllTapesWF.transition
statement:
theorem AllTapesWF.transition {inp : Tape} {work : Fin n → Tape} {out : Tape}
    (h : AllTapesWF inp work out) :
    (transitionInput inp).head ≥ 1 ∧
    (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → (transitionInput inp).cells j ≠ Γ.start) ∧
    (∀ i, (transitionTape (work i)).head ≥ 1) ∧
    (∀ i j, j ≥ 1 → (transitionTape (work i)).cells j ≠ Γ.start) ∧
    (transitionTape out).cells = out.cells ∧
    (transitionTape out).head ≥ 1

statement:
theorem complementTM_hoareTime (tm : TM n)
    {pre : TapePred n} {b p_bound : ℕ}
    {cell1_pred : Γ → Prop}
    (h_tm : tm.HoareTime pre
      (fun _ _ out =>
        out.cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → out.cells j ≠ Γ.start) ∧
        out.head ≤ p_bound ∧
        cell1_pred (out.cells 1))
      b) :
    tm.complementTM.HoareTime pre
      (fun _ _ out => ∃ g, cell1_pred g ∧ out.cells 1 = (flipBit g).toΓ)
      (b + p_bound + 4)

name: Complexity.TM.ifTM_hoareTime
statement:
theorem ifTM_hoareTime (tmTest tmThen tmElse : TM n)
    {pre mid_test mid_then mid_else post_then post_else post : TapePred n}
    {b_test b_then b_else p_bound : ℕ}
    (h_test : tmTest.HoareTime pre mid_test b_test)
    (h_wf : ∀ inp work out, mid_test inp work out → AllTapesWF inp work out)
    (h_head : ∀ inp work out, mid_test inp work out → out.head ≤ p_bound)
    (h_to_then : ∀ inp work out, mid_test inp work out → out.cells 1 = Γ.one →
      mid_then (transitionInput inp) (fun i => transitionTape (work i))
               ⟨1, out.cells⟩)
    (h_to_else : ∀ inp work out, mid_test inp work out → out.cells 1 ≠ Γ.one →
      mid_else (transitionInput inp) (fun i => transitionTape (work i))
               ⟨1, out.cells⟩)
    (h_then : tmThen.HoareTime mid_then post_then b_then)
    (h_else : tmElse.HoareTime mid_else post_else b_else)
    (h_post_then : ∀ inp work out, post_then inp work out →
      post (transitionInput inp) (fun i => transitionTape (work i))
           (transitionTape out))
    (h_post_else : ∀ inp work out, post_else inp work out →
      post (transitionInput inp) (fun i => transitionTape (work i))
           (transitionTape out)) :
    (ifTM tmTest tmThen tmElse).HoareTime pre post
      (b_test + p_bound + max b_then b_else + 5)

name: Complexity.TM.loopTM_hoareTime
statement:
theorem loopTM_hoareTime (tmBody tmTest : TM n)
    {inv post : TapePred n} {b_iter k : ℕ}
    {variant : Tape → (Fin n → Tape) → Tape → ℕ}
    (h_variant_bound : ∀ inp work out, inv inp work out → variant inp work out ≤ k)
    (h_iter : ∀ inp work out, inv inp work out →
      (∃ c' t, t ≤ b_iter ∧
        (loopTM tmBody tmTest).reachesIn t
          ⟨(loopTM tmBody tmTest).qstart, inp, work, out⟩ c' ∧
        (loopTM tmBody tmTest).halted c' ∧
        post c'.input c'.work c'.output)
      ∨
      (∃ inp' work' out' t, t ≤ b_iter ∧
        (loopTM tmBody tmTest).reachesIn t
          ⟨(loopTM tmBody tmTest).qstart, inp, work, out⟩
          ⟨(loopTM tmBody tmTest).qstart, inp', work', out'⟩ ∧
        inv inp' work' out' ∧
        variant inp' work' out' < variant inp work out)) :
    (loopTM tmBody tmTest).HoareTime inv post ((k + 1) * b_iter)

      (fun inp work out =>
        inp = { head := 1, cells := (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).cells } ∧
        (∀ i, IsReg 0 (work i)) ∧ OutAcc [] out)
      1

name: Complexity.TM.emitBitsTM_hoareTime
statement:
theorem emitBitsTM_hoareTime (w : List Bool) (inp₀ : Tape) (work₀ : Fin n → Tape)
    (ys : List Bool) (hinp₀ : Parked inp₀) (hwork₀ : ∀ i, Parked (work₀ i)) :
    (emitBitsTM (n := n) w).HoareTime
      (fun inp work out => inp = inp₀ ∧ work = work₀ ∧ OutAcc ys out)
      (fun inp work out => inp = inp₀ ∧ work = work₀ ∧ OutAcc (ys ++ w) out)
      w.length

name: Complexity.TM.emitBitsTM_reachesIn_frame
statement:
theorem emitBitsTM_reachesIn_frame (w : List Bool) (inp₀ : Tape)
    (work₀ : Fin n → Tape) (out₀ : Tape) (ys : List Bool)
    (hinp₀ : Parked inp₀) (hwork₀ : ∀ i, Parked (work₀ i))
    (hout₀ : OutAcc ys out₀) :
    ∃ c',
      (emitBitsTM (n := n) w).reachesIn w.length
        { state := (emitBitsTM (n := n) w).qstart
          input := inp₀
          work := work₀
          output := out₀ } c' ∧
      (emitBitsTM (n := n) w).halted c' ∧
      c'.input = inp₀ ∧
      c'.work = work₀ ∧
      OutAcc (ys ++ w) c'.output

name: Complexity.TM.emitLitTM_hoareTime
statement:
theorem emitLitTM_hoareTime (s : Bool) (r : Fin n) (v : ℕ) (inp₀ : Tape)

    (hwork₀ : ∀ i, i ≠ r → Parked (work₀ i)) (hreg : IsReg v (work₀ r)) :
    (emitLitTM s r).HoareTime
      (EmitPred inp₀ work₀ ys)
      (EmitPred inp₀ work₀
        (ys ++ ([s, s] ++ List.replicate (2 * v) true ++ [false, true])))
      (3 * v + 9)

name: Complexity.TM.emitPred_transition
statement:

    (hinp₀ : Parked inp₀) (hworkAll : ∀ i, Parked (work₀ i)) (ys : List Bool) :
    ∀ inp work out, EmitPred inp₀ work₀ ys inp work out →
      EmitPred inp₀ work₀ ys (transitionInput inp)
        (fun i => transitionTape (work i)) (transitionTape out)

statement:
theorem emitUnaryTM_hoareTime (r : Fin n) (v : ℕ) (inp₀ : Tape) (work₀ : Fin n → Tape)
    (ys : List Bool) (hinp₀ : Parked inp₀) (hwork₀ : ∀ i, i ≠ r → Parked (work₀ i))
    (hreg : IsReg v (work₀ r)) :
    (emitUnaryTM (n := n) r).HoareTime

name: Complexity.Frontier.eventually_lt_of_demand
statement:
theorem eventually_lt_of_demand {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ η₀ > 0, ∀ η, 0 < η → η ≤ η₀ → ∀ (C : ℝ) (e : ℕ → ℝ), e =o[atTop] (fun n => (n : ℝ)) →
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ s v w : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ v → v ≤ κ * (n + s + 1) →
        (n : ℝ) ≤ w + e n + κ * Real.log (v + 1) →
        w ≤ (A + η) * (s - n + e n) + η * v + C →
        (1 + 1 / A - ε) * n < s

name: Complexity.Frontier.isLittleO_log_affine
statement:
theorem isLittleO_log_affine {α β : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hβ : 1 ≤ β) :
    (fun n : ℕ => Real.log (α * n + β)) =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ)

name: Complexity.Frontier.div_two_pow_le_of_logb
statement:
theorem div_two_pow_le_of_logb {x γ : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (h : Real.logb 2 x ≤ (1 - γ) * n) :
    x / (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-γ * n)

name: Complexity.Frontier.eventually_frontier_log_error
statement:
theorem eventually_frontier_log_error {A ε γ : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hγ1 : γ < 1) (hγε : γ < A * ε) (K : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hK : (fun n => Real.log (K n)) =o[atTop] fun n => (n : ℝ)) :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      1 + 2 * Real.logb 2 (K n) ≤ (1 - γ) * n ∧
      ∀ s v w : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ v → s ≤ (1 + 1 / A - ε) * n → v ≤ 4 * s + 3 →
        w ≤ (A + η) * (s - n + Real.logb 2 (K n) + 1) + η * v + C →
        w + 4 + 3 * Real.logb 2 (K n) + Real.logb 2 (v + 1) ≤ (1 - γ) * n

theorem finrank_states [FiniteDimensional F W] :

      finrank F (LinearMap.range L) + finrank F (LinearMap.range R) -
        finrank F (LinearMap.range L ⊔ LinearMap.range R : Submodule F W)

        finrank F (LinearMap.range L ⊔ LinearMap.range R : Submodule F W))

        completions L R x = completions L R x') :
    (L '' {x | (completions L R x).Nonempty}).ncard ≤
      (code '' {x | (completions L R x).Nonempty}).ncard

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.abs_sumOn_le_codes
statement:
theorem abs_sumOn_le_codes (hP : P.Coherent) (hL : 0 < P.length)
    {D : ℕ → Type*} (code : ∀ t, (ι → U) → D t) (C : ∀ t, Set (D t))
    (hC : ∀ t < P.length, (C t).Finite)
    (hmem : ∀ t < P.length, ∀ x ∈ S, code t x ∈ C t)
    (hdet : ∀ t < P.length, ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S,
      code t x = code t y → P.transition t x = P.transition t y)
    {KL KR : ℕ} (hKL : 1 < KL) (hKR : 1 < KR)
    {w cost : (ι → U) → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hw : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ a)
    (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ cost x) (hrect : Frontier.RectangleBudget w cost KL KR) :
    |Frontier.sumOn w S| ≤ Frontier.sumOn cost S +
      a * ((KL - 1) * (KR - 1) * ∑ t ∈ Finset.range P.length, (C t).ncard : ℕ)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.transitionCount_le_codes
statement:
theorem transitionCount_le_codes {D : ℕ → Type*}
    (code : ∀ t, (ι → U) → D t) (C : ∀ t, Set (D t))
    (hC : ∀ t < P.length, (C t).Finite)
    (hmem : ∀ t < P.length, ∀ x ∈ S, code t x ∈ C t)
    (hdet : ∀ t < P.length, ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S,
      code t x = code t y → P.transition t x = P.transition t y) :
    P.transitionCount ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range P.length, (C t).ncard

name: Complexity.Frontier.Sweep.transitionCount_le_linear_codes
statement:
theorem transitionCount_le_linear_codes (L : ℕ → (ι → F) →ₗ[F] W)
    (hdet : ∀ t < P.length, ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S,
      L t x = L t y → P.transition t x = P.transition t y) :
    P.transitionCount ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range P.length,
      Nat.card F ^ Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range (L t))

name: Complexity.Frontier.LayoutBound.exists_layout_componentwise
statement:
theorem LayoutBound.exists_layout_componentwise {d : ℕ} {A : ℝ} (h : LayoutBound d A) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (V E : Type) [Finite V] [Finite E] (G : Multigraph V E),
      G.Loopless → G.MaxDegreeLE d →
        ∃ π : Layout V, ∀ t (ht : t < Nat.card V), ∃ W : Set V,
          π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩ ∈ W ∧ G.cut W = ∅ ∧ W.ncard ≤ (G.touching W).ncard + 1 ∧
          G.cut (π.initial t) ⊆ G.touching W ∧ G.cut (π.initial (t + 1)) ⊆ G.touching W ∧
          ((G.cut (π.initial t)).ncard : ℝ) ≤
            (A + η) * G.cycleRankOn W + η * Nat.card V + C ∧
          ((G.cut (π.initial (t + 1))).ncard : ℝ) ≤
            (A + η) * G.cycleRankOn W + η * Nat.card V + C

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_kernel_mul_ge
statement:
theorem sum_kernel_mul_ge (degree : ∀ v, H.degree v ≤ 3) (q : ℝ) (R : ℕ) {u v : W}
    (huv : H.Adj u v) :
    2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) * ((∑ z, kernel H q R u z ^ 2) + ∑ z, kernel H q R v z ^ 2) / 2 -
        3 * (2 * q ^ 2) ^ R ≤ ∑ z, kernel H q R u z * kernel H q R v z

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_kernel_mul_ge_degree
statement:
theorem sum_kernel_mul_ge_degree {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (degree : ∀ v, H.degree v ≤ D)
    (q : ℝ) (R : ℕ) {u v : W}
    (huv : H.Adj u v) :
    2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) * ((∑ z, kernel H q R u z ^ 2) + ∑ z, kernel H q R v z ^ 2) / 2 -
        D * ((D - 1 : ℕ) * q ^ 2) ^ R ≤ ∑ z, kernel H q R u z * kernel H q R v z

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_unitKernel_mul_ge

theorem sum_unitKernel_mul_ge (degree : ∀ v, H.degree v ≤ 3) {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (R : ℕ)
    {u v : W} (huv : H.Adj u v) :
    2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) - 3 * (2 * q ^ 2) ^ R ≤
      ∑ z, unitKernel H q R u z * unitKernel H q R v z

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_unitKernel_mul_ge_degree
statement:

    {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (R : ℕ)
    {u v : W} (huv : H.Adj u v) :
    2 * q / (1 + q ^ 2) - D * ((D - 1 : ℕ) * q ^ 2) ^ R ≤
      ∑ z, unitKernel H q R u z * unitKernel H q R v z

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_unitKernel_sq
statement: theorem sum_unitKernel_sq (q : ℝ) (R : ℕ) (v : W) : ∑ z, unitKernel H q R v z ^ 2 = 1

name: Complexity.Frontier.LocalLayout.cutSize_improve_cubic_le
statement:
theorem cutSize_improve_cubic_le (I : Finset V)
    (hI : ∀ e, ¬(G.src e ∈ I ∧ G.tgt e ∈ I))
    (edges : ∀ v, Fin 3 ≃ G.edgesAt v) (key : V → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    G.cutSize (fun v => decide (improve I
      (fun v i => G.otherEnd v (edges v i).1) key v < t)) ≤
        G.cutSize (fun v => decide (key v < t))

name: Complexity.Frontier.LocalLayout.cutSize_improve_le
statement:
theorem cutSize_improve_le (I : Finset V) (hI : ∀ e, ¬(G.src e ∈ I ∧ G.tgt e ∈ I))
    (neighbours : V → Fin 3 → V)
    (hstar : ∀ v ∈ I, ∀ c : V → Bool,
      G.localCut c v = disagreements3 (c v) (fun i => c (neighbours v i)))
    (hout : ∀ v ∈ I, ∀ i, neighbours v i ∉ I) (key : V → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    G.cutSize (fun v => decide (improve I neighbours key v < t)) ≤
      G.cutSize (fun v => decide (key v < t))

name: Complexity.Frontier.LocalLayout.disagreements_median3_le
statement:
theorem disagreements_median3_le (k : Fin 3 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (c : Bool) :
    disagreements3 (decide (median3 (k 0) (k 1) (k 2) < t)) (fun i => decide (k i < t)) ≤
      disagreements3 c (fun i => decide (k i < t))

name: Complexity.Frontier.LocalLayout.improve_of_mem
statement:
theorem improve_of_mem {I : Finset V} (neighbours : V → Fin 3 → V) (key : V → ℝ)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ I) : improve I neighbours key v =
      median3 (key (neighbours v 0)) (key (neighbours v 1)) (key (neighbours v 2))

name: Complexity.Frontier.LocalLayout.improve_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem improve_of_not_mem {I : Finset V} (neighbours : V → Fin 3 → V) (key : V → ℝ)

statement:

    (c c' : V → Bool) (hfix : ∀ v, v ∉ I → c' v = c v) :
    G.cutSize c' + ∑ v ∈ I, G.localCut c v =
      G.cutSize c + ∑ v ∈ I, G.localCut c' v

name: Complexity.Frontier.Multigraph.cutSize_eq_add_gain
statement:
theorem cutSize_eq_add_gain (I : Finset V) (hI : ∀ e, ¬(G.src e ∈ I ∧ G.tgt e ∈ I))

    (hlocal : ∀ v ∈ I, G.localCut c' v ≤ G.localCut c v) :
    G.cutSize c = G.cutSize c' + ∑ v ∈ I, (G.localCut c v - G.localCut c' v)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Multigraph.card_cut_le_grid
statement:
theorem card_cut_le_grid {d : ℕ} (degree : G.MaxDegreeLE d) (score : W → ℝ)
    (P : Finset W) {m a δ : ℝ} (hP : ∀ v ∈ P, score v ≤ m)
    (hPc : ∀ v ∉ P, m ≤ score v) (hδ : 0 < δ) (M : ℕ) {B : ℝ}
    (low : d * (#{v | score v < a} : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (high : d * (#{v | a + M * δ ≤ score v} : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (mid : ∀ i < M,
      ((G.crossingFinset {v | score v < a + i * δ}).card : ℝ) +
        d * #{v | a + i * δ ≤ score v ∧ score v < a + (i + 1) * δ} ≤ B) :
    ((G.crossingFinset P).card : ℝ) ≤ B

name: Complexity.Frontier.Multigraph.exists_key_of_vertexScore
statement:
theorem exists_key_of_vertexScore {d : ℕ} (degree : G.MaxDegreeLE d) (score : W → ℝ)
    {a δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (M : ℕ) {B : ℝ}
    (low : d * (#{v | score v < a} : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (high : d * (#{v | a + M * δ ≤ score v} : ℝ) ≤ B)
    (mid : ∀ i < M,
      ((G.crossingFinset {v | score v < a + i * δ}).card : ℝ) +
        d * #{v | a + i * δ ≤ score v ∧ score v < a + (i + 1) * δ} ≤ B) :
    ∃ key : W → ℕ, Function.Injective key ∧ ∀ t,
      ((G.crossingFinset {v | key v < t}).card : ℝ) ≤ B

name: Complexity.Frontier.Multigraph.mem_crossingFinset_iff

theorem mem_crossingFinset_iff {P : Finset W} {e : E} : e ∈ G.crossingFinset P ↔
    ∃ u v, ((G.src e = u ∧ G.tgt e = v) ∨ (G.src e = v ∧ G.tgt e = u)) ∧
      u ∈ P ∧ v ∉ P

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_abs_le_mul_abs
statement:
theorem gaussPi_abs_le_mul_abs (k : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    (gaussPi (Fin 2)).real {ω | |ω 0| ≤ k * |ω 1|} = 2 / Real.pi * Real.arctan k

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_between_le_arccos
statement:
theorem gaussPi_between_le_arccos {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {α β : ι → ℝ}
    (hα : ∑ i, α i ^ 2 = 1) (hβ : ∑ i, β i ^ 2 = 1) (hx : -1 < ∑ i, α i * β i) (t : ℝ) :
    (gaussPi ι).real {ω | Between t (form α ω) (form β ω)} ≤
      Real.arccos (∑ i, α i * β i) / Real.pi

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_between_le_arctan
statement:
theorem gaussPi_between_le_arctan {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (α β : ι → ℝ)
    (hnorm : ∑ i, α i ^ 2 = ∑ i, β i ^ 2) (hsum : 0 < ∑ i, (α i + β i) ^ 2) (t : ℝ) :
    (gaussPi ι).real {ω | Between t (form α ω) (form β ω)} ≤
      2 / Real.pi *
        Real.arctan (Real.sqrt (∑ i, (β i - α i) ^ 2) / Real.sqrt (∑ i, (α i + β i) ^ 2))

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_map_form
statement:
theorem gaussPi_map_form (a : ι → ℝ) :
    (gaussPi ι).map (form a) = gaussianReal 0 (∑ i, a i ^ 2).toNNReal

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_map_form_pair
statement:
theorem gaussPi_map_form_pair (a b : ι → ℝ) (hab : ∑ i, a i * b i = 0) :
    (gaussPi ι).map (fun ω => (form a ω, form b ω)) =
      (gaussianReal 0 (∑ i, a i ^ 2).toNNReal).prod
        (gaussianReal 0 (∑ i, b i ^ 2).toNNReal)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_tail_le
statement:
theorem gaussPi_tail_le (α : ι → ℝ) (hα : ∑ i, α i ^ 2 = 1)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (gaussPi ι).real {ω | T ≤ |form α ω|} ≤ 1 / T ^ 2

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussPi_window_le
statement:
theorem gaussPi_window_le (α : ι → ℝ) (hα : ∑ i, α i ^ 2 = 1)
    (s : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (gaussPi ι).real {ω | s ≤ form α ω ∧ form α ω < s + δ} ≤ δ / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.gaussianReal_Icc_le
statement:
theorem gaussianReal_Icc_le (v : ℝ≥0) (c w : ℝ) :

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.two_mul_arctan_tanHalf

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.le_inner_of_le_inner
Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_arccos_le
Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_arccos_star_le
statement:
theorem sum_arccos_star_le {ι J : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq J] {x : ι → ℝ}
    (hx : ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = 1) (s : Finset J) (hs : s.card = 3) (y : J → ι → ℝ)
    (hy : ∀ j ∈ s, ∑ i, y j i ^ 2 = 1) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 7 / 8 ≤ κ)
    (hyx : ∀ j ∈ s, κ ≤ ∑ i, y j i * x i) :
    ∑ j ∈ s, ∑ j' ∈ s.erase j, Real.arccos (∑ i, y j i * y j' i) ≤
      6 * Real.arccos ((3 * κ ^ 2 - 1) / 2)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Gaussian.sum_inner_ordered_pairs_ge
statement:
theorem sum_inner_ordered_pairs_ge {ι J : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq J] {x : ι → ℝ}
    (hx : ∑ i, x i ^ 2 = 1) (s : Finset J) (y : J → ι → ℝ)
    (hy : ∀ j ∈ s, ∑ i, y j i ^ 2 = 1) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hyx : ∀ j ∈ s, κ ≤ ∑ i, y j i * x i) :
    (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * κ ^ 2 - s.card ≤
      ∑ j ∈ s, ∑ j' ∈ s.erase j, ∑ i, y j i * y j' i

name: Complexity.Frontier.Network.ncard_accepted_le
statement:
theorem ncard_accepted_le [Finite ι] [Finite U] [Finite E] {K : ℕ}
    (hfree : RectangleFree N.accepted K) (hK : K ≤ N.accepted.ncard)
    {w d m : ℕ} (hw : ∀ t, (N.frontier π t).ncard ≤ w) (hd : N.MaxDegreeLE d)
    (hm : ∀ v, (N.readAt v).ncard ≤ m) :
    N.accepted.ncard ≤
      (K - 1) ^ 2 * (Nat.card V * Nat.card U ^ (w + d + m) + Nat.card U ^ N.readᶜ.ncard)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Network.ncard_accepted_le_labels
statement:
theorem ncard_accepted_le_labels [Finite ι] [Finite U] {Λ : Type*} [Finite Λ]
    (label : E → Λ) (value : (ι → U) → Λ → U)
    (hval : ∀ x ∈ N.accepted, ∀ e, N.witness x e = value x (label e))
    {K b : ℕ} (hfree : RectangleFree N.accepted K) (hK : K ≤ N.accepted.ncard)
    (hb : ∀ t, ∀ ht : t < Nat.card V,
      (label '' (N.frontier π t ∪ N.frontier π (t + 1))).ncard +
        (N.readAt (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)).ncard ≤ b) :
    N.accepted.ncard ≤ (K - 1) ^ 2 *
      (Nat.card V * Nat.card U ^ b + Nat.card U ^ N.readᶜ.ncard)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Network.ncard_transition_last_le
statement:

    ((N.frontierSweep π val extra hlast hsplice).transition (Nat.card V) '' S).ncard ≤
      ((fun x => (extra (Nat.card V) x, extra (Nat.card V + 1) x)) '' S).ncard *
        Nat.card U ^ N.readᶜ.ncard

name: Complexity.Frontier.Network.ncard_transition_le
statement:
theorem ncard_transition_le [Finite ι] [Finite U] [Finite E] {t : ℕ} (ht : t < Nat.card V) :
    ((N.frontierSweep π val extra hlast hsplice).transition t '' S).ncard ≤
      ((fun x => (extra t x, extra (t + 1) x)) '' S).ncard *
        Nat.card U ^ ((N.frontier π t ∪ N.frontier π (t + 1)).ncard +
          (N.readAt (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)).ncard)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Network.ncard_transition_le_labels
statement:
theorem ncard_transition_le_labels [Finite ι] [Finite U] {Λ : Type*} [Finite Λ]
    (label : E → Λ) (value : (ι → U) → Λ → U)

    {t : ℕ} (ht : t < Nat.card V) :
    ((N.frontierSweep π val extra hlast hsplice).transition t '' S).ncard ≤
      ((fun x => (extra t x, extra (t + 1) x)) '' S).ncard *

          (N.readAt (π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩)).ncard)

name: Complexity.Frontier.Network.ncard_transition_le_of_touching
statement:
theorem ncard_transition_le_of_touching [Finite ι] [Finite U] {t : ℕ} (ht : t < Nat.card V)
    {W : Set V} (hv : π.symm ⟨t, ht⟩ ∈ W)
    (hC : N.frontier π t ∪ N.frontier π (t + 1) ⊆ N.touching W)
    (hdet : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, extra t x = extra t y → extra (t + 1) x = extra (t + 1) y →
      EqOn x y (N.readIn W) → EqOn (val x) (val y) (N.touching W)) :
    ((N.frontierSweep π val extra hlast hsplice).transition t '' S).ncard ≤
      ((fun x => (extra t x, extra (t + 1) x)) '' S).ncard *
        Nat.card U ^ (N.readIn W).ncard

name: Complexity.Frontier.Network.abs_sumOn_accepted_le_tree
statement:
theorem abs_sumOn_accepted_le_tree [Finite ι] [Finite U] [Finite E] [Fintype B]
    (hlam : ∀ u v, T.region u ⊆ T.region v ∨ T.region v ⊆ T.region u ∨
      Disjoint (T.region u) (T.region v))
    (hunique : ∀ x α β, G.Satisfies x α → G.Satisfies x β → α = β)
    {K : ℕ} (hK : 1 < K) {w cost : (ι → U) → ℝ} {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hw : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ a) (hc : ∀ x, 0 ≤ cost x)
    (hrect : RectangleBudget w cost K K) :
    |sumOn w G.accepted| ≤ sumOn cost G.accepted + a * ((K - 1) ^ 3 *
      ∑ v, Nat.card U ^ ((G.cut (T.region v) ∪ G.cut (T.region (T.left v)) ∪
        G.cut (T.region (T.right v))).ncard +
          ((G.treeFrontier T hread).localInputs v).ncard) : ℕ)

theorem run_swapPlayers_internal {ι M : Type*} :

  | _, .answer _, _, _ => rfl

statement:
theorem one_sub_pow_bound_internal {p : ℝ} (hp' : p ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    (1 - p) ^ n * (1 + (n : ℝ) * p) ≤ 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.IsDensityLimit.agrees_internal
Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.IsDensityLimit.mono_deficit_internal
Complexity.KarchmerWigderson.DensityRectangle.not_separated_internal
