name: Complexity.blockAppend_fst_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockAppend_fst_snd (a b : ℕ) (w : Fin (a + b) → Bool) :
    blockAppend a b (blockFst a b w) (blockSnd a b w) = w

name: Complexity.blockEventCount_add_compl
statement:
theorem blockEventCount_add_compl {k T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool))
    (w : Fin (k * T) → Bool) :
    blockEventCount E w + blockEventCount Eᶜ w = k

name: Complexity.blockFst_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockFst_append (a b : ℕ) (u : Fin a → Bool) (v : Fin b → Bool) :
    blockFst a b (blockAppend a b u v) = u

name: Complexity.blockMajority_compl_of_odd
statement:
theorem blockMajority_compl_of_odd {k T : ℕ} (hk : Odd k)
    (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (w : Fin (k * T) → Bool) :
    blockMajority Eᶜ w = !(blockMajority E w)

name: Complexity.blockMajority_eq_false_iff
statement:
theorem blockMajority_eq_false_iff {k T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool))
    (w : Fin (k * T) → Bool) :
    blockMajority E w = false ↔ blockEventCount E w ≤ k / 2

name: Complexity.blockMajority_eq_false_iff_mem_range
Complexity.blockSnd_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockSnd_append (a b : ℕ) (u : Fin a → Bool) (v : Fin b → Bool) :
    blockSnd a b (blockAppend a b u v) = v

name: Complexity.blockSnd_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockSnd_apply (a b : ℕ) (w : Fin (a + b) → Bool) (i : Fin b) :
    blockSnd a b w i = w (Fin.natAdd a i)

name: Complexity.blocksEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem blocksEquiv_apply (k T : ℕ) (w : Fin (k * T) → Bool)
    (i : Fin k) (t : Fin T) :
    blocksEquiv k T w i t = w (finProdFinEquiv (i, t))

name: Complexity.blocksEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem blocksEquiv_symm_apply (k T : ℕ) (f : Fin k → Fin T → Bool)
    (p : Fin (k * T)) :
    (blocksEquiv k T).symm f p =
      f (finProdFinEquiv.symm p).1 (finProdFinEquiv.symm p).2

name: Complexity.boolFunEquivFinset_card
statement:
@[simp] theorem boolFunEquivFinset_card {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :
    (boolFunEquivFinset (Fin k) f).card = popCount f

name: Complexity.card_adjMatrix
statement:
theorem card_adjMatrix (n : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Fin n → Fin n → Bool) = 2 ^ (n * n)

name: Complexity.card_blockEventCount_eq
statement:
theorem card_blockEventCount_eq {T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (k j : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin (k * T) → Bool => blockEventCount E w = j)).card =
      k.choose j * E.card ^ j * (2 ^ T - E.card) ^ (k - j)

name: Complexity.card_blockMajority_eq_false
statement:
theorem card_blockMajority_eq_false (T r : ℕ) (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin ((2 * r + 1) * T) → Bool =>
      blockMajority E w = false)).card =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
        (2 * r + 1).choose j * E.card ^ j *
          (2 ^ T - E.card) ^ (2 * r + 1 - j)

name: Complexity.card_boolFunc
statement:
theorem card_boolFunc (n : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card ((Fin n → Bool) → Bool) = 2 ^ (2 ^ n)

name: Complexity.card_filter_block
statement:
theorem card_filter_block {a b : ℕ}
    (P : (Fin a → Bool) → Prop) (Q : (Fin b → Bool) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q] :
    (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun w : Fin (a + b) → Bool => P (blockFst a b w) ∧ Q (blockSnd a b w))).card
      = (Finset.univ.filter P).card * (Finset.univ.filter Q).card

name: Complexity.card_filter_exists_le
statement:
theorem card_filter_exists_le {ι α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → α → Prop) [∀ i, DecidablePred (p i)] :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => ∃ i ∈ s, p i x)).card
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (Finset.univ.filter (p i)).card

name: Complexity.card_filter_of_constant_fibers
statement:
theorem card_filter_of_constant_fibers
    {total compact ignored : ℕ}
    (randomSeed : (Fin total → Bool) → (Fin compact → Bool))
    (Accept : (Fin total → Bool) → Prop)
    (Good : (Fin compact → Bool) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred Accept] [DecidablePred Good]
    (hfactor : ∀ w, Accept w ↔ Good (randomSeed w))
    (hfiber : ∀ seed,
      (Finset.univ.filter fun w => randomSeed w = seed).card = 2 ^ ignored) :
    (Finset.univ.filter Accept).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter Good).card * 2 ^ ignored

name: Complexity.card_filter_popCount_eq
statement:
theorem card_filter_popCount_eq (k r : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → Bool => popCount f = r)).card =
      k.choose r

name: Complexity.card_filter_popCount_mem
statement:
theorem card_filter_popCount_mem (k : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → Bool => popCount f ∈ s)).card =
      ∑ r ∈ s, k.choose r

name: Complexity.card_filter_repeatRandomSeed
statement:
theorem card_filter_repeatRandomSeed (k T : ℕ)
    (P : (Fin (k * T) → Bool) → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) → Bool =>
      P (repeatRandomSeed k T w))).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter P).card * 2 ^ (2 + k * (T + 2))

name: Complexity.card_finArrowBool
statement: theorem card_finArrowBool (T : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Fin T → Bool) = 2 ^ T

name: Complexity.card_finArrowBool_add
statement:
theorem card_finArrowBool_add (a b : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Fin (a + b) → Bool) = 2 ^ a * 2 ^ b

name: Complexity.card_majority_eq_false
statement:
theorem card_majority_eq_false (k : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → Bool => majority f = false)).card =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (k / 2 + 1), k.choose r

name: Complexity.card_majority_eq_true
statement:
theorem card_majority_eq_true (k : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → Bool => majority f = true)).card =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc (k / 2 + 1) k, k.choose r

name: Complexity.card_majority_ne_true
statement:
theorem card_majority_ne_true (k : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin k → Bool => majority f ≠ true)).card =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (k / 2 + 1), k.choose r

name: Complexity.card_repeatRandomSeed_fiber
statement:
theorem card_repeatRandomSeed_fiber (k T : ℕ) (seed : Fin (k * T) → Bool) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) → Bool =>
      repeatRandomSeed k T w = seed)).card = 2 ^ (2 + k * (T + 2))

name: Complexity.card_tupleEventCount_eq
statement:
theorem card_tupleEventCount_eq {k : ℕ} {α : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (E : Finset α) (j : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun f : Fin k → α => tupleEventCount E f = j)).card =
        k.choose j * E.card ^ j *
          (Fintype.card α - E.card) ^ (k - j)

name: Complexity.card_tupleEventCount_mem
statement:
theorem card_tupleEventCount_mem {k : ℕ} {α : Type*}
    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (E : Finset α) (counts : Finset ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun f : Fin k → α => tupleEventCount E f ∈ counts)).card =
        ∑ j ∈ counts,
          k.choose j * E.card ^ j *
            (Fintype.card α - E.card) ^ (k - j)

name: Complexity.exists_good_seed
statement:
theorem exists_good_seed {S ι : Type*} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (inputs : Finset ι) (bad : ι → Finset S)
    (h : ∑ i ∈ inputs, (bad i).card < Fintype.card S) :
    ∃ s : S, ∀ i ∈ inputs, s ∉ bad i

name: Complexity.finCountP_eq_popCount
statement:
theorem finCountP_eq_popCount {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :
    Fin.countP f = popCount f

name: Complexity.majority_eq_false_iff
statement:
theorem majority_eq_false_iff {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :
    majority f = false ↔ popCount f ≤ k / 2

name: Complexity.majority_eq_false_iff_mem_range
statement:
theorem majority_eq_false_iff_mem_range {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :
    majority f = false ↔ popCount f ∈ Finset.range (k / 2 + 1)

name: Complexity.majority_eq_true_iff
statement:
theorem majority_eq_true_iff {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :
    majority f = true ↔ k / 2 < popCount f

name: Complexity.majority_eq_true_iff_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem majority_eq_true_iff_mem_Icc {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :
    majority f = true ↔ popCount f ∈ Finset.Icc (k / 2 + 1) k

name: Complexity.majority_not_of_odd
statement:
theorem majority_not_of_odd {k : ℕ} (hk : Odd k) (f : Fin k → Bool) :
    majority (fun i => !f i) = !(majority f)

name: Complexity.mem_boolFunEquivFinset
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_boolFunEquivFinset {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (f : α → Bool) (i : α) : i ∈ boolFunEquivFinset α f ↔ f i = true

name: Complexity.popCount_add_popCount_not
statement:
theorem popCount_add_popCount_not {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :
    popCount f + popCount (fun i => !f i) = k

name: Complexity.popCount_le
statement: theorem popCount_le {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) : popCount f ≤ k

name: Complexity.popCount_not
statement:
theorem popCount_not {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Bool) :
    popCount (fun i => !f i) = k - popCount f

name: Complexity.repeatRandomSeed_apply
statement:
theorem repeatRandomSeed_apply (k T : ℕ)
    (w : Fin (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) → Bool) (i : Fin k) (t : Fin T) :
    repeatRandomSeed k T w (finProdFinEquiv (i, t)) =
      w (Fin.natAdd 2
        (finProdFinEquiv (i, Fin.castLE (by omega : T ≤ 2 * T + 2) t)))

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.majorityDeficitBound_eventually_le_internal
statement:
theorem majorityDeficitBound_eventually_le_internal {r c : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → majorityDeficitBound n ≤ c * (n : ℝ) ^ r

name: Complexity.KarchmerWigderson.finite_budget_with_deficit_of_cost_internal
statement:
theorem finite_budget_with_deficit_of_cost_internal {n d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {m k : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hk : 0 ≤ k)
    (hcost : m ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹) / (128 * (32768 * (194 : ℝ) ^ d)))
    (hkcost : k ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ)⁻¹) / (128 * (32768 * (194 : ℝ) ^ d))) :
    64 * (32768 * (194 : ℝ) ^ d * (m + k)) ^ d ≤ (n : ℝ)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.le_majorityDeficitBound_internal
statement: theorem le_majorityDeficitBound_internal (n : ℕ) : 128 ≤ majorityDeficitBound n

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.majority_layers_deficit_internal
statement:
theorem majority_layers_deficit_internal {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ((weightLayer n (n / 2)).Nonempty ∧
      uniformDeficit (weightLayer n (n / 2)) ≤ majorityDeficitBound n) ∧
    ((weightLayer n (n / 2 + 1)).Nonempty ∧
      uniformDeficit (weightLayer n (n / 2 + 1)) ≤ majorityDeficitBound n)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.middle_choose_bound_internal
statement: theorem middle_choose_bound_internal (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ n ≤ (n + 1) * n.choose (n / 2)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.next_middle_choose_bound_internal
statement:
theorem next_middle_choose_bound_internal {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    n.choose (n / 2) ≤ 2 * n.choose (n / 2 + 1)

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.popCount_update_false_internal
statement:
theorem popCount_update_false_internal {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → Bool) (i : Fin n) (hi : x i = true) :
    popCount (Function.update x i false) + 1 = popCount x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.popCount_update_true_internal
statement:
theorem popCount_update_true_internal {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → Bool) (i : Fin n) (hi : x i = false) :
    popCount (Function.update x i true) = popCount x + 1

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.weightLayer_deficit_internal
statement:
theorem weightLayer_deficit_internal {n r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ n)
    (hcard : 2 ^ n ≤ (2 * (n + 1)) * n.choose r) :
    (weightLayer n r).Nonempty ∧ uniformDeficit (weightLayer n r) ≤ majorityDeficitBound n

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_hits_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_hits_internal {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ) (s : Fin n → Bool) :
    bernoulliAverage p (fun P : Fin n → Bool =>
      if ∃ i, s i = true ∧ P i = true then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
        1 - (1 - p) ^ popCount s

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.bernoulliAverage_popCount_internal
statement:
theorem bernoulliAverage_popCount_internal {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ) :
    bernoulliAverage p (fun P : Fin n → Bool => (popCount P : ℝ)) = n * p

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.coordinateDensity_of_neighbor_internal
statement:
theorem coordinateDensity_of_neighbor_internal {n : ℕ} (X : Finset (Fin n → Bool))
    (P x : Fin n → Bool) (i : Fin n) (hi : P i = true)
    (hx : Function.update x i (!x i) ∈ X) (hsmall : popCount P ≤ 128) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(128 : ℝ)) ≤ coordinateDensity X P x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.isDensityLimit_of_many_neighbors_internal
statement:
theorem isDensityLimit_of_many_neighbors_internal {n : ℕ} (hn : 16 ≤ n)
    (X : Finset (Fin n → Bool)) (x s : Fin n → Bool) (hs : n ≤ 2 * popCount s)
    (hneighbor : ∀ i, s i = true → Function.update x i (!x i) ∈ X) :
    IsDensityLimit X (16 / n) 128 x

name: Complexity.BooleanAnalysis.majority_layers_limits_internal
statement:
theorem majority_layers_limits_internal {n : ℕ} (hn : 16 ≤ n) :
    (∀ x ∈ weightLayer n (n / 2),
      IsDensityLimit (weightLayer n (n / 2 + 1)) (16 / n) (majorityDeficitBound n) x) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ weightLayer n (n / 2 + 1),
      IsDensityLimit (weightLayer n (n / 2)) (16 / n) (majorityDeficitBound n) y)

name: Complexity.mle₁_bool
statement:
theorem mle₁_bool {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : Bool → R) (b : Bool) :
    mle₁ f (if b then 1 else 0) = f b

name: Complexity.mle₁_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem mle₁_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : Bool → R) :
    mle₁ f 1 = f true

name: Complexity.mle₁_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem mle₁_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : Bool → R) :
    mle₁ f 0 = f false

name: Complexity.Shallow.construction_size_bound
statement:
theorem construction_size_bound {k n U V B N A D E : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hn : n ≤ 2 ^ (N * k)) (hu : U ≤ A * k)
    (hv : V ≤ 2 ^ (D * k)) (hb : B ≤ 2 ^ (E * k)) :
    1 + (n + 1) * (1 + (3 ^ U * (n + 1)) * (2 + V * (B + 2))) ≤
      2 ^ ((2 * A + 2 * N + D + E + 8) * k)

name: Complexity.Shallow.exp_add_bound
statement:
theorem exp_add_bound {k a b x y : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hx : x ≤ 2 ^ (a * k))
    (hy : y ≤ 2 ^ (b * k)) : x + y ≤ 2 ^ ((a + b + 1) * k)

name: Complexity.Shallow.exp_const_bound
statement: theorem exp_const_bound (c k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : c ≤ 2 ^ (c * k)

name: Complexity.Shallow.exp_mul_bound
statement:
theorem exp_mul_bound {k a b x y : ℕ} (hx : x ≤ 2 ^ (a * k))
    (hy : y ≤ 2 ^ (b * k)) : x * y ≤ 2 ^ ((a + b) * k)

name: Complexity.Shallow.pair_size_bound
statement:
theorem pair_size_bound {n d k m : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hn : n ≤ k ^ (d + 2))
    (hm : k ≤ m) : 2 * (n / m + 1) ≤ (4 * k) ^ (d + 1)

name: Complexity.Shallow.sum_sq_moduli_bound
statement:
theorem sum_sq_moduli_bound {r C k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (m : Fin r → ℕ) (hm : ∀ i, m i ≤ C * k) :
    ∑ i, (m i) ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ ((r + 2 * C + 2) * k)

name: Complexity.Shallow.ShiftTest.sound
statement:
theorem ShiftTest.sound {t : G} {w s : G → G} (h : ShiftTest t w s) :
    ∑ i, w i = t

name: Complexity.Shallow.card_acceptingShifts
statement:
theorem card_acceptingShifts {t : G} (w : G → G) (hw : ∑ i, w i = t) :
    Nat.card {s : G → G // ShiftTest t w s} = (Fintype.card G).factorial

name: Complexity.Shallow.exists_shiftTest_iff
statement:
theorem exists_shiftTest_iff (t : G) (w : G → G) :
    (∃ s, ShiftTest t w s) ↔ ∑ i, w i = t

name: Complexity.Shallow.shiftTest_iff_pairwise
statement:
theorem shiftTest_iff_pairwise (t : G) (w s : G → G) :
    ShiftTest t w s ↔ (∑ i, s i) = residueSum G - t ∧
      ∀ i j, i ≠ j → w i + s i ≠ w j + s j

name: Complexity.Shallow.shiftTest_perm
statement:
theorem shiftTest_perm {t : G} (w : G → G) (hw : ∑ i, w i = t)
    (e : Equiv.Perm G) : ShiftTest t w (fun i => e i - w i)

name: Complexity.Shallow.exists_cover
statement:
theorem exists_cover {S W : Type*} [Fintype S] [Nonempty S] [Fintype W]
    (hit : S → W → Prop) [DecidableRel hit] (q n : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hw : Fintype.card W ≤ 2 ^ n)
    (density : ∀ w, Fintype.card S ≤ q * Fintype.card {s : S // hit s w}) :
    ∃ tests : Fin (q * (n + 1)) → S, ∀ w, ∃ i, hit (tests i) w

name: Complexity.Shallow.exists_shiftTest_cover
statement:
theorem exists_shiftTest_cover {G W : Type*} [Fintype G] [AddCommGroup G]
    [Fintype W] (t : G) (w : W → G → G) (n : ℕ)
    (hcard : Fintype.card W ≤ 2 ^ n) (hw : ∀ x, ∑ i, w x i = t) :
    ∃ tests : Fin (3 ^ Fintype.card G * (n + 1)) → (G → G),
      ∀ x, ∃ j, ShiftTest t (w x) (tests j)

name: Complexity.Shallow.pow_self_le_three_pow_mul_factorial
statement:
theorem pow_self_le_three_pow_mul_factorial (k : ℕ) :
    k ^ k ≤ 3 ^ k * k.factorial

name: Complexity.Shallow.exists_moduli
statement:
theorem exists_moduli (r : ℕ) : ∃ C : ℕ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k →
    ∃ m : Fin r → ℕ,
      Pairwise (fun i j => (m i).Coprime (m j)) ∧
      (∀ i, k < m i) ∧ (∀ i, m i ≤ C * k)

name: Complexity.Smolensky.card_middle_le
statement:
theorem card_middle_le (n t : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin n) =>
      n ≤ 2 * S.card ∧ S.card ≤ n / 2 + t).card ≤ (t + 1) * n.choose (n / 2)

name: Complexity.Smolensky.centralBinom_sq_mul_le
statement:
theorem centralBinom_sq_mul_le (m : ℕ) :
    m.centralBinom ^ 2 * (2 * m + 1) ≤ 16 ^ m

name: Complexity.Smolensky.choose_half_sq_mul_le
statement:
theorem choose_half_sq_mul_le (n : ℕ) :
    n.choose (n / 2) ^ 2 * (n + 1) ≤ 4 ^ n

name: Complexity.Smolensky.ten_mul_card_le_internal
statement:
theorem ten_mul_card_le_internal (n t : ℕ) (h : 100 * (t + 1) ^ 2 ≤ n + 1) :
    10 * (univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin n) => S.card ≤ n / 2 + t).card ≤ 6 * 2 ^ n

name: Complexity.Smolensky.two_mul_card_small_le
statement:
theorem two_mul_card_small_le (n : ℕ) :
    2 * (univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin n) => 2 * S.card < n).card ≤ 2 ^ n

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.mem_chunkTuple_iff
statement:
theorem mem_chunkTuple_iff (s : Finset α) (K : ℕ) (positive : 0 < K) (a : α) :
    (∃ block : Fin (s.card / K + 1), a ∈ tupleSupport (chunkTuple s K block.val)) ↔
      a ∈ s

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.mem_tupleSupport
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_tupleSupport {K : ℕ} (v : Fin K → Option α) (a : α) :
    a ∈ tupleSupport v ↔ ∃ i, v i = some a

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.sum_div_le_div_sum
statement:
theorem sum_div_le_div_sum {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ) (K : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, f i / K ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) / K

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.tupleSupport_card
statement: theorem tupleSupport_card {K : ℕ} (v : Fin K → Option α) : (tupleSupport v).card ≤ K

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.exists_cover
statement:
theorem exists_cover (s : Finset β) (r : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [Nonempty α] [DecidableEq α] (a length : ℕ) (positive : 0 < a)
    (size : s.card ≤ 4 ^ length)
    (dense : ∀ b ∈ s, Fintype.card α ≤
      a * (Finset.univ.filter fun x => r x b).card) :
    ∃ chosen : Finset α, chosen.card ≤ (4 * length + 1) * a ∧
      ∀ b ∈ s, ∃ x ∈ chosen, r x b

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.exists_dense_row
statement:
theorem exists_dense_row (s : Finset β) (r : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [Nonempty α]
    (a : ℕ) (dense : ∀ b ∈ s, Fintype.card α ≤
      a * (Finset.univ.filter fun x => r x b).card) :
    ∃ x, s.card ≤ a * (s.filter (r x)).card

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.exists_partial_cover
statement:
theorem exists_partial_cover (s : Finset β) (r : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [Nonempty α] [DecidableEq α]
    (a : ℕ) (positive : 0 < a)
    (dense : ∀ b ∈ s, Fintype.card α ≤
      a * (Finset.univ.filter fun x => r x b).card) (steps : ℕ) :
    ∃ chosen : Finset α, chosen.card ≤ steps ∧
      ((s.filter fun b => ∀ x ∈ chosen, ¬ r x b).card : ℝ) ≤
        s.card * (1 - 1 / (a : ℝ)) ^ steps

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.sum_card_filter_comm
statement:
theorem sum_card_filter_comm (s : Finset β) (r : α → β → Prop) [DecidableRel r] :
    ∑ a : α, (s.filter (r a)).card =
      ∑ b ∈ s, (Finset.univ.filter fun a => r a b).card

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.card_extensions
statement:
theorem card_extensions (length specified : ℕ) (domain : Finset (Fin length))
    (small : domain.card ≤ specified) (values : Fin length → Bool) :
    2 ^ length ≤ 2 ^ specified *
      (Finset.univ.filter fun extension : Fin length → Bool =>
        ∀ i ∈ domain, extension i = values i).card

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.exists_extension_bank
statement:
theorem exists_extension_bank (length specified : ℕ) :
    ∃ bank : Finset (Fin length → Bool), bank.card ≤ (4 * length + 1) * 2 ^ specified ∧
      ∀ (domain : Finset (Fin length)), domain.card ≤ specified →
        ∀ values : Fin length → Bool, ∃ extension ∈ bank,
          ∀ i ∈ domain, extension i = values i

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.exists_intervalChunk
statement:
theorem exists_intervalChunk {L : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin L)) (K : ℕ) (positive : 0 < K)
    (i : Fin L) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    ∃ block : Fin (s.card / K + 1), i ∈ intervalChunk s K block.val

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.intervalChunk_card
statement:
theorem intervalChunk_card {L : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin L)) (K block : ℕ) :
    (intervalChunk s K block).card ≤ K

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.lt_supportCut_iff
statement:
theorem lt_supportCut_iff {L : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin L)) (rank : ℕ)
    (i : Fin L) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    i.val < (supportCut s rank).val ↔ ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨i, hi⟩).val < rank

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.mem_intervalChunk_iff
statement:
theorem mem_intervalChunk_iff {L : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin L)) (K block : ℕ)
    (i : Fin L) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    i ∈ intervalChunk s K block ↔ block * K ≤ ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨i, hi⟩).val ∧
      ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨i, hi⟩).val < (block + 1) * K

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.supportCut_le_iff
statement:
theorem supportCut_le_iff {L : ℕ} (s : Finset (Fin L)) (rank : ℕ)
    (i : Fin L) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    (supportCut s rank).val ≤ i.val ↔ rank ≤ ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨i, hi⟩).val

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.columnAt_matrixInput
statement:
@[simp] theorem columnAt_matrixInput {k l : ℕ} (r : Fin (2 ^ l)) (c : Fin (2 ^ k)) :
    columnAt (matrixInput r c) = c

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.matrixInput_rowAt_columnAt
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixInput_rowAt_columnAt {k l : ℕ} (x : Fin (k + l) → Bool) :
    matrixInput (rowAt x) (columnAt x) = x

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.rowAt_matrixInput
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowAt_matrixInput {k l : ℕ} (r : Fin (2 ^ l)) (c : Fin (2 ^ k)) :
    rowAt (matrixInput r c) = r

name: Complexity.CircuitSparseSynthesis.Internal.sum_rowDomain_card
statement:
theorem sum_rowDomain_card {k l : ℕ} (domain : Finset (Fin (k + l) → Bool)) :
    ∑ r, (rowDomain domain r).card = domain.card

name: Complexity.BoolFormula.exists_spira_balanced
statement:
theorem exists_spira_balanced (formula : BoolFormula) :
    ∃ balanced : BoolFormula,
      (∀ assignment, eval assignment balanced = eval assignment formula) ∧
      balanced.depth ≤ 15 + 12 * Nat.clog 2 formula.size ∧
      balanced.size + 4 ≤ 80 * formula.size ^ 8

name: Complexity.Valiant.depth_reduction
statement:
theorem depth_reduction
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : Digraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {k r : Nat} (hrk : r ≤ k)
    (hac : IsAcyclic G)
    (hd : G.depth ≤ 2 ^ k) :
    ∃ F : Finset (V × V),
      F ⊆ G.edgeFinset ∧
      k * F.card ≤ r * G.edgeFinset.card ∧
      (G.deleteEdges F).depth ≤ 2 ^ k / 2 ^ r

name: Complexity.NTM.acceptProb_eq_eventProb
statement:
theorem NTM.acceptProb_eq_eventProb {n : ℕ} (tm : NTM n) (x : List Bool) (T : ℕ) :
    tm.acceptProb x T =
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter fun choices : Fin T → Bool =>
        let c' := tm.trace T choices (tm.initCfg x)
        c'.state = tm.qhalt ∧ c'.output.cells 1 = Γ.one)

name: Complexity.NTM.acceptProb_eq_eventProb_repeatRandomSeed
statement:
theorem NTM.acceptProb_eq_eventProb_repeatRandomSeed
    {n : ℕ} (tm : NTM n) (x : List Bool) (k T : ℕ)
    (P : (Fin (k * T) → Bool) → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (hfactor : ∀ choices : Fin (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) → Bool,
      (let c' := tm.trace (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) choices (tm.initCfg x)
       c'.state = tm.qhalt ∧ c'.output.cells 1 = Γ.one) ↔
        P (repeatRandomSeed k T choices)) :
    tm.acceptProb x (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) =
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter P)

name: Complexity.NTM.acceptProb_eq_of_le_of_allChoicesHalt
statement:
theorem NTM.acceptProb_eq_of_le_of_allChoicesHalt {n T T' : ℕ}
    (tm : NTM n) (x : List Bool) (hle : T ≤ T')
    (hhalt : ∀ choices : Fin T → Bool,
      tm.halted (tm.trace T choices (tm.initCfg x))) :
    tm.acceptProb x T' = tm.acceptProb x T

name: Complexity.NTM.acceptProb_eq_of_le_of_allPathsHaltIn
statement:
theorem NTM.acceptProb_eq_of_le_of_allPathsHaltIn {n : ℕ} {T T' : ℕ → ℕ}
    (tm : NTM n) (hle : ∀ m, T m ≤ T' m) (hhalt : tm.AllPathsHaltIn T)
    (x : List Bool) :
    tm.acceptProb x (T' x.length) = tm.acceptProb x (T x.length)

name: Complexity.NTM.outputProb_eq_eventProb
statement:
theorem NTM.outputProb_eq_eventProb {n : ℕ} (tm : NTM n) (x : List Bool)
    (T : ℕ) (y : List Bool) :
    tm.outputProb x T y =
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter fun choices : Fin T → Bool =>
        let c := tm.trace T choices (tm.initCfg x)
        c.state = tm.qhalt ∧ c.output.HasOutput y)

name: Complexity.NTM.outputProb_eq_of_le_of_allChoicesHalt
statement:
theorem NTM.outputProb_eq_of_le_of_allChoicesHalt {n T T' : ℕ}
    (tm : NTM n) (x : List Bool) (y : List Bool) (hle : T ≤ T')
    (hhalt : ∀ choices : Fin T → Bool,
      tm.halted (tm.trace T choices (tm.initCfg x))) :
    tm.outputProb x T' y = tm.outputProb x T y

name: Complexity.NTM.outputProb_eq_of_le_of_allPathsHaltIn
statement:
theorem NTM.outputProb_eq_of_le_of_allPathsHaltIn {n : ℕ} {T T' : ℕ → ℕ}
    (tm : NTM n) (hle : ∀ m, T m ≤ T' m) (hhalt : tm.AllPathsHaltIn T)
    (x y : List Bool) :
    tm.outputProb x (T' x.length) y = tm.outputProb x (T x.length) y

name: Complexity.NTM.traceEventProb_eq_of_le_of_allChoicesHalt
statement:
theorem NTM.traceEventProb_eq_of_le_of_allChoicesHalt {n T T' : ℕ}
    (tm : NTM n) (c : Cfg n tm.Q)
    (event : Cfg n tm.Q → Prop) [DecidablePred event] (hle : T ≤ T')
    (hhalt : ∀ choices : Fin T → Bool,
      tm.halted (tm.trace T choices c)) :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter fun choices : Fin T' → Bool =>
      event (tm.trace T' choices c)) =
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter fun choices : Fin T → Bool =>
        event (tm.trace T choices c))

name: Complexity.binomial_lower_tail_le
statement:
theorem binomial_lower_tail_le (r : ℕ) (p : ℚ)
    (hp_lower : 2 / 3 ≤ p) (hp_upper : p ≤ 1) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
        ((2 * r + 1).choose j : ℚ) * p ^ j *
          (1 - p) ^ (2 * r + 1 - j)) ≤
      (1 / 3) * (8 / 9) ^ r

name: Complexity.card_le_pow
statement: theorem card_le_pow {T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) : E.card ≤ 2 ^ T

name: Complexity.eventProb_biUnion
statement:
theorem eventProb_biUnion {T : ℕ} {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (E : ι → Finset (Fin T → Bool))
    (h : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint E) :
    eventProb (s.biUnion E) = ∑ i ∈ s, eventProb (E i)

name: Complexity.eventProb_biUnion_le
statement:
theorem eventProb_biUnion_le {T : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι)
    (E : ι → Finset (Fin T → Bool)) :
    eventProb (s.biUnion E) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, eventProb (E i)

name: Complexity.eventProb_block
statement:
theorem eventProb_block {a b : ℕ}
    (P : (Fin a → Bool) → Prop) (Q : (Fin b → Bool) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q] :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun w : Fin (a + b) → Bool => P (blockFst a b w) ∧ Q (blockSnd a b w)))
      = eventProb (Finset.univ.filter P) * eventProb (Finset.univ.filter Q)

name: Complexity.eventProb_blockMajority_eq_false
statement:
theorem eventProb_blockMajority_eq_false
    (T r : ℕ) (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin ((2 * r + 1) * T) → Bool =>
      blockMajority E w = false)) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
        ((2 * r + 1).choose j : ℚ) * eventProb E ^ j *
          (1 - eventProb E) ^ (2 * r + 1 - j)

name: Complexity.eventProb_blockMajority_false_le_two_pow
statement:
theorem eventProb_blockMajority_false_le_two_pow
    (T k : ℕ) (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (hE : 2 / 3 ≤ eventProb E) :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin ((12 * k + 1) * T) → Bool =>
      blockMajority E w = false)) ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ k

name: Complexity.eventProb_blockMajority_true_ge_one_sub_two_pow
statement:
theorem eventProb_blockMajority_true_ge_one_sub_two_pow
    (T k : ℕ) (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (hE : 2 / 3 ≤ eventProb E) :
    1 - 1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ k ≤
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun w : Fin ((12 * k + 1) * T) → Bool => blockMajority E w = true))

name: Complexity.eventProb_blockMajority_true_le_two_pow
statement:
theorem eventProb_blockMajority_true_le_two_pow
    (T k : ℕ) (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (hE : eventProb E ≤ 1 / 3) :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun w : Fin ((12 * k + 1) * T) → Bool => blockMajority E w = true))
      ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ k

name: Complexity.eventProb_compl
statement:
theorem eventProb_compl {T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) :
    eventProb Eᶜ = 1 - eventProb E

name: Complexity.eventProb_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem eventProb_empty {T : ℕ} : eventProb (∅ : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) = 0

name: Complexity.eventProb_eq_sum_fiberwise
statement:
theorem eventProb_eq_sum_fiberwise {T : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (s : Finset ι) (f : (Fin T → Bool) → ι)
    (h : (E : Set (Fin T → Bool)).MapsTo f s) :
    eventProb E = ∑ i ∈ s, eventProb (E.filter fun w => f w = i)

name: Complexity.eventProb_filter_bool_true
statement:
theorem eventProb_filter_bool_true (T : ℕ)
    (f : (Fin T → Bool) → Bool) :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => f w = true)) =
      1 - eventProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => f w = false))

name: Complexity.eventProb_filter_of_constant_fibers
statement:
theorem eventProb_filter_of_constant_fibers
    {total compact ignored : ℕ} (htotal : total = compact + ignored)
    (randomSeed : (Fin total → Bool) → (Fin compact → Bool))
    (Accept : (Fin total → Bool) → Prop)
    (Good : (Fin compact → Bool) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred Accept] [DecidablePred Good]
    (hfactor : ∀ w, Accept w ↔ Good (randomSeed w))
    (hfiber : ∀ seed,
      (Finset.univ.filter fun w => randomSeed w = seed).card = 2 ^ ignored) :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter Accept) =
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter Good)

name: Complexity.eventProb_le_one
statement: theorem eventProb_le_one {T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) : eventProb E ≤ 1

name: Complexity.eventProb_le_uniformAverage_div
statement:
theorem eventProb_le_uniformAverage_div {T : ℕ}
    (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) (weight : (Fin T → Bool) → ℚ)
    (threshold : ℚ) (hthreshold : 0 < threshold)
    (hweight : ∀ seed, 0 ≤ weight seed)
    (hlarge : ∀ seed ∈ E, threshold ≤ weight seed) :
    eventProb E ≤
      ((∑ seed : Fin T → Bool, weight seed) / (2 : ℚ) ^ T) / threshold

name: Complexity.eventProb_map
statement:
theorem eventProb_map {T : ℕ} (e : (Fin T → Bool) ≃ (Fin T → Bool))
    (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) :
    eventProb (E.map e.toEmbedding) = eventProb E

name: Complexity.eventProb_mono
statement:
theorem eventProb_mono {T : ℕ} {E F : Finset (Fin T → Bool)} (h : E ⊆ F) :
    eventProb E ≤ eventProb F

name: Complexity.eventProb_nonneg
statement: theorem eventProb_nonneg {T : ℕ} (E : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) : 0 ≤ eventProb E

name: Complexity.eventProb_repeatRandomSeed
statement:
theorem eventProb_repeatRandomSeed (k T : ℕ)
    (P : (Fin (k * T) → Bool) → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    eventProb (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin (2 + k * (2 * T + 2)) → Bool =>
      P (repeatRandomSeed k T w))) =
      eventProb (Finset.univ.filter P)

name: Complexity.eventProb_union_le
statement:
theorem eventProb_union_le {T : ℕ} (E F : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) :
    eventProb (E ∪ F) ≤ eventProb E + eventProb F

name: Complexity.eventProb_univ
statement:
@[simp] theorem eventProb_univ {T : ℕ} :
    eventProb (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin T → Bool)) = 1

name: Complexity.exists_good_seed_of_eventProb_le_two_pow_succ
statement:
theorem exists_good_seed_of_eventProb_le_two_pow_succ (n S : ℕ)
    (bad : (Fin n → Bool) → Finset (Fin S → Bool))
    (hbad : ∀ x, eventProb (bad x) ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ (n + 1)) :
    ∃ seed : Fin S → Bool, ∀ x, seed ∉ bad x

name: Complexity.exists_good_seed_of_sum_eventProb_lt_one
statement:
theorem exists_good_seed_of_sum_eventProb_lt_one {S : ℕ} {ι : Type*}
    (inputs : Finset ι) (bad : ι → Finset (Fin S → Bool))
    (h : ∑ i ∈ inputs, eventProb (bad i) < 1) :
    ∃ seed : Fin S → Bool, ∀ i ∈ inputs, seed ∉ bad i

name: Complexity.delimit_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem delimit_cons (b : Bool) (l : List Bool) :
    delimit (b :: l) = b :: b :: delimit l

name: Complexity.delimit_length
statement: @[simp] theorem delimit_length (l : List Bool) : (delimit l).length = 2 * l.length + 2

name: Complexity.delimit_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem delimit_nil : delimit [] = [false, true]

name: Complexity.eq_delimit_append_of_unpair?_eq_some
statement:
theorem eq_delimit_append_of_unpair?_eq_some :
    ∀ {z x y : List Bool}, unpair? z = some (x, y) → z = delimit x ++ y
  | [], _, _, h => by simp [unpair?] at h
  | [b], _, _, h => by cases b <;> simp [unpair?] at h
  | false :: true :: rest, x, y, h => by
    simp only [unpair?, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: Complexity.hasBlock_eq_isSome_unpair?
statement:
theorem hasBlock_eq_isSome_unpair? :
    ∀ l : List Bool, hasBlock l = (unpair? l).isSome
  | [] => rfl
  | [b] => by cases b <;> rfl
  | false :: true :: _ => rfl
  | false :: false :: rest => by
    simp only [hasBlock, unpair?, hasBlock_eq_isSome_unpair? rest]
    cases unpair? rest <;> rfl
  | true :: true :: rest => by
    simp only [hasBlock, unpair?, hasBlock_eq_isSome_unpair? rest]
    cases unpair? rest <;> rfl
  | true :: false :: _ => rfl

name: Complexity.length_le_length_flatten_delimit
statement:
theorem length_le_length_flatten_delimit (l : List (List Bool)) :
    l.length ≤ ((l.map delimit).flatten).length

name: Complexity.takeFirstBlock_delimit_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem takeFirstBlock_delimit_append (P Q : List Bool) :
    takeFirstBlock (delimit P ++ Q) = delimit P

name: Complexity.takeFirstBlock_eq_nil_of_unpair?_eq_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem takeFirstBlock_eq_nil_of_unpair?_eq_none {input : List Bool}
    (h : unpair? input = none) :
    takeFirstBlock input = []

name: Complexity.undelimitBlock_delimit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem undelimitBlock_delimit (P : List Bool) :
    undelimitBlock (delimit P) = P

name: Complexity.undelimitBlock_delimit_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem undelimitBlock_delimit_append (P Q : List Bool) :
    undelimitBlock (delimit P ++ Q) = P

name: Complexity.undelimitBlock_eq_nil_of_unpair?_eq_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem undelimitBlock_eq_nil_of_unpair?_eq_none {input : List Bool}
    (h : unpair? input = none) :
    undelimitBlock input = []

name: Complexity.undelimitBlocks_flatten_delimit
statement:
theorem undelimitBlocks_flatten_delimit (l : List (List Bool)) :
    undelimitBlocks ((l.map delimit).flatten) = some l

name: Complexity.unpair?_delimit_append
statement:
@[simp] theorem unpair?_delimit_append (x y : List Bool) :
    unpair? (delimit x ++ y) = some (x, y)

name: Complexity.eq_pair_of_unpair?_eq_some
statement:
theorem eq_pair_of_unpair?_eq_some {z x y : List Bool} (h : unpair? z = some (x, y)) :
    z = pair x y

name: Complexity.pairFst_length_le
statement: theorem pairFst_length_le (z : List Bool) : (pairFst z).length ≤ z.length

name: Complexity.pairFst_pair
statement: @[simp] theorem pairFst_pair (x y : List Bool) : pairFst (pair x y) = x

name: Complexity.pairSnd_eq_unpair?
statement:
theorem pairSnd_eq_unpair? (z : List Bool) :
    pairSnd z = ((unpair? z).map Prod.snd).getD []

name: Complexity.pairSnd_length_le
statement: theorem pairSnd_length_le (z : List Bool) : (pairSnd z).length ≤ z.length

name: Complexity.pairSnd_pair
statement: @[simp] theorem pairSnd_pair (x y : List Bool) : pairSnd (pair x y) = y

name: Complexity.pair_cons_eq
statement:
theorem pair_cons_eq (b : Bool) (x y : List Bool) :
    pair (b :: x) y = b :: b :: pair x y

name: Complexity.pair_getElem_left_first
statement:
theorem pair_getElem_left_first (x y : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length) :
    (pair x y)[2 * i]'(by rw [pair_length]; omega) = x[i]'hi

name: Complexity.pair_getElem_left_second
statement:
theorem pair_getElem_left_second (x y : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < x.length) :
    (pair x y)[2 * i + 1]'(by rw [pair_length]; omega) = x[i]'hi

name: Complexity.pair_getElem_right
statement:
theorem pair_getElem_right (x y : List Bool) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < y.length) :
    (pair x y)[2 * x.length + 2 + j]'(by rw [pair_length]; omega) = y[j]'hj

name: Complexity.pair_getElem_sep_one
statement:
theorem pair_getElem_sep_one (x y : List Bool) :
    (pair x y)[2 * x.length + 1]'(by rw [pair_length]; omega) = true

name: Complexity.pair_getElem_sep_zero
statement:
theorem pair_getElem_sep_zero (x y : List Bool) :
    (pair x y)[2 * x.length]'(by rw [pair_length]; omega) = false

name: Complexity.pair_inj
statement:
theorem pair_inj {x₁ x₂ : List Bool} {y₁ y₂ : List Bool}
    (h : pair x₁ y₁ = pair x₂ y₂) : x₁ = x₂ ∧ y₁ = y₂

name: Complexity.pair_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem pair_length (x y : List Bool) :
    (pair x y).length = 2 * x.length + 2 + y.length

name: Complexity.unpair?_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem unpair?_eq_some_iff {z x y : List Bool} :
    unpair? z = some (x, y) ↔ z = pair x y

name: Complexity.unpair?_pair
statement:
@[simp] theorem unpair?_pair (x y : List Bool) :
    unpair? (pair x y) = some (x, y)

name: Complexity.AuxiliaryUnarySeed.splitLe
statement: theorem splitLe {m : ℕ} (seed : AuxiliaryUnarySeed m) : seed.split ≤ m

name: Complexity.DyadicEnsemble.probability_congr_internal
statement:
theorem probability_congr_internal (D : DyadicEnsemble α) (n : ℕ)
    (P Q : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q]
    (hPQ : ∀ x, P x ↔ Q x) :
    D.probability n P = D.probability n Q

name: Complexity.DyadicEnsemble.probability_dirac_internal
statement:
theorem probability_dirac_internal (x : ℕ → α) (n : ℕ)
    (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    (dirac x).probability n P = if P (x n) then 1 else 0

name: Complexity.DyadicEnsemble.probability_false_internal
statement:
theorem probability_false_internal (D : DyadicEnsemble α) (n : ℕ) :
    D.probability n (fun _ => False) = 0

name: Complexity.DyadicEnsemble.probability_le_one_internal
statement:
theorem probability_le_one_internal (D : DyadicEnsemble α) (n : ℕ)
    (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    D.probability n P ≤ 1

name: Complexity.DyadicEnsemble.probability_map_internal
statement:
theorem probability_map_internal (D : DyadicEnsemble α) (f : α → β)
    (n : ℕ) (P : β → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :

    [Fintype challenge] [Nonempty challenge]
    (event : advice → challenge → Prop)
    [∀ fixed, DecidablePred (event fixed)] :
    ∃ fixed : advice,
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun sample : advice × challenge =>
          event sample.1 sample.2) ≤
        uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter (event fixed))

    {sample : Type u} [Fintype sample]
    [Nonempty sample] (value : sample → ℚ) (epsilon : ℚ)
    (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon) (hupper : ∀ input, value input ≤ 1)
    (hmean : 1 / 2 + epsilon ≤ uniformMean value) :
    epsilon / 2 ≤
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun input =>
        1 / 2 + epsilon / 2 ≤ value input)

    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) (singleDrawLower : ℚ)
    (hlower : singleDrawLower ≤ uniformProbability event)
    (htrials : 1 ≤ (trials : ℚ) * singleDrawLower) :
    1 / 2 ≤ uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials

    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) (singleDrawLower : ℚ)
    (hlower : singleDrawLower ≤ uniformProbability event) :
    1 - (1 - singleDrawLower) ^ trials ≤
      uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials

    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) :
    (trials : ℚ) * uniformProbability event /
        (1 + (trials : ℚ) * uniformProbability event) ≤
      uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials

    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) :
    uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials =

    [Nonempty sample] (value : sample → ℚ) (threshold : ℚ)
    (hupper : ∀ input, value input ≤ 1) :
    uniformMean value ≤ threshold +
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun input =>
        threshold ≤ value input) * (1 - threshold)

name: Complexity.uniformMean_sub_div_le_probability_ge_internal

    (hupper : ∀ input, value input ≤ 1)
    (hlower : lower ≤ uniformMean value) (hthreshold : threshold < 1) :
    (lower - threshold) / (1 - threshold) ≤
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun input =>
        threshold ≤ value input)

name: Complexity.FiniteEnsemble.probability_product

    [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q] :
    (D.product E).probability n (fun xy => P xy.1 ∧ Q xy.2) =
      D.probability n P * E.probability n Q

name: Complexity.exists_fiber_uniformProbability_ge
statement:

    {advice : Type u} {challenge : Type v}
    [Fintype advice] [Nonempty advice]
    [Fintype challenge] [Nonempty challenge]
    (event : advice → challenge → Prop)
    [∀ fixed, DecidablePred (event fixed)] :
    ∃ fixed : advice,
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun sample : advice × challenge =>
          event sample.1 sample.2) ≤
        uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter (event fixed))

name: Complexity.half_epsilon_le_probability_ge_of_le_uniformMean
statement:
theorem half_epsilon_le_probability_ge_of_le_uniformMean
    {sample : Type u} [Fintype sample]
    [Nonempty sample] (value : sample → ℚ) (epsilon : ℚ)
    (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon) (hupper : ∀ input, value input ≤ 1)
    (hmean : 1 / 2 + epsilon ≤ uniformMean value) :
    epsilon / 2 ≤
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun input =>
        1 / 2 + epsilon / 2 ≤ value input)

name: Complexity.half_le_uniformAtLeastOneProbability_of_singleDrawLower
statement:
theorem half_le_uniformAtLeastOneProbability_of_singleDrawLower
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) (singleDrawLower : ℚ)
    (hlower : singleDrawLower ≤ uniformProbability event)
    (htrials : 1 ≤ (trials : ℚ) * singleDrawLower) :
    1 / 2 ≤ uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials

name: Complexity.one_sub_pow_le_uniformAtLeastOneProbability
statement:
theorem one_sub_pow_le_uniformAtLeastOneProbability
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) (singleDrawLower : ℚ)
    (hlower : singleDrawLower ≤ uniformProbability event) :
    1 - (1 - singleDrawLower) ^ trials ≤
      uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials

name: Complexity.trials_mul_div_one_add_le_uniformAtLeastOneProbability
statement:
theorem trials_mul_div_one_add_le_uniformAtLeastOneProbability
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) :
    (trials : ℚ) * uniformProbability event /
        (1 + (trials : ℚ) * uniformProbability event) ≤
      uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials

name: Complexity.uniformAtLeastOneProbability_eq_one_sub_pow
statement:
theorem uniformAtLeastOneProbability_eq_one_sub_pow
    {Ω : Type u} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (event : Finset Ω) (trials : ℕ) :
    uniformAtLeastOneProbability event trials =
      1 - (1 - uniformProbability event) ^ trials

name: Complexity.uniformMean_le_threshold_add_probability
statement:
theorem uniformMean_le_threshold_add_probability
    {sample : Type u} [Fintype sample]
    [Nonempty sample] (value : sample → ℚ) (threshold : ℚ)
    (hupper : ∀ input, value input ≤ 1) :
    uniformMean value ≤ threshold +
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun input =>
        threshold ≤ value input) * (1 - threshold)

name: Complexity.uniformMean_sub_div_le_probability_ge
statement:
theorem uniformMean_sub_div_le_probability_ge
    {sample : Type u} [Fintype sample]
    [Nonempty sample] (value : sample → ℚ) (lower threshold : ℚ)
    (hupper : ∀ input, value input ≤ 1)
    (hlower : lower ≤ uniformMean value) (hthreshold : threshold < 1) :
    (lower - threshold) / (1 - threshold) ≤
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun input =>
        threshold ≤ value input)

name: Complexity.uniformProbability_eq_sum_fiberwise

theorem uniformProbability_eq_sum_fiberwise
    {Ω : Type u} {ι : Type v} [Fintype Ω]
    [DecidableEq ι] (event : Finset Ω) (indices : Finset ι) (f : Ω → ι)
    (hmaps : (event : Set Ω).MapsTo f indices) :
    uniformProbability event =
      ∑ i ∈ indices,
        uniformProbability (event.filter fun seed => f seed = i)

      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter P)

name: Complexity.uniformProbability_product
statement:
theorem uniformProbability_product
    {Ω : Type u} {Ξ : Type v} [Fintype Ω]
    [Fintype Ξ] (P : Ω → Prop) (Q : Ξ → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q] :
    uniformProbability
        (Finset.univ.filter fun seed : Ω × Ξ => P seed.1 ∧ Q seed.2) =
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter P) *
      uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter Q)

name: Complexity.uniformProbability_product_eq_average_fibers
statement:
theorem uniformProbability_product_eq_average_fibers
    {advice : Type u} {challenge : Type v}
    [Fintype advice] [Nonempty advice]
    [Fintype challenge] [Nonempty challenge]
    (event : advice → challenge → Prop)
    [∀ fixed, DecidablePred (event fixed)] :
    uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter fun sample : advice × challenge =>
        event sample.1 sample.2) =
      (∑ fixed : advice,
        uniformProbability (Finset.univ.filter (event fixed))) /
        Fintype.card advice

name: Complexity.TM.blankWorkTM_hoareTime_frame_of_binaryString
statement:
theorem blankWorkTM_hoareTime_frame_of_binaryString {n : ℕ}
    (idx : Fin n) (x : List Bool)
    {P : Tape → (Fin n → Tape) → Tape → Prop}
    (hP_preserved : ∀ (inp : Tape) (work : Fin n → Tape) (out : Tape)
      (inp' : Tape) (work' : Fin n → Tape) (out' : Tape),
      P inp work out →
      (work' idx).head = x.length + 1 →
      (work' idx).cells 0 = Γ.start →
      (∀ i, (work' idx).cells (i + 1) = Γ.blank) →
      inp' = inp →
      out' = out →
      (∀ i, i ≠ idx → work' i = work i) →
      P inp' work' out') :
    (blankWorkTM idx).HoareTime
      (fun inp work out =>
        work idx = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right ∧
        inp.read ≠ Γ.start ∧
        out.read ≠ Γ.start ∧ out.head ≥ 1 ∧
        (∀ i, i ≠ idx → (work i).read ≠ Γ.start ∧ (work i).head ≥ 1) ∧
        P inp work out)
      (fun inp work out =>
        (work idx).head = x.length + 1 ∧
        (work idx).cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        (∀ i, (work idx).cells (i + 1) = Γ.blank) ∧
        P inp work out)
      (x.length + 1)

        work idx = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right)

        (work idx).head = x.length + 1 ∧
        (work idx).cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        (∀ i, (work idx).cells (i + 1) = Γ.blank))

      (fun inp work _out =>
        inp.cells = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).cells ∧
        inp.head = x.length + 1 ∧
        (work idx).HasBinaryPrefix x)
      (x.length + 1)

name: Complexity.TM.copyWorkToWorkTM_hoareTime_frame_of_binaryString
statement:
theorem copyWorkToWorkTM_hoareTime_frame_of_binaryString {n : ℕ}
    (src dst : Fin n) (hne : src ≠ dst) (x : List Bool)
    {P : Tape → (Fin n → Tape) → Tape → Prop}
    (hP_preserved : ∀ (inp : Tape) (work : Fin n → Tape) (out : Tape)
      (inp' : Tape) (work' : Fin n → Tape) (out' : Tape),
      P inp work out →
      (work' src).cells = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).cells →
      (work' src).head = x.length + 1 →
      (work' dst).HasBinaryPrefix x →
      (work' dst).cells 0 = Γ.start →
      inp' = inp →
      out' = out →
      (∀ i, i ≠ src → i ≠ dst → work' i = work i) →
      P inp' work' out') :
    (copyWorkToWorkTM src dst).HoareTime
      (fun inp work out =>
        work src = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right ∧
        work dst = (Tape.init []).move Dir3.right ∧
        inp.read ≠ Γ.start ∧
        out.read ≠ Γ.start ∧ out.head ≥ 1 ∧
        (∀ i, i ≠ src → i ≠ dst → (work i).read ≠ Γ.start ∧ (work i).head ≥ 1) ∧
        P inp work out)
      (fun inp work out =>
        (work src).cells = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).cells ∧
        (work src).head = x.length + 1 ∧
        (work dst).HasBinaryPrefix x ∧
        (work dst).cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        P inp work out)
      (x.length + 1)

    (src dst : Fin n) (hne : src ≠ dst) (x : List Bool) :
    (copyWorkToWorkTM src dst).HoareTime
      (fun _inp work _out =>
        work src = (Tape.init (x.map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right ∧

        (work dst).HasBinaryPrefix x)

theorem rewindInputTM_hoareTime (B : ℕ) :
    (rewindInputTM (n := n)).HoareTime
      (fun inp _ _ => inp.cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
                      (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → inp.cells j ≠ Γ.start) ∧
                      inp.head ≤ B)
      (fun inp _ _ => inp.head = 1)
      (B + 2)

name: Complexity.TM.rewindInputTM_hoareTime_frame
statement:
theorem rewindInputTM_hoareTime_frame {n : ℕ} (B_input : ℕ)
    {P : Tape → (Fin n → Tape) → Tape → Prop}
    (hP_preserved : ∀ (inp : Tape) (work : Fin n → Tape) (out : Tape)
      (inp' : Tape) (work' : Fin n → Tape) (out' : Tape),
      P inp work out →
      inp'.cells = inp.cells →
      inp'.head = 1 →
      work' = work →
      out' = out →
      P inp' work' out') :
    (rewindInputTM (n := n)).HoareTime
      (fun inp work out =>
        inp.cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → inp.cells j ≠ Γ.start) ∧
        inp.head ≤ B_input ∧
        out.read ≠ Γ.start ∧ out.head ≥ 1 ∧
        (∀ i, (work i).read ≠ Γ.start ∧ (work i).head ≥ 1) ∧
        P inp work out)
      (fun inp work out =>
        inp.head = 1 ∧
        P inp work out)
      (B_input + 2)

name: Complexity.TM.rewindInputTM_toNTM_hoareTime_frame
statement:
theorem rewindInputTM_toNTM_hoareTime_frame {n : ℕ} (B_input : ℕ)
    {P : Tape → (Fin n → Tape) → Tape → Prop}
    (hP_preserved : ∀ (inp : Tape) (work : Fin n → Tape) (out : Tape)
      (inp' : Tape) (work' : Fin n → Tape) (out' : Tape),
      P inp work out →
      inp'.cells = inp.cells →

      out' = out →
      P inp' work' out') :
    ((rewindInputTM (n := n)).toNTM).HoareTime
      (fun inp work out =>
        inp.cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → inp.cells j ≠ Γ.start) ∧
        inp.head ≤ B_input ∧
        out.read ≠ Γ.start ∧ out.head ≥ 1 ∧
        (∀ i, (work i).read ≠ Γ.start ∧ (work i).head ≥ 1) ∧
        P inp work out)
      (fun inp work out =>
        inp.head = 1 ∧
        P inp work out)
      (B_input + 2)

name: Complexity.TM.rewindWorkTM_hoareTime

theorem rewindWorkTM_hoareTime (idx : Fin n) (B : ℕ) :

      (fun _ work _ => (work idx).cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
                       (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → (work idx).cells j ≠ Γ.start) ∧
                       (work idx).head ≤ B)
      (fun _ work _ => (work idx).head = 1)
      (B + 2)

name: Complexity.TM.rewindWorkTM_hoareTime_frame
statement:
theorem rewindWorkTM_hoareTime_frame {n : ℕ} (idx : Fin n) (B_tape : ℕ)
    {P : Tape → (Fin n → Tape) → Tape → Prop}
    (hP_preserved : ∀ (inp : Tape) (work : Fin n → Tape) (out : Tape)
      (inp' : Tape) (work' : Fin n → Tape) (out' : Tape),
      P inp work out →
      (work' idx).cells = (work idx).cells →
      (work' idx).head = 1 →
      (∀ i, i ≠ idx → work' i = work i) →
      inp' = inp →
      out'.cells = out.cells →
      out'.head = out.head →
      P inp' work' out') :
    (rewindWorkTM idx).HoareTime
      (fun inp work out =>
        (work idx).cells 0 = Γ.start ∧
        (∀ j, j ≥ 1 → (work idx).cells j ≠ Γ.start) ∧
        (work idx).head ≤ B_tape ∧
        inp.read ≠ Γ.start ∧
        out.read ≠ Γ.start ∧ out.head ≥ 1 ∧
        (∀ i, i ≠ idx → (work i).read ≠ Γ.start ∧ (work i).head ≥ 1) ∧
        P inp work out)
      (fun inp work out =>
        (work idx).head = 1 ∧
        P inp work out)
      (B_tape + 2)

theorem pairInputWorkTM_hoareTime_internal {n : ℕ}
    (firstIdx : Fin n) (first second : List Bool) :

      (fun inp work out =>
        inp = (Tape.init (second.map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right ∧
        (work firstIdx).head = 1 ∧
        (work firstIdx).HasOutput first ∧
        (∀ i, (work i).StartInvariant ∧ 1 ≤ (work i).head) ∧
        out = (Tape.init []).move Dir3.right)

name: Complexity.TM.pairInputWorkTM_reachesIn_internal
statement:
theorem pairInputWorkTM_reachesIn_internal {n : ℕ}
    (firstIdx : Fin n) (first second : List Bool)
    {inp out : Tape} {work : Fin n → Tape}
    (hinput : inp = (Tape.init (second.map Γ.ofBool)).move Dir3.right)
    (hsourceHead : (work firstIdx).head = 1)
    (hsourceOutput : (work firstIdx).HasOutput first)
    (hwork : ∀ i, (work i).StartInvariant ∧ 1 ≤ (work i).head)
    (houtput : out = (Tape.init []).move Dir3.right) :
    ∃ c',
      (pairInputWorkTM firstIdx).reachesIn (pairInputWorkTime first second)
        { state := (pairInputWorkTM firstIdx).qstart,
          input := inp, work := work, output := out } c' ∧
      (pairInputWorkTM firstIdx).halted c' ∧
      c'.input.HasBinarySuffix [] ∧
      c'.input.cells = inp.cells ∧
      (c'.work firstIdx).HasBinarySuffix [] ∧
      (c'.work firstIdx).cells = (work firstIdx).cells ∧
      (c'.work firstIdx).HasOutput first ∧
      (∀ i, i ≠ firstIdx → c'.work i = work i) ∧
      c'.output.HasBinaryPrefix (pair first second)

theorem cfgBlocks_step {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) {c c' : Cfg k tm.Q} {W : ℕ}
    (h : tm.step c = some c') (hout : c.output.StartInvariant)
    (hwork : ∀ i, (c.work i).StartInvariant)
    (hgood : List.Forall₂ (fun (a : Γ × Dir3) (t : Tape) =>
      (t.head = 0 → a.1 = t.cells t.head) ∧
      (a.2 ≠ Dir3.right → t.head ≠ 0) ∧ t.head ≤ W) (stepActs tm c) (cfgTapes c)) :
    cfgBlocks W c' =
      padTo (blockRuler W) (stateCode c'.state) ::
        (List.zipWith (fun a t =>
          [(tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
              (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).1,
           (tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
              (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).2])
          (stepActs tm c) (cfgTapes c)).flatten

statement:
theorem cfgTapes_step {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) {c c' : Cfg k tm.Q}
    (h : tm.step c = some c') (hout : c.output.StartInvariant)
    (hwork : ∀ i, (c.work i).StartInvariant) :
    cfgTapes c' = tapesStep (stepActs tm c) (cfgTapes c)

name: Complexity.Cobham.correctWrite_at_zero
statement:
theorem correctWrite_at_zero {t : Tape} (s : Γ) (h : t.StartInvariant)
    (hh : t.head = 0) : correctWrite t s = t.cells t.head

name: Complexity.Cobham.getElem?_tapesBlocks
statement:
theorem getElem?_tapesBlocks (W : ℕ) :
    ∀ (ts : List Tape) (j : ℕ),
      (tapesBlocks W ts)[2 * j]? =
        (ts[j]?).map (fun t => padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t)) ∧
      (tapesBlocks W ts)[2 * j + 1]? =
        (ts[j]?).map (fun t => padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))

name: Complexity.Cobham.heads_le_of_reachesIn
Complexity.Cobham.inputRead_of_cfgCode
statement:
theorem inputRead_of_cfgCode {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]
    (W : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Q) (hW : c.input.head ≤ W) :
    symDecode ((blockAt (blockRuler W) (cfgCode W c) 2).take 2) = c.input.read

name: Complexity.Cobham.keyCode_eq
statement:
theorem keyCode_eq {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] (c : Cfg k Q) :
    keyCode c = keyPattern (c.state, cfgReads c)

name: Complexity.Cobham.keyCode_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem keyCode_length {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]
    (c : Cfg k Q) : (keyCode c).length = Fintype.card Q + 2 * (k + 2)

name: Complexity.Cobham.keyPattern_injective
statement:
theorem keyPattern_injective {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] :
    Function.Injective (keyPattern (k := k) (Q := Q))

name: Complexity.Cobham.keyPattern_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem keyPattern_length {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]
    (p : Q × (Fin (k + 2) → Γ)) :
    (keyPattern p).length = Fintype.card Q + 2 * (k + 2)

name: Complexity.Cobham.leftCodeFrom_congr
Complexity.Cobham.leftCodeFrom_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftCodeFrom_length (t : Tape) (n : ℕ) :
    (leftCodeFrom t n).length = 2 * n

name: Complexity.Cobham.leftCodeFrom_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftCodeFrom_succ (t : Tape) (n : ℕ) :
    leftCodeFrom t (n + 1) = symCode (t.cells n) ++ leftCodeFrom t n

name: Complexity.Cobham.leftCodeFrom_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem leftCodeFrom_zero (t : Tape) : leftCodeFrom t 0 = []

name: Complexity.Cobham.leftCode_congr
statement:
theorem leftCode_congr {t t' : Tape} (hh : t.head = t'.head)
    (h : ∀ j, j < t.head → t.cells j = t'.cells j) : leftCode t = leftCode t'

name: Complexity.Cobham.leftCode_length
statement: @[simp] theorem leftCode_length (t : Tape) : (leftCode t).length = 2 * t.head

name: Complexity.Cobham.leftCode_rightCode_length
statement:
theorem leftCode_rightCode_length (t : Tape) {W : ℕ} (h : t.head ≤ W + 1) :
    (leftCode t).length + (rightCode t W).length = 2 * (W + 1)

name: Complexity.Cobham.leftCode_write_left
statement:
theorem leftCode_write_left {t : Tape} {s : Γ} (h : t.head ≠ 0) :
    leftCode ((t.write s).move Dir3.left) = (leftCode t).drop 2

name: Complexity.Cobham.leftCode_write_right
Complexity.Cobham.leftCode_write_stay
statement:
theorem leftCode_write_stay {t : Tape} {s : Γ} :
    leftCode ((t.write s).move Dir3.stay) = leftCode t

name: Complexity.Cobham.rightCode_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightCode_length (t : Tape) (W : ℕ) :
    (rightCode t W).length = 2 * (W + 1 - t.head)

name: Complexity.Cobham.rightCode_write_left
statement:
theorem rightCode_write_left {t : Tape} {s : Γ} {W : ℕ} (h : t.head ≠ 0)
    (hW : t.head ≤ W) :
    rightCode ((t.write s).move Dir3.left) W =
      (leftCode t).take 2 ++ symCode s ++ (rightCode t W).drop 2

name: Complexity.Cobham.rightCode_write_right
statement:
theorem rightCode_write_right {t : Tape} {s : Γ} {W : ℕ} (hW : t.head ≤ W) :
    rightCode ((t.write s).move Dir3.right) W = (rightCode t W).drop 2

name: Complexity.Cobham.rightCode_write_stay
statement:
theorem rightCode_write_stay {t : Tape} {s : Γ} {W : ℕ} (h : t.head ≠ 0)
    (hW : t.head ≤ W) :
    rightCode ((t.write s).move Dir3.stay) W = symCode s ++ (rightCode t W).drop 2

name: Complexity.Cobham.stateCode_injective
statement:
theorem stateCode_injective {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] :
    Function.Injective (stateCode (Q := Q))

name: Complexity.Cobham.stateCode_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem stateCode_length {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] (q : Q) :
    (stateCode q).length = Fintype.card Q

name: Complexity.Cobham.state_of_cfgCode
statement:
theorem state_of_cfgCode {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]
    (W : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Q) (hW : Fintype.card Q ≤ blockWidth W) :
    (blockAt (blockRuler W) (cfgCode W c) 0).take (Fintype.card Q)
      = stateCode c.state

name: Complexity.Cobham.stepActs_eq_stepActsOf
statement:
theorem stepActs_eq_stepActsOf {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) (c : Cfg k tm.Q) :
    stepActs tm c = stepActsOf tm c.state (cfgReads c)

name: Complexity.Cobham.stepActs_forall₂
statement:
theorem stepActs_forall₂ {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) (c : Cfg k tm.Q) {W : ℕ}
    (hinv : ∀ t ∈ cfgTapes c, t.StartInvariant)
    (hW : ∀ t ∈ cfgTapes c, t.head ≤ W) :
    List.Forall₂ (fun (a : Γ × Dir3) (t : Tape) =>
      (t.head = 0 → a.1 = t.cells t.head) ∧
      (a.2 ≠ Dir3.right → t.head ≠ 0) ∧ t.head ≤ W)
      (stepActs tm c) (cfgTapes c)

name: Complexity.Cobham.step_state_eq
statement:
theorem step_state_eq {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) {c c' : Cfg k tm.Q}
    (h : tm.step c = some c') : c'.state = stepStateOf tm c.state (cfgReads c)

name: Complexity.Cobham.symCode_blank
statement: @[simp] theorem symCode_blank : symCode Γ.blank = [false, false]

name: Complexity.Cobham.symCode_injective
statement: theorem symCode_injective : Function.Injective symCode

name: Complexity.Cobham.symCode_length
statement: @[simp] theorem symCode_length (g : Γ) : (symCode g).length = 2

name: Complexity.Cobham.symDecode_replicate_false
statement:
theorem symDecode_replicate_false {n : ℕ} (h : 2 ≤ n) :
    symDecode (List.replicate n false) = Γ.blank

name: Complexity.Cobham.symDecode_rightCode
statement:
theorem symDecode_rightCode (t : Tape) {W : ℕ} (hw : t.head ≤ W) :
    symDecode (rightCode t W) = t.read

name: Complexity.Cobham.symDecode_symCode
statement:
@[simp] theorem symDecode_symCode (g : Γ) (rest : List Bool) :
    symDecode (symCode g ++ rest) = g

name: Complexity.Cobham.symDecode_take_padTo_rightCode
statement:
theorem symDecode_take_padTo_rightCode {W : ℕ} (t : Tape) (hW : t.head ≤ W) :
    symDecode ((padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W)).take 2) = t.read

name: Complexity.Cobham.symDecode_take_two
statement: theorem symDecode_take_two (l : List Bool) : symDecode (l.take 2) = symDecode l

name: Complexity.Cobham.take_rightCode
statement:
theorem take_rightCode (t : Tape) {W : ℕ} (hW : t.head ≤ W) :
    (rightCode t W).take 2 = symCode t.read

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapeBlocks_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem tapeBlocks_length (W : ℕ) (t : Tape) :
    (tapeBlocks W t).length = 2

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapeBlocks_step
statement:
theorem tapeBlocks_step {W : ℕ} (a : Γ × Dir3) (t : Tape)
    (hs : t.head = 0 → a.1 = t.cells t.head)
    (hne : a.2 ≠ Dir3.right → t.head ≠ 0) (hW : t.head ≤ W) :
    tapeBlocks W ((t.write a.1).move a.2) =
      [(tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
          (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).1,
       (tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
          (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).2]

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapeBlocks_width
statement:
theorem tapeBlocks_width (W : ℕ) (t : Tape) :
    ∀ b ∈ tapeBlocks W t, b.length = (blockRuler W).length

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapeCode_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem tapeCode_length (W : ℕ) (t : Tape) :
    (tapeCode W t).length = 2 * blockWidth W

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapeStepBlocks_eq
statement:
theorem tapeStepBlocks_eq {W : ℕ} (t : Tape) (s : Γ) (d : Dir3)
    (hs : t.head = 0 → s = t.cells t.head)
    (hne : d ≠ Dir3.right → t.head ≠ 0) (hW : t.head ≤ W) :
    tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) s d
        (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t)) (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))
      = (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode ((t.write s).move d)),
          padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode ((t.write s).move d) W))

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapesBlocks_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem tapesBlocks_length (W : ℕ) (ts : List Tape) :
    (tapesBlocks W ts).length = 2 * ts.length

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapesBlocks_tapesStep
statement:
theorem tapesBlocks_tapesStep {W : ℕ} :
    ∀ (acts : List (Γ × Dir3)) (ts : List Tape),
      List.Forall₂ (fun (a : Γ × Dir3) (t : Tape) =>
        (t.head = 0 → a.1 = t.cells t.head) ∧
        (a.2 ≠ Dir3.right → t.head ≠ 0) ∧ t.head ≤ W) acts ts →
      tapesBlocks W (tapesStep acts ts) =
        (List.zipWith (fun a t =>
          [(tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
              (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).1,
           (tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
              (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).2]) acts ts).flatten

name: Complexity.Cobham.worksCode_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem worksCode_length {k : ℕ} (W : ℕ) (work : Fin k → Tape) :
    (worksCode W work).length = k * (2 * blockWidth W)

name: Complexity.Cobham.write_cells_head
statement:
theorem write_cells_head {t : Tape} {s : Γ} (hs : t.head = 0 → s = t.cells t.head) :
    (t.write s).cells t.head = s

name: Complexity.Cobham.write_cells_of_ne
statement:
theorem write_cells_of_ne {t : Tape} {s : Γ} {j : ℕ} (h : j ≠ t.head) :
    (t.write s).cells j = t.cells j

name: Complexity.Cobham.write_cells_self
statement:
theorem write_cells_self {t : Tape} {s : Γ} (h : t.head ≠ 0) :
    (t.write s).cells t.head = s

name: Complexity.Cobham.write_correctWrite
statement:
theorem write_correctWrite {t : Tape} (s : Γ) (h : t.StartInvariant) :
    t.write (correctWrite t s) = t.write s

name: Complexity.Cobham.write_read_self
statement: theorem write_read_self (t : Tape) : t.write t.read = t

name: Complexity.Cobham.blockAt_cfgCode_tape
statement:
theorem blockAt_cfgCode_tape {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]
    (W : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Q) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < (cfgTapes c).length) :
    blockAt (blockRuler W) (cfgCode W c) (2 * j + 1)
        = padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode (cfgTapes c)[j]) ∧
      blockAt (blockRuler W) (cfgCode W c) (2 * j + 2)
        = padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode (cfgTapes c)[j] W)

name: Complexity.Cobham.branchFn_eq
statement:
theorem branchFn_eq {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) {c c' : Cfg k tm.Q} {W : ℕ}
    (h : tm.step c = some c') (hout : c.output.StartInvariant)
    (hwork : ∀ i, (c.work i).StartInvariant)
    (hgood : List.Forall₂ (fun (a : Γ × Dir3) (t : Tape) =>
      (t.head = 0 → a.1 = t.cells t.head) ∧
      (a.2 ≠ Dir3.right → t.head ≠ 0) ∧ t.head ≤ W) (stepActs tm c) (cfgTapes c)) :
    branchFn (blockRuler W) (stateCode c'.state) (stepActs tm c) (cfgCode W c)
      = cfgCode W c'

name: Complexity.Cobham.branchFn_length_le
statement:
theorem branchFn_length_le (R q' : List Bool) (acts : List (Γ × Dir3)) (z : List Bool) :
    (branchFn R q' acts z).length ≤ (2 * acts.length + 1) * R.length

name: Complexity.Cobham.branchFn_mem
statement:
theorem branchFn_mem {n : ℕ} (q' : List Bool) (acts : List (Γ × Dir3))
    {gR gz : (Fin n → List Bool) → List Bool} (hR : Cobham gR) (hz : Cobham gz) :
    Cobham fun v : Fin n → List Bool => branchFn (gR v) q' acts (gz v)

name: Complexity.Cobham.cellsCode_add
statement:
theorem cellsCode_add (t : Tape) (i a b : ℕ) :
    cellsCode t i (a + b) = cellsCode t i a ++ cellsCode t (i + a) b

name: Complexity.Cobham.drop_pairCode
statement:
theorem drop_pairCode (W : ℕ) (t : Tape) :
    (pairCode W t).drop (blockRuler W).length = padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W)

name: Complexity.Cobham.encodeBitsFn
statement:
theorem encodeBitsFn {n : ℕ} {g : (Fin n → List Bool) → List Bool} (h : Cobham g) :
    Cobham fun v : Fin n → List Bool => encodeBits (g v)

name: Complexity.Cobham.encodeBits_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem encodeBits_cons (b : Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    encodeBits (b :: x) = symCode (Γ.ofBool b) ++ encodeBits x

name: Complexity.Cobham.encodeBits_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem encodeBits_length (x : List Bool) :
    (encodeBits x).length = 2 * x.length

name: Complexity.Cobham.encodeBits_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem encodeBits_nil : encodeBits [] = []

name: Complexity.Cobham.initFn_eq
statement:
theorem initFn_eq {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) (W : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (hx : x.length ≤ W) :
    initFn tm (blockRuler W) x = cfgCode W (tm.initCfg x)

name: Complexity.Cobham.initFn_mem
statement:
theorem initFn_mem {n k : ℕ} (tm : TM k)
    {gR gx : (Fin n → List Bool) → List Bool} (hR : Cobham gR) (hx : Cobham gx) :
    Cobham fun v : Fin n → List Bool => initFn tm (gR v) (gx v)

name: Complexity.Cobham.keyFn_eq
statement:
theorem keyFn_eq {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]
    (W : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Q) (hq : Fintype.card Q ≤ blockWidth W)
    (hW : ∀ t ∈ cfgTapes c, t.head ≤ W) :
    keyFn (blockRuler W) (Fintype.card Q) (k + 2) (cfgCode W c) = keyCode c

name: Complexity.Cobham.keyFn_mem
statement:
theorem keyFn_mem {n : ℕ} (q m : ℕ)
    {gR gz : (Fin n → List Bool) → List Bool} (hR : Cobham gR) (hz : Cobham gz) :
    Cobham fun v : Fin n → List Bool => keyFn (gR v) q m (gz v)

name: Complexity.Cobham.mem_stepEntries
statement:
theorem mem_stepEntries {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) (p : tm.Q × (Fin (k + 2) → Γ)) :
    p ∈ stepEntries tm

name: Complexity.Cobham.readsFn_eq
statement:
theorem readsFn_eq {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]
    (W : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Q) (hW : ∀ t ∈ cfgTapes c, t.head ≤ W) :
    ∀ (m j : ℕ), j + m = (cfgTapes c).length →
      readsFn (blockRuler W) m j (cfgCode W c)
        = ((cfgTapes c).drop j).flatMap fun t => symCode t.read

name: Complexity.Cobham.readsFn_mem
statement:
theorem readsFn_mem {n : ℕ} (m j : ℕ)
    {gR gz : (Fin n → List Bool) → List Bool} (hR : Cobham gR) (hz : Cobham gz) :
    Cobham fun v : Fin n → List Bool => readsFn (gR v) m j (gz v)

name: Complexity.Cobham.rewindFn_eq
statement:
theorem rewindFn_eq {W : ℕ} (t : Tape) (hinv : t.StartInvariant) (hW : t.head ≤ W) :
    rewindFn (blockRuler W) (pairCode W t) = pairCode W (t.move Dir3.left)

name: Complexity.Cobham.rewindFn_length_le
statement:
theorem rewindFn_length_le (R z : List Bool) (hz : z.length ≤ 2 * R.length) :
    (rewindFn R z).length ≤ 2 * R.length

name: Complexity.Cobham.rewindFn_mem
Complexity.Cobham.stepActsOf_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem stepActsOf_length {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) (q : tm.Q)
    (syms : Fin (k + 2) → Γ) : (stepActsOf tm q syms).length = k + 2

name: Complexity.Cobham.stepBranch_halt
statement:
theorem stepBranch_halt {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) (R : List Bool)
    {p : tm.Q × (Fin (k + 2) → Γ)} (h : p.1 = tm.qhalt) (z : List Bool) :
    stepBranch tm R p z = z

name: Complexity.Cobham.stepBranch_step
statement:
theorem stepBranch_step {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) (R : List Bool)
    {p : tm.Q × (Fin (k + 2) → Γ)} (h : p.1 ≠ tm.qhalt) (z : List Bool) :
    stepBranch tm R p z
      = branchFn R (stateCode (stepStateOf tm p.1 p.2)) (stepActsOf tm p.1 p.2) z

name: Complexity.Cobham.stepFn_apply
statement:
theorem stepFn_apply {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) (c : Cfg k tm.Q) {W : ℕ}
    (hq : Fintype.card tm.Q ≤ blockWidth W) (hW : ∀ t ∈ cfgTapes c, t.head ≤ W) :
    stepFn tm (blockRuler W) (cfgCode W c)
      = stepBranch tm (blockRuler W) (c.state, cfgReads c) (cfgCode W c)

name: Complexity.Cobham.stepFn_eq
statement:
theorem stepFn_eq {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) {c c' : Cfg k tm.Q} {W : ℕ}
    (h : tm.step c = some c') (hq : Fintype.card tm.Q ≤ blockWidth W)
    (hW : ∀ t ∈ cfgTapes c, t.head ≤ W)
    (hout : c.output.StartInvariant) (hwork : ∀ i, (c.work i).StartInvariant)
    (hgood : List.Forall₂ (fun (a : Γ × Dir3) (t : Tape) =>
      (t.head = 0 → a.1 = t.cells t.head) ∧
      (a.2 ≠ Dir3.right → t.head ≠ 0) ∧ t.head ≤ W) (stepActs tm c) (cfgTapes c)) :
    stepFn tm (blockRuler W) (cfgCode W c) = cfgCode W c'

name: Complexity.Cobham.stepFn_halted
statement:
theorem stepFn_halted {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) {c : Cfg k tm.Q} {W : ℕ}
    (h : c.state = tm.qhalt) (hq : Fintype.card tm.Q ≤ blockWidth W)
    (hW : ∀ t ∈ cfgTapes c, t.head ≤ W) :
    stepFn tm (blockRuler W) (cfgCode W c) = cfgCode W c

name: Complexity.Cobham.stepFn_length_le
statement:
theorem stepFn_length_le {k : ℕ} (tm : TM k) (R z : List Bool)
    (hz : z.length ≤ (2 * (k + 2) + 1) * R.length) :
    (stepFn tm R z).length ≤ (2 * (k + 2) + 1) * R.length

name: Complexity.Cobham.stepFn_mem
statement:
theorem stepFn_mem {n k : ℕ} (tm : TM k)
    {gR gz : (Fin n → List Bool) → List Bool} (hR : Cobham gR) (hz : Cobham gz) :
    Cobham fun v : Fin n → List Bool => stepFn tm (gR v) (gz v)

name: Complexity.Cobham.take_pairCode
statement:
theorem take_pairCode (W : ℕ) (t : Tape) :
    (pairCode W t).take (blockRuler W).length = padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t)

name: Complexity.Cobham.take_two_drop_pairCode
statement:
theorem take_two_drop_pairCode {W : ℕ} (t : Tape) (hW : t.head ≤ W) :
    ((pairCode W t).drop (blockRuler W).length).take 2 = symCode t.read

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapeStepBlocksFst
statement:
theorem tapeStepBlocksFst {n : ℕ} (s : Γ) (d : Dir3)
    {gR gL gRt : (Fin n → List Bool) → List Bool}
    (hR : Cobham gR) (hL : Cobham gL) (_hRt : Cobham gRt) :
    Cobham fun v : Fin n → List Bool =>
      (tapeStepBlocks (gR v) s d (gL v) (gRt v)).1

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapeStepBlocksSnd
statement:
theorem tapeStepBlocksSnd {n : ℕ} (s : Γ) (d : Dir3)
    {gR gL gRt : (Fin n → List Bool) → List Bool}
    (hR : Cobham gR) (hL : Cobham gL) (hRt : Cobham gRt) :
    Cobham fun v : Fin n → List Bool =>
      (tapeStepBlocks (gR v) s d (gL v) (gRt v)).2

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapesStepFn_eq
statement:
theorem tapesStepFn_eq {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]
    (W : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Q) :
    ∀ (acts : List (Γ × Dir3)) (j : ℕ), j + acts.length ≤ (cfgTapes c).length →
      tapesStepFn (blockRuler W) acts j (cfgCode W c)
        = ((List.zipWith (fun a t =>
            [(tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
                (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).1,
             (tapeStepBlocks (blockRuler W) a.1 a.2 (padTo (blockRuler W) (leftCode t))
                (padTo (blockRuler W) (rightCode t W))).2])
            acts ((cfgTapes c).drop j)).flatten).flatten

name: Complexity.Cobham.tapesStepFn_length_le
statement:
theorem tapesStepFn_length_le (R : List Bool) :
    ∀ (acts : List (Γ × Dir3)) (j : ℕ) (z : List Bool),
      (tapesStepFn R acts j z).length ≤ 2 * acts.length * R.length

name: Complexity.NTM.choiceTM_simulates
statement:
theorem choiceTM_simulates (tm : NTM k) (T : ℕ) (c : Cfg (k + 1) tm.Q)
    (hinv : (c.work (Fin.last k)).StartInvariant)
    (hhead : 1 ≤ (c.work (Fin.last k)).head) :
    ∃ (c' : Cfg (k + 1) tm.Q) (t : ℕ), t ≤ T ∧
      (choiceTM tm).reachesIn t c c' ∧
      (t < T → (choiceTM tm).halted c') ∧
      dropChoice c' = tm.trace T (fun j => choiceStream c j.val) (dropChoice c)

    ∃ c₁, (choiceTM tm).step c = some c₁ ∧
      dropChoice c₁ = stepCfg tm (choiceStream c 0) (dropChoice c) ∧
      c₁.work (Fin.last k) = (c.work (Fin.last k)).move Dir3.right
